dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mdun du brjod par mi bya ste dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ rdo rje spyi bor bas ste/ 'di ni su yang rung ba la/ /gal te khyod kyis smras gyur na/ khyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje yis/ /rang gi mgo bo 'gas par 'gyur/ /rdo rje snying gar gto la/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag gzhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshe/gas/ /bdud rtsi blud la/ oṃ badzra u da ka hū oṃ ā hū/'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis grub/ /o sarba pañtsa a rlu to da ka hū/ rdo rje spyi bor gsas te/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi ni/ /he ru ka dpal nga yin gyis/ /nga yis bsgo ba khyod kyis gyis/ khyod kyis nga la brnyas byas na/ /mi bde ma spangs dus byas nas/ /dmyal bar lhung bar gyur ta re/ /slob mas ye shes dbab pa'i don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /bdag la byin gyis rlobs mdzod la/ /rdo rje ye shes bla med ni/ /da lta nyid du dbab du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod blud la/ 'di skad ces/ khyed rang rnams he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ snying ga padma 'dab ma bzhi'i steng du nyi ma la gnas pa'i hū sngon po/ /oṃ uhrī hū hū zhes pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba/ mar me bzhin du 'od 'bar ba la ma yengs par rtse gcig tu sgom shig /mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas hu sngon 'od 'phro ba/ de las 'od zer dkar po 'phreng ma chad pa byung ba snying gar zhugs/ lus thams cad 'od zer dkar pos gang bar mos/ zhes brjod la rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ tsho te uhrī hū hū oṃ badzra ā be sha ya a a/ zhes drag tu —32—

brjod cing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bkug ste slob ma'i lus la bcug par bsgom/gnyis pa spogs chog ni/ slob ma'i snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i he ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas 'od zer dmar po'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste lus thams cad gang / mthar yab yum 'od zer dmar por zhu/ lus kyi nad thams cad 'od zer dmar pos gang bar sgoms shigaces brjod la rol mo'i sgra bya ba gong bzhin slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram bzhag ste/ tiṣṭha badzra/zhes brjod pas brtan par byas/ nam mkha'i kha dog 'bri/ lha'i rigs kyi rim pa dang / /bsod nams rim pa de bzhin shog /'di yi dngos grub ci 'drar 'gyur/ /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /'di la bsod nams ci yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /zhes slob dpon gyis bden stobs brjod/ bde gshegs snying po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rig pa'i me tog 'di phul bas/ /sngon tshe ye shes bsnyen pa'i lha/ /gang yin de la 'bab par shog /lko pra titsā badzra ho/zhes brjod du gzhug cing me tog 'bul/ sems can stobs chen khyod kyis ni/ /'di ni rab tu gus pas bzung / zhes me tog slob ma'i mgo la bcings/ skabs 'dir me tog spyin pa 'di mar rngog sogs gong ma'i phyag len yin/ gzhung don ni ma yin no/ /slob ma'i mig gnyis la yi ge o/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong ba yang / /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /o badzra ni tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa lam hi zhes gdong g.yogs phye/ de nas blta bar bskul ba ni/dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ khyod na rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /'gro ba phun —33—

tshogs dngos grub kun/ /dngos grub thams cad mngon du 'gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang / /sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis/ /zhes brjod la mngon rtogs ltar lha ngo ston/ bdag 'jug gi skabs su/ dkyil 'khor chen po mngon sum du mthong zhing byin gyis brlubs par gyur zhes brjod/de nas dbang bskur ba dngos la bzhi las/ dang po bum dbang bskur ba ni/ maṇḍal phul/he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyobs phyir gzi brjid can/ /ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas stsal/ /de bzhin bdag la deng stsole cig /dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i/ /dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol/ / sems can kun kyi don bgyid phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon 'gyur/ / slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros dbang gi lha dpal he ru ka rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dza a ji dang nyer spyod phul/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas la nas/ gnang bar zhu zhes gsol ba gdab bo/ /slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su padma 'dab brgyad khri dang bcas pa la bzhag pa'am bzhag par mos sdo/ bcug /yungs kar gyis brabs/ 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ hū zhes bsrung ba bya/steng du gdugs phub/ mtha' skor du mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung pos bskor bar mos/ slob ma mahā ma ya he ru ka'i sku gyur/ oṃ pra tisnro ho gtso bo la me tog dor/ o dharmā kuṇḍa a bhi khiñtsa hu/ me teg 'phreng ba slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag go/dbang dang po'o//bsangs sbyangs/ dbang rdzas bum chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hū las byung ba'i mi bskyod pa he ru ka /sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/rus pa'i rgyan can/ yum mā ma gī sngon po gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor —34—

bar gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam par badzra sa mā dza dza : ba ho gnyis su med par thim/ badzra dhika ces lan bdun bzlas/ mi bskyod pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur/bum chu rnams gtso bo'i bum pa'am thod par bsdus la/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/khams gsum kun kyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba spyin par bya/ /o uhrī hū hū oṃ badzra a bhi ta ngos mi/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur ba na/ mkha' 'gro ma bum pa thogs pa dpag tu med pas kyang dbang bskur bar gyur/ de ltar na chu dbang bskur bas kun gzhi rnam shes gnas gyur nas/ me long lta bu'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa yin no/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ bsangs sbyangs/ dbang rdzas cod pan: a las rin chen 'byung ldan he ru ka ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan can/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor bar gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnam par badzra sa mā dzadza hu ba ho gnyis su med par thim/ swa ratna dhika ces lan bdun tsam bzlas la/ rin chen 'byung ldan zhu ba las byung ba'i cod pan du gyur/ thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan pa/ /sangs rgyas kun kyis bsngags pa yi/ /rin chen dag gi dbu rgyan dang / /dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /lko badzra pā ṭa ka a ra lli hu/ o ratna a bhi ṣañtsa mi/ zhes dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur ba na/ mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pas kyang cod pan gyis dbang bskur bar gyur/ de ltar dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa can gyi yid gnas gyur nas/—35—

mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rgyud la skyes pa yin no/ /bsangs sbyangs/ dbang rdzas rdo rje: thri las snang ba mtha' yas he ru ka dmar po padma dang dril bu 'dzin pa rus pa'i rgyan can/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo spi thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba2 sogs dang / ā a ro lika: ces bzla/ 'od dpag med: rdo rjer gyur/slob ma'i lag pa g.yas par rdo rje gtad la/ o sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab grub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis bzung / o badzra a dhi pa ti stu/ a bhi ski nyu shi/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje'i sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /ces snying gar bzung du 'jug go /mkha' 'gro rme dpag tu med pas kyang dbang bskur/ de ltar na rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa gnas gyur nas/ so sor kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa yin no/ /bsangs sbyangs/ dbang rdzas dril bu/ kha las don yod grub pa he ru ka ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor bar: ha pradzñā dhika: ces bzlas/ don yod grub pa dril bur: de nas dril bu lag pa g.yon du byin la/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ khres rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems can gyis/ /mchog gi srid pa byed par 'gyur/ /o shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti sta/ a bhi sa ṣañtsa tiṣṭha bī ra sa ma ya stu/ mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu —36—

med pas kyang dril bu'i dbang bskur/ de ltar na dril bu'i dbang bskur bas sgo lnga'i rnam shes gnas gyur nas bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa yin no/ /slob ma mahā ma ya dpal he ru ka la yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro mas 'khyud par gyur/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ /lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba/ /slob dpon gyi ni dbang du brjod/ /yid kyi lus su brtan pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod/ /gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan/ /des na phyag rgya rab tu bsgrags/ /zhes phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig bzung ngo / /dbang rdzas rdo rje dang rdo rje dril bu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bhu las rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa rus pa'i rgyan can/ yum spyan ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor bar gyur/rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam par badzra sa mā dza dza : ba ho gnyis su med par thim/ o dzi na dzig:ces mang du bzlas/ rnam snang zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rje dang rdo rje dril bur gyur/ slob ma'i mgo bor rdo rje dang dril bu bzhag la/ o shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti sta/a bhi khiñtsa mi/ shrī he ru ka nā ma a ghi ṣe ka ta kye dpal/ rigs dang mthun pa'i ming btags/ zhes ming gi dbang bskur ba na/ mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pas kyang ming gi dbang bskur/ de ltar ming gi dbang bskur bas/ phung po bzhi gnas gyur nas/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du gyur pa yin no/ /de nas dbang rdzas rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las gri gug dang ḍā ma ru hū las thod pa dang kha ṭā ga rnams thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug gi rang bzhin du —37—

gyur/ he ru ka dpal kha ṭāX ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍā ma sa /rdo rje kha ṭāX rdo rjer bcas/ /dril bu sil sil sgra sgrog pa/ /tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag /gri gug dang ni ka pā la/ /dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis/ /'di garnya las ma bshad kyang bod kyi bla ma rnams mdzad pa mi 'brel ba ma yin no/ /slob ma'i snying ga'am lag tu rdo rje gto cing / 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha e ṣa stuX dha ra ya mi huX ha ha ha ha hiX zhes rdo rje brtul zhugs sbyin no/ /dzaXhūX baX hoX dbang gi lha rnams slob ma la thim/ mchod pa brtan bzhugs bya'o/ /rgyud bsdus pa 'di dag la cho ga'ang bsdus pa shin tu 'os pas/ de tsam gyis kyang lugs 'di'i bum dbang ma tshang ba med pa yin la/ spros pa la dga' na 'di dag kyang bya bar bzhed de/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badzra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laX hiX zhes mig thur dang / cho se rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'gyung / /wo brjod de me long dang /hoXlas skyes pa'i mda' gzhu/ hoXsarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ya swaX zhes mda' gzhu lag tu gtad de 'phen tshul byed du gzhug /rkang pa'i bar du 'khor lo btsug la/ de ring phyin chad 'jig rten la/ /skyobs pa rnams kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla med pas/ /kun tu sdig med dri med pa'o/ /dung dang po ti gtad la/ khyod kyi the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla —38—

med pas/ /dri med kun tu gang bar byos/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar byed dang gnod sogs dang / /bsad dang bskrad pa thams cad de/ /las de rnams ni sgrub par gyis/ /zhes las sna tshogs dang / /nangs par sngar langs sems dag nyid/ /ma lus las ni byas nas kyang / /srung dang bza' ba la sogs pa/ /sdom pa'i bdag nyid can srung ngo / /zhes dam tshig sbyin no/ /bla gos gyon zhing skyabs sbyin dang bcas pas/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan/ /he ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu bsgrub pas ni/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /he shrī che ge mo na ma sarba ta thā ga ta sidha sa ma ya sgyir bhu wa swa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis lung bstan par mos pa gyis shig /gsang chen mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /mthong ba dang ni bcag pa yis/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol nas/ khyod ni de ring bde bar gnas/ /slob dpon brnyas par mi bya zhing / /gus pa yis ni mchod par byed/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yongs su btang bar mi bya'o/ /dam tshig sdom pa bsrung bya ste/ /rnam par mi rtog gos med pas/ /rang lha'i rnal 'ebyor gnas pa yis/ /'dod pa'i yon tan bsten par bya/ khyod rang sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /zhes dbugs dbyung ngo / /mig thur nas 'di'i bar bum dbang dang bzhi pa'i 'jug 'dam ka dang gsang dbang gi mthar yang rung bar bshad pas nub gcig la dbang ji tsam byed pa de'i mthar sbyor ro/ /de ltar na bum pa'i dbang thob/lus kyi dri ma dag /dman pa dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor sgoms pa dang / rgyud nyan bshad dang gtor ma'i bya ba la sogs pa la dbang ngo / /gnyis pa gsang dbang ni/ rig ma mtshan ldan dang bcas pa'i zhing khams phul bar —39—

bsams la/ maṇḍal phul/ khyod kyi zhabs kyi drin gyis ni/ /bdag gis bla med byang chub thob/ /gsang ba'i dbang bskur gsang ba che/ /gtso bo chen pos bdag la stsa'// /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ tse( ā hu mig dar bcing / mngon rtogs ltar/sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i mgo bor o dkar po zhes pa nas (〈pho〉 snying gar hu sngon po/ lte bar khyu ser po/ gsang gnas su ā dmar po/ brla gnyis la ha ljang khu/ mkha' gsang stong pa'i ngang las hū rdo rje oṃ las nor bu/ hi las padma bhu las ze'u 'khru'o/ /'khrud pa tsum pa la sogs pas shes rab ma la bde ba skyes pa na/ lha mo bzhis/ e ma gnyen mchog rdo rje'i 'od kyis padma rab phye shiga.a la la la la ho/ bde ba chen po rab tu dgyes pa'i gar mdzod cig /ji ltar nyi ma'i 'od kyis padma rab kha 'byed pa bzhin/ a la la la la ho/ bde ba chen po rab tu dgyes pa'i gar mdzod cig /ces bskul bas/ 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal dang bcas snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgra dang sbyor mtshams nas byung ba'i phaṭa yig gis sgras/ sangs rgyas thams cad bkug nas )yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba a wa dhu ti'i lam brgyud rdo rje nas phyung ste/ shes rab kyi mkhar gnas pa'i byang chub kyi sems lce steng du babs par gyur/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ sogs kyi mthar 'bru gsum brjod la/ 'o ma dang bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba spyin/ des kyang / a ti su kha/ zhes brjod/ 'bru gsum gyis mig ras bsal lo/ /de ltar na gsang ba'i dbang thob pas ngag gi dri ma dag /steng sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor sgom pa dang / bza' ba'i dam tshig bstan pa la dbang ba yin no/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ slob mas maṇḍal 'bul/ slob dpon go 'phang che rang bzhin/ /skal —40—

pa chen po bdag la stsole/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi dbang bskur ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab sgrub pa/ /brtul zhugs mchog gi khyod drin gyis/ /bdag la nges par stsal nas kyang / /des ni sems can dpag med don/ /ji ltar 'dul bzhin bdag bgyid do/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ /'bru gsum gyis mig dar bcings/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas/ rig ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma mdzes sgeg lang tsho dang ldan par byin gyis rlabs te/ khyed rang rnams he ru kar gsal ba la 'byud par mos mdzes ma 'di ni bzung ba dang / /bsten byar sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags/ /'di ni gzungs ma yid dga' ma/ khyod kyis rtag tu brjod par gyis/ /rang snang ba'i lha sku yab yum mnyam par sbyar ba'i rkyen gyis/ lte ba'i gtum mo ye shes kyi me a thung drod kyi rang bzhin can 'bar ba la mnyam par bzhag pas/ spyi bo'i thig le zhu ba'i dga' ba bzhi rgyud la skyes par gyur/ 'bru gsum gyis mig dar dbye'o/ /de ltar na shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pas/ yid kyi dri ma dag /'og sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang ba yin no/ /bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che ni/maṇḍal zhig phul la/ mtshon bya don bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes shes bya gshis kyi dngos po'i gnas lugs de nyid mtshon byed dpe dbang gsum pa'i dus su nyams myong gi sgo nas gtan la phab pas de'i rang bzhin gdod ma nas 'od gsal bde chen rnam pa thams cad pa yin te/ rgyud las/ chos rnams rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /gdod nas dag cing rnyog pa med/ /thabs brjod de yis de la ni/ /rang byung ye shes lnga ldan 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /zhes —41—

mtshams sbyar nas gnas lugs la cung zad 'jog tu gzhug de ltar na dbang bzhi pa thob pas lus ngag yid gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa dag /mthar thug chos kyi rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang ngo / /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal sogs/ maṇḍal 'bul/deng nas brtsams te sogs spyi dang 'dra'o/ /dbang bzhi nyin zhag so so la bskur na/ gsang ba dang / shes rab kyi dbang la yang spyod pa'i dbang ma gtogs/ chu nas brtul zhugs kyi bar bum dbang ltar phal cher sngon du 'gro bar byed la/ khyad par ni phyag rgya'i dam tshig brtul zhugs kyi rjes su byed pa'o/ /rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga la mchod pa byin rlabs dang 'bul tshul sa chog gi skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra/ de nyid lnga pas bstod/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs bzod gsol nas bkra shis kyi bar sta gon gyi skabs bzhin/ o khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /sogs kyi mthar/ o ā hū badzra mu zhes lan gsum gyis ye shes pa gshegs/ dza : ba ho lan bdun gyis dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ a kā ro'i sngags kyis rdul tshon phyags shing / dri bzang gi chu thig rnams dbyi/ rdul tshon chu bor spyan drangs la/ dkyil 'khor gyi shul du zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg bya/ sngar dngos su phur gdab byas na phur pa'ang dbyung dgos so/ /rgyud rgyal sgyu 'phrul chen mo yi/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga rab gsal bar/ /bris pa'i dge ba gang yin des/ /'gro kun he ru kar gyur cig/ //mahā ma ya'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rin rṣa sgron ma zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rdo rje 'dzin pa byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' zhes bya ba'i gsung gis bskul nas/ rgyal khams pa twa ra nā thas sbyar ba ste/ yang smras pa/ rgya gzhus rnams ni go dka' ste/ /'ga' zhig brgyud pa'ang chad pa dang / /lugs 'dir mkhas shing grub brnyes pa/ /phyogs 'dir byon pas sbyar ba yang / /cung zad brjod pa mi bde —42—

zhing / /mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis sbyar ba/ /dpe sna sna tshogs bsdus pa'i phyir/ /snying po byin rlabs rgyun chad dang / /man ngag ldan pa'i yi ge ni/ /gsal po gzhan yang ma mthong bas/ /gzhung dang man ngag ji bzhin du/ /cung zad 'bad rtsol byas pa yin/ /mahā ma ya la dkyil chog rgya gzhung bzhi yod de/ dkyil chog rim pa gsal ba lo tsā ba gzhon nu tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ 'di'i dpe rnying mang po la mdzad byang med/ kha cig las ku ku ri pas mdzad/ ces 'byung / mar rngog kyang de ltar bzhed/don la'ang ku ku ri pa'i gsung dngos sam gsung gi rgyun ma nor pa yin par nges la/ kha cig las nag po spyod pas mdzad ces 'byung na chog sgros rnams sdom pa'i dkyil chog dang mthun shas che ba bsams pa'o/ /gzhan dpal brgyan pas mdzad pa dang / 'dul bas byin gyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog yod/ ku ku ri pa nyid kyis mdzad zer ba'i dbang chog 'gos 'gyur zhig yod de/ ku ku ri pa'i rtsom min par nges so/ /rgya gar gyi sgrub dkyil gyi rigs la/ rgyal po dharmā pā la yan chad la brtsams pa dang / de rjes sgo drug gi bar dang / de nas a bha ya'i bar dang / de'i phyis su byung ba ste/dus thog bzhi po de'i skabs kyi bstan bcos rnams la rtsoms kyi babs byed lugs mi 'dra ba re snang ba de go na/ rim pa gsal ba 'di dang po'i rigs su 'dug /gzhan 'di rnams gsum pa'i rigs su 'dug pas/ mahā ma ya'i dkyil chog rtsa ba de rim pa 'dir 'dug /nyan bshad kyi bka' yang 'di la yod pas byin rlabs kyi rgyun can yin/ 'dir brgyud pa gong ma'i phyag len kha skongs rnams man ngag ltar byas dgyes rdor sogs kyi 'dres byas pa 'di'i gzhung dang mi mthun pa rnams dor te/ gtsang dag tu sbyar ba'o//—43—

zhes bya ba shin tu rnam par dag cing gsa'/ ba bzhu / gas/na mo gu sa zag med bde la dgyes rol zhing / /bdud bzhi 'dul phyir drag po'i sku/ /sgyu 'phrul he ru kar btud nas/ /rdzogs rim la brten sgrub thabs tshand/ /'dir mahā mā ya'i 'khrid tshul gyi snying po tsam brjod de/ 'di la gnyis/ sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi'o/ /dang po la/ sdig sgrib sbyangs pa dang /tshogs bsags pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang mthun par byas la he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa'i rnal 'byor la brtson par byed pa'o/ /de ni spyi dang 'dra ba las rdo rje sems dpa' skad cig gis bskyed cing gnas gsum byin rlabs sogs mi dgos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ mdun du rten gyi maṇḍal tshom bu lnga pa zhig bsham/ de rnams sesgo'i khri lnga tshoms su mos/ mdun du mchod pa'ang ci 'byor ba bsham/ dbus kyi gdan la bla ma dang mahā mā ya yab yum dbyer med pa dang / phyogs bzhi'i gdan la mkha' 'gro ma bzhi bsgom/mtha' skor du mchod par 'os pa thams cad kyis bskor bar bsam la/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang 'bul ba spyi dang mthun par bya/ de nas mchod pa'i maṇḍal thog mthar rgyas pa re dang / bar du thun gyi grangs 'dzin tshom bu bdun ma la mdzad cing / thun re rer brgya rtsa las mi nyung ba re 'bul/ thun gyi mthar —44—

gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ mchod yul gzhan rnams gtso 'khor lnga la thim/lha mo bzhi yang gtso bo la thim/ slar yang mos gus drag tu byas pas/ bla ma he ru ka yab yum yang bdag nyid la thim par bsams la cung zad mnyam par bzhag go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bzhi ste/ dman pa dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor/ zab pa sngags kyi rnal 'byor/ mthar thug chos kyi rnal 'byor/ 'phros don sgyu ma gsum rgyud kyi gdams ngag dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ slob dpon ku ku rī pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang rung ltar nyams su blang bar bya la/ de tsam ma 'grub na/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ shu n+ya tas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig tsam gyis rang nyid mahā mā ya he ru ka'i skur gsal btab/ sku de yang 'ja' tshon lta bu snang stong gnyis su med par bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa sngags kyi rnal 'byor la/ steng sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor dang / 'og sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor gnyis/ dang po la/ 'khor lo sngags kyi rnal 'byor dang / thig le sngags kyi rnal 'byor dang / phra mo sngags kyi rnal 'byor gsum las/ dang po la yang 'khor lo gcig la brten pa dang / gnyis la brten pa dang / bzhi la brten pa ste gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun spyi dang mthun par bcas/ rlung ro lan gsum bsal la rang dgar bzhag /'di gnyis 'og ma thams cad la rigs 'gre'o/ /de nas lus kyi dbus su rtsa gsum gsum gzhibs su yod pa/ dbu ma chos bzhi ldan te/dmar ba/ drang ba/ srab pa/ 'od gsal ba'o/ /ro ma dmar ba raktas gang ba/—45—

rkyang ma dkar ba kunas gang ba/ gsum kar gyi yas sna spyi bor sleb pa/ mar sna lte bar rtsa mdud chos 'byung gsum pa'i nang du chug pa/ dbu ma'i mas sna'i nang lte bar a shad/ ro ma la ki li so gnyis steng nas mar rim pas bkod pa dang /rkyang ma la ā li bcu drug 'og nas steng du rim pas bkod pa ste/ yi ge 'god tshul 'di slob dpon nā ro pa'i bzhed pa yin skad cing / mahā mā ya la mkhas pa'i slob dpon gas rnams ni/ ā li kā li'i steng 'og rim pa 'di go bzlog par 'dod do zhes gsung ngo / /de nas rlung kha sbyor cung zad bzung la/ steng 'og gi rlung gis lte ba'i a shad la bskul bas/ cung zad 'bar zhing bde drod kyi nyams rgyas par bsam/ gnyis pa ni/ bshad ma thag pa de nyid dang dmigs pa'i gzhi 'dra ba las/ spyi bor dbu ma'i nang du ha dkar po mgo bo thur du blta ba gcig gsal btab la rlung kha sbyor 'jam por bzung bas/ lte ba'i a shad las/ me lce phra mo dmar ser zhig sir te 'bar nas spyi bo'i ha gi cha shas bsregs pas/ byang chub kyi sems khu 'phang lta bu khro lo lo 'bab pa'i chu rgyun phra mo ltar cil li li babs nas me'i mtha' ma na mar sib sib thim par bsam/gsum pa ni/ rtsa gsum gong du 'dra ba las/ lte ba/ snying ga mgrin pa/ spyi bo rnams su/ rtsa 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bzhi pa re re yod pa thams cad kyang kha dog dmar po/ dbu ma'i nang lte bar a dang / mgrin par o mgo bo gyen bstan/ de gnyis dmar po/ snying gar hu sngon po/ spyi bor ha dkar po mgo bor thur bstan no/ /ro rkyang gi yi ge yang sngar ltar bsgom la/ rlung kha sbyor bzung bas a las me shin tu rno ba phra ba zhig 'bar/ dbu ma'i lam rgyud/ snying ga'i hu dang mgrin —46—

pa'i o phug ste/ spyi bo'i ha la bsnun pas/ byang sems zhu ste/ o dang hū khengs shing de dag gi dwangs ma yang lhan cig tu babs pa'am/ yang na yi ge gsum las so sor babs te/ rkang gsum gyi rnam par sgom pa'am khu 'phang 'bab pa ltar byas kyang rung ste/ de rnams lte ba'i a la sib sib thim pas/ lus sems bde bas gang bar bsam/ gnyis pa thig le sngags kyi rnal 'byor la/ rnam pa gsum ste/ steng gi sna rtser sgom pa dang / 'og gi sna rtser sgom pa dang / lus kyi dbus su sgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dmigs pa'i ngo bo gcig yin yang / sgrub thabs so so'i dgongs pas/ dmigs skor lngar 'gyur te/ de yang slob dpon chen po shānti pa'i man ngag ltar na/ rang gi snying padma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi par kha phye ba/ 'dab ma bzhi la thig le re/ de'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor me dang rlung gi rang bzhin de'i steng du zla ba sa dang chu'i rang bzhin/ nyi zla gnyis po ga'u kha sbyor du gnas pa'i dbus su/ thig le dkar po yungs kar tsam/ nyi zla kha sbyor la/ ba thag phra mo zhig gis mdun rgyab tu tshan gsum du dkris/ steng gi zla ba'i thad kyi de gsum la/ dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge rnams brgyus par bsam ste/de yang g.yas pa la/ ka nas da'i bar nga nya spangs pa dang / dbus ma la dbyangs bcu drug dang ka g.yon pa la dha nas lnga'i bar rnams te yi ge rnams 'phreng rdog lta bu la/ 'od kyi ba thag phreng thag lta bu dang / dbus kyi zla ba la bu ga phra mo zhig dang de yod par bsams la/ lam de nas thig le la sems drag tu gtod pa'o/ /zhes rngog gong ma dag gsung / 'grel pa yon to dang ldan pa las 'di dang cung zad mi 'dra ba zhig gsungs so/ /slob dpon ku ku rī pa'i —47—

sgrub thabs bsdus pa shin tu spros med ltar na/ dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor ni/ der rdor sems yab yum du sgom par bshad kyang / mtha' gcig tu ma nges pas he ru ka bsgom kyang chog /snying gar padma dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa 'dab ma bzhi pa/ lte ba la nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor dbus su thig le dkar po dang bcas pa sngar bzhin gsal btab la/ 'dab ma bzhi la thig le bzhi bsgom ste/de yang shar sngo/ lhor ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang pa'o/ / dbus kyi zla ba la sgra dang bcas te bu ga rta rnga shong ba zhig dod rang gi dbugs phyi la 'gro ba dang bstun te/ thig le las 'od zer gyi skud pa zhig byung zla ba'i bu ga nas thon/mdun rgyab dang g.yas g.yon du rgya gram ris su dkris slar thig le la zug par bsam/ dbugs phyir 'gro ba'i tshe thig le las o yig rgyang ste thon sna sgo nas phyir song / nang du 'ong ba'i tshe hū zhig sna sgo nas zhugs sngar gyi lam brgyud nas thig le la thim par bsam/ de lta bu'i rdo rje'i bzlas pa lan mang du byas te mthar rlung 'gro 'ong dang bral bar bsams nas/ de'i rjes la thig le nyid la sems gtod pa gsang ba'i man ngag bzla ba'i dod du sba ba zhes bya ba yin la/zla ba'i bu ga nas thig le 'jur gyis byung nas zla ba'i steng du yer re 'dug pa la sems gtod pa ni gsang ba'i man ngag nam mkhar 'phyar ba zhes pa yin zhing / nyi zla kha sbyor gyi bar na gnas pa'i thig le nyid sems sems nyid thig le zhes thig le'i dbus su rang nyid zhugs par sgom pa ni gsang ba'i man ngag phra mor bzhag pa zhes pa yin no/ kha cig gzhung dngos bstan la zhen nas steng dang phra mo gnyis 'gog pa ni/ mkhas 'dod langs pas man ngag la sdang ba —48—

tsam du zad do/ /slob dpon 'gro ba bzang po'i de kho na nyid kyi man ngag ltar na/rang gi snying padma dmar po 'dab bzhi pa'i rnam par kha gyes pa'i lte bar nyi ma me rlung gi rang bzhin gyi steng du zla ba sa chu'i rang bzhin kha sbyor gyi dbus su thig le sngar dang mtshungs par bsgoms te de nyid la sems 'dzin pa'o/ /gzhung 'di'i mna' mchan las ku ku rī pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa'i lugs dang 'dra bar bshad kyang / 'gro bzang gi gzhung gi dgongs pa 'di las mi 'da' 'o/ /ku ku rī pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa'i lugs ltar na/ snying gar padma 'dab bzhi'i lte bar nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor gyi dbus su thig le snga ma ltar bsgoms nas/ rlung cung zad kha sbyar bas/ tog ces pa'i sgra zhig byung nas steng gi zla ba la bu ga rnga 'brum shong pa tsam zhig dod/ bu ga de nas rlung 'gro 'ong lan bdun tsam byas par bsam/de nas thig le las 'od zer gyi skud pa ba thag tsam la ā li kā li 'phreng ba star la brgyus pa zhig byung zla ba'i bu ga nas 'thon/ mdun rgyab tu dkris gsum dang g.yas g.yon du bzhi 'byog mtshams su phyed de phyed dang brgyad du dkris/ slar yang thig le nyid la thim par bsam/ de nas 'jam rlung kha sbyor du bzung nas thig le la sems 'dzin/ gsang ba'i man ngag zla ba'i dod du sba ba la sogs pa gsum po gang rung shig bsgom ste gong dang 'dra'o/ /'di'i yan lag tu rdo rje bzlas pa ni/ padma nyi zla thig le rnams snga ma ltar bsgoms la/thig le'i mthar ā li bcu drug kā li so bzhi rnams 'od kyi skud pa la brgyus pa sprul 'khyil ba ltar khor re dkyil le 'khor ba bsam/ rlung phyir 'gro ba'i tshe o zhes pa'i sgra dang bcas steng gi zla ba phug ste sna bug g.yas nas 'thon/ a phyi —49—

rol du rgyang nge 'dug pa dang kṣa snying ga'i zla ba la reg ge 'dug par bsam/rlung nang du rngub pa'i mtshams su 'od kyi skud pa de 'khyogs te/ a sna bug g.yon pa la reg gis byung ba na kṣa zla ba dang bral bar bsam/ rlung nang du 'ong ba'i tshe hū gi gdangs dang bcas sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ a snying ga'i zla ba la reg pa na/ kṣa sna bug g.yas nas mdun du rgyangs kyis 'thon par bsam/rlung cung zad bzung ba'i tshe zla ba'i bu ga nas zhugs te thig le la skor gyis 'khyil par bsams la/ ā zhes pa'i gdangs yid kyis dran par bya'o/ /de ltar lan mang du bsgom/ dmigs pas ngal na 'og nas 'byung ba lhar rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ skyes pa'i rdo rje nor bu'am gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lor bsgoms kyang rung la/ bud med kyi ni padma'i ze'u 'brur bsgom ste/de yang padma dmar po 'dab brgyad kha zum thabs su yod pa/ ze'u 'bru dmar rong re ba gcig bsam/ der nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su thig le yung 'bru tsam zhig bde ba'i rang bzhin du bsam/ de nas rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya ba 'dod na/steng rlung nang du 'jug pa'i tshe thig le las/ o byung zla ba phug nas rdo rje'i bu ga nas rgyangs kyis 'thon/ steng rlung phyir 'gro ba'i tshe oṃ hu gi rnam pa can du gyur nas sngar gyi lam nas tshur byung / thig le la thim par bsam/ steng rlung phyir 'dzin pa'i tshe ā zhes dran par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ slob dpon ku ku rī pa'i mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs 'bring po las 'byung ba ste/ spyi bor rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam ljang khu/ snying gar sa —50—

ser po gru bzhi/ lte bar chu dkar po zlum po/ mdoms bar du me dmar po gru gsum/ spyi bo'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du thig le dkar po de'i steng du haX mgo bo thur du lta ba'o/ /spyi bo'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor g.yos pas/ thig le hril te 'gril 'og tu song snying gar babs/ sa'i dkyil 'khor thig le la thim/ de bzhin du lte ba'i chu dang / mdoms kyi me yang thig les zos/ rdo rje'i rtser dkar tser gyis byung / yang yar hril li li 'gril/ spyi bo'i rlung yang zos haX la thim/ de nas dbugs dang 'grogs te/ rlung phyir song tsa na/ haX las thig le chad / rdo rje'i rtser dkar rtser gyis byung / nang du sas tsa na yar byung haX la thim/ de lta bu lan 'ga' zung byas te/ de nas thig le de nyid nar gyis song yar sna haX la 'byar mas snas rdo rje'i bu ga khengs te/ lus kyi dbus na yar skya shar re ba de drang nge 'dug par bsams la dar cig bzhag /de nas lte ba'i thad nas thig le skud pa lta bu de las yal ga gnyis kyis/ yar na ra ra song nas sna bug g.yas g.yon la zug par bsam/ dbugs phyir 'gro ba'i tshe nye ba nas oṃ zhig g.yas kyi thig le'i ba thag la 'khril nas sna g.yas nas 'thon/ nang du 'ong ba'i tshe hūX du gyur sna g.yon nas zhugs/ g.yon gyi ba thag la 'khril nas nye bar sleb/ gnas pa'i tshe āXru song ste dbus kyi ba thag la brten par bsam/de lta ma ning gi bzlas pa gang nas shig pa'o/ /gsum pa phra mo sngags kyi rnal 'byore la/ rlung rgya yan la bslab pa/ bgrang zhing rtsib la bslab pa/ bum pa can la bslab pa ste gsum mo/ /dang po la gnyis kyi/ rgya yan tsam po ni/ dbugs phyir 'gro ba'i tshe nad dang sdug bsngal dang rga shi ster ba'o snyam du bsam/ nang —51—

du 'ong ba'i dus tshe dang bsod nams dang mdangs stobs rgyas par byed nga/'o snyam du bsam mo/ /gnyis pa rdo rje'i bzlas pa la bslab pa ni/ rlud phyir 'gro ba na o/ nang du 'jug pa na hū gnas pa na ā zhes pa rnams yid kyis dran par byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum las dang po bgrang zhing rtsi ba tsam po ni/ dbugs phyi 'gro nang 'gro gcig tu bsdoms pa bcu tshan bcu tshan du bcad de yang yang sgrong ba'o/ /gnyis pa rdo rje'i bzlas pa la brten pa ni rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang sbyar te/bcu tshan bcu tshan tu sgrong ba'o/ /gsum pa man ngag gi gnad la brten pa ni/ /snying gar zla ba'i steng du hū dkar po/ /de las skyes pa'i 'od zer gyi skud pa'i sne la o gyis mtshan pa/ skud pa de nyid hu la g.yas skor du lan bdun du bskor bar bsam la/ dbugs phyir 'gro ba'i tshe de skor log tu zhig ste/ rlung gang nas rgyu ba'i sna sgo nas rgyangs kyis 'thon/ nang du 'ong ba'i tshe sngar bzhin hu la skor ba lan bdun du bskor bar bsam/ de nyid bcu tshan bcu tshan du sgrong pa'o /gsum pa bum pa can la rim gyis dgag pa dang / btsan thabs su dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ lus gnad sogs legs par bcos te/ 'a/ga len ltar hā ring pos rlung ro bsal pa lan bcu tsam byas te/ rlung shar gyis rngubs te/ lte bar drag tu mnan/ 'og rlud yar 'then pas/ rlud gnyis lte bar khrug chil chil 'thab pa la sems bstad/ bde drod yid la bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni seng ge rnas rol gyi phyag rgya bcas la bum can drag tu bzung ba ste/ 'di thun re la —52—

lan 'ga' zung re las mi bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'og sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor ni bla ma'i man ngag dang yig chung las logs su shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa mthar thug chos kyi rnal 'byor la/ thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ dang po la rang bzhin lam 'byer dang / snang ba lam 'byer gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lus gnad bcos/ sems rang babs su lhod kyis klod/ de'i ngang nas sems kyi ngo bo la che re bltas pas/ gsal la ngos gzung med pa gcig 'char te/ de ngos gzung la mnyam par bzhag /gnyis pa ni/ tshogs drug gi snang ba sna tshogs su shar ba 'di nyid la che re bltas shing snang tsam de nyid ngo shes par byas te/ bzo bcos med par cham me bzhag pa na snang ba de thams cad snang stong du 'char ba'o/ /gnyis pa la yang / rang bzhin lam 'byer dang / snang ba lam 'byer gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sngags kyi rnal 'byor sgoms pa'i bde ba yid la byas nas sems bde stong du ngo 'phrod par byas te sgom pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sems bde stong des tshogs drug gi snang ba la rgyas 'debs pa ste/ 'dis tshogs drug gi snang ba thams cad bde bar 'char ro/ /bzhi pa 'phros don sgyu ma gsum brgyud la/ snang ba sgyu ma/ rmi lam sgyu ma/bar do sgyu ma gsum las/ dang po ni bdag dang snang ba thams cad mahā mā ya'i dkyil 'khor du bsgoms te/ 'di thams cad kyang rang gi snang ba tsam yin/snang yang bden pas stong pa sgyu ma lta bu'o zhes sgyu ma'i 'dun pa drag tu sbyong ba'o/ /gnyis pa la/ rmi lam bzung ba dang / sbyang ba dang / gcig tu bya ba'o/ /—53—

dang po ni/ mgrin par padma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba la o/ 'dab ma bzhi la/ a nu ta ra bzhi bkod la/ dmigs pa'am/ yang padma'i lte bar thig le nag po a sngon pos mtshan pa la dmigs nas/ do nub rmi lam zin par bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag tu bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni rmi lam rmi tshad zin pa na/ do nub rmi lam rmi ba'i tshe snang ba thams cad mahā mā ya'i dkyil 'khor du bsgyur bar bya'o snyam du 'dun pa drag tu sbyangs te/ sad dus kyi snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor du bsgoms pas/ rmi lam 'khrul pa'i snang ba shar na'ang shar ma thag tu dmigs pa 'di bsgoms pas dkyil 'khor du 'gyur ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ nyin par do nub rmi lam rmi ba na sngags kyi rnal 'byor dang chos kyi rnal 'byor bsgom ste/ /rmi lam 'od gsal du 'jug par bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag tu bya'o/ /'dis mtshan mo rmi lam shar ba'i tshe/ gdams pa 'di dran te snying ga'i thig le sogs bsgoms pa'i rmi lam gyi snang ba yal te 'od gsal 'char la/ de nas chos kyi rnal 'byor bsgoms pas 'od gsal yun ring du skyong thub pa yin no/ /gsum pa la yang gzung ba dang / sbyang ba dang / gcig tu bya ba gsum las/ dang po ni/ snang ba 'di thams cad bar do yin pa 'dug snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag tu sbyangs/ gnyid nyal khar yang / da lta rang rmi lam 'byung bas/ de bar dor ngo shes par bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa yang yang sbyang ngo / /de'i rmi lam du bar do'i dge sbyor zin pa rtag tu 'ong na bar do zin pa zhes tha snyad 'jog go /gnyis pa ni/ nyin par bar do'i 'dun pa sbyangs nas/ bar do 'khrul —54—

pa'i snang ba 'di lha skur bsgyur bar bya'o snyam pas rang he ru ka yab yum dang /snod thams cad gzhal yas khang / bcud thams cad mahā mā ya yab yum mam bla ma yab yum du dran par bya'o/ /'dir yang bden med kyi 'dun pa drag tu sbyong ba gal che/ gsum pa ni/ rmi lam dang bar do'i gdams pa 'di la rten nas/ gnyid thams cad 'od gsal du chud par byas te nam zhig na 'chi ba 'od gsal ngos 'dzin pa yin no/ /de ltar na dkyus kyi 'khrid tshul ni de dag kho na yin la/ gzhan rdzogs rim thor bu pa/ gdams ngag bka' drug dang / bsam gtan gyi las tshogs drug po la bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gyi man ngag re re yod cing / g.yin gyi grong sogs bya ba dang / zhes pa las 'phros nas/ bsre 'pho nas 'byung ba ltar 'pho ba grong 'jug gnyis kyang ston no/ /da lta sgyu ma gsum brgyud kyi nyams len byed pa 'di las dang po pa'i sgyu lus dang 'od gsal la yin la/ 'di la brten nas rnal 'byor pa'i de dag rgyud la skye ba yin no/ /'di dag rgyud kyi ji ltar bstan skrudi ni/ ā li kā li mnyam byas nas/ zhes sogs rkang pa drug gis 'khor lo sngags kyi rnal 'byor dang / bzang po'i yi ge'i 'phreng ba rnams/ zhes sogs kyis thig le sngags kyi rnal 'byor steng 'og dang / gong bur song ba'i 'od de yi/ zhes pa'i thig le lus kyi dbus su sgom pa dang / dang po'i yi ge'i sbyor ba yi/ /sogs kyis rdor bzlas dang 'brel ba rnams dang / srog dang rtsol ba bsngams nas su/ /zhes pas/ bum pa can rim gyis dgag pa dang / mig gnyis dang ni sogs kyis btsan thabs su dgag pa dang / gang gang dbang bo'i lam las ni/ zhes sogs kyis chos kyi rnal 'byor —55—

dang / rnal 'byor gnyid dang yang dag ldan/ zhes pa dang ji ltar sku gsum mchog ster ba'i/ sogs kyis sgyu ma gsum brgyud kyi gdams ngag dang /dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor ni le'u gsum char du rgyas par gsungs pa dang / 'og sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor yang snga phyir 'thor thabs su mang du bstan pa yin no/ /sgyu ma gsum brgyud kyi yan lag tu/ 'byams bcod bzhi sbyor ba'ang snang la/de'i rnam gzhag shes par 'don na/ gsang 'dus nag 'khrid kyi yig rnying ngam/rim snga mar lugs kyi khrid yig shin du dag cing gsal ba zhig kho bos sbyar yod pas de ltar shes par bya'o// //'dir smras pa/ snying po mchog gyur lam bzang rmad byung 'di/ /chos kyi blo gros mtshan 'chang he ru ka /gang de'i srol 'dzin rin chen bdun brgyud sogs/ /rdo rje 'dzin rgyal rnams kyis dar bar mdzad/ /da lta phyogs med spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /tā ra nā tha bdag gi yid bde'i sos/ /mkhas rlom rnams la ming yang ma grags na/ /blo chung nga rgyal can la lta ci smos/ /rtag tu dman par rgyu yang ca co can/ /gya gyur spyod pa'i chu klung 'ga' med ngam/ /chu skyar sgyu ma'i brtul zhugs 'dzin mthong nas/ khres ldan rnams ni bag yod lam du gzhol/ khren tu rnyed dka'i rin chen 'di/ /rin thang med par yongs shes nas/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i byi dor du/ /tā ra nā thas sbyar ba yin/ /zhus dag /dge legs 'phel/ /—56—

rgya cher bshad pa de kho na nyed kyi sgron ma zhes bya ba bsdo/gas/na mo gu ru buddhā bo dhi sa te khyuX dpal ldan rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgya cher bshad pa de kho na nyid kyi sgron ma zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang / dpal he ru ka dbyer ma mchis pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan bde ba dam pa thugs rje'i stobs/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam snying po'i ye shes ni/ /mtha' yas sgyu ma'i rol rtsed ston mkhas pa/ /gcig pu mchog tu che ba lhag pa'i lhar/ /snyim pa me tog gis bkang shing / /mgrin pa dma' bas zhabs btud de/ /mtha' med 'khor ba ji srid bar/ /dngos po kun gyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyud rgyal yid bzhin nor bu yi/ /rgyal mtshan 'gro ba'i re bskong gang / /gzhan ngor mdzes pa bskyed pa'i phyir/ /tshig gi me tog 'phreng bas mchod/ /de la 'dir dpal sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rgyud rgyas pa las yongs su phyung ba nyung ja'i rgyud 'di ni tshig tshogs shin du nyung yang don lhag par rgyas pa'o/ /gzhan yang rdo rje'i tshig gi don rnam par dbye dka' ba'i phyir/ byis pa'i blo can bdag lta bu rnams kyi spyod yul ma yin yang / bla ma dam pa'i man ngag legs par mnos shing / rdo rje theg pa la tshad mar gyur pa'i grub pa'i slob dpon rnams kyi gsung gi rgyun thos pa dang / rdo rje —57—

'dzin pa chen po rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rnam par bshad pa la brten nas/ rang gi blo dang 'tsham par ci nus shig dbye bar bya'o/ /de la sngon du 'gro ba rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag dang / rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs la legs par shes nas rgyud kyi tshig don la 'jug dgos pa las/ dang po ni gzhan du shes par bya la/gnyis pa la yang / theg pa bla na med pa'i rgyud spyi'i mngon par rtogs pa/ rgyud gsum gyi don la nges pa rnyed cing / khyad par du/ rim pa gnyis kyi ngo bo dang /dbye ba dang / nges tshig dang / go rim dang / grol bar 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan dang / bye brag tu bskyed pa'i rim pa la/ ting nge 'dzin gsum dang / bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi dang / rnal 'byor bzhi dang / yan lag drug dang / de dag gi sbyang bya sbyong byed sbyangs 'bras rnams dmigs phyed pa dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa la/gang la gnad du bsnun pa'i gzhi gnas pa rtsa/ g.yo ba rlung / bkod pa byang chub kyi sems rnams dang / rdzogs rim gyi ngo bo la/ rlung sems dbu mar 'jug byed dang / zhugs zin gyi bya ba rnams dang / rim pa gnyis la drod thob nas spyod pas 'bras bu la mtshams sbyor ba'i tshul dang / lam lnga dang sa bcu'i rnam par bzhag pa rnams la nges pa rnyed pa zhig dgos pas de dag kyang gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa rgyud 'di nyid kyi mngon par rtogs pa la/sde snod gang du gtogs pa ngos bzung ba dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i masno gyi dgos don dang / mi yul du sus spyan drangs pa dang / rgyud kyi bsdus pa'i don bstan pa dang / rgyud gsum gyi rang bzhin rnam par bzhag pa ste don tshan lnga las/ dang po ni/ mdo dang sngags gnyis las sngags kyi theg pa dang / de la —58—

rgyud sde bzhi las rnal 'byor bla na med pa ste/ de la yang pha rgyud dang / ma rgyud gnyis las ma rgyud ces bya ba/ shes rab kyi rgyud dam rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud ces kyang bya bar gtogs te/ de skad du/ rig pa 'jig rten gsum po na/ khyod dang mnyam pa nga las med/ ces mahā ma ya'i rgyud 'di'i rig sngags ni/ yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i rig sngags yin par bshad cing / sngags de nyid lha mo'i rigs sngags yin la/ dkyil 'khor dang / las tshogs kyi cho ga thams cad sngags de nyid kyi dbang du byas pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud la dbye na rigs drug tu yod pa las/ rigs kyi gtso bo he ru ka'i rigs su gtogs shing / yang ma rgyud kyi gtso bo'i dbang du mdzad nas/ rdo rje gur las/ ji skad du/ mkha' 'gro sde dang rgya mtsho sde dang nam mkha' dang / /gser gyi char pa dang ni dga' chen za nus dang / /bde chen sgeg pa dang ni gsang ba yid bde dang / /rgyud de rnams la phan pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / /sangs rgyas thams cad dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dang / /gsang ba mdzod dang rdo rje bdud rtsi las byung ba'i/ /'khor lo bde mchog gur dang phun sum tshogs pa rnams/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud ni drug par grags pa yin/ /zhes gsungs te ma rgyud bcu bzhi las 'di ni gsang ba yid bde'o/ /'di la rgya bod gnyis na bshad rgyud rang rkang pa ni med la/ gsang ba kun las btus pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi le'u 'ga' zhig gis rgyud 'di bshad par grags na'ang de ni da lta bod na med cing / dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud du/ rgyud 'di'i tshig rags rim rnams 'dren par mdzad cing ci rigs pa mi gsal ba gsal ba'i phyir bshad —59—

pa yang mdzad la/ zla gsang thig le dang cung zad 'brel ba dang / 'di'i rgyud don ci rigs pa sa pu zhis kyang cung zad 'chad cing phag mo don grub ma'i rtog pa dang / 'phreng ba'i rig pa 'dzin ma'i rtog pa gnyis kyang rgyud 'di'i phyogs mthun du snang ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di le'u gsum tshigs su bcad pa dgu bcu lhag bcas tsam dang lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor kho na dang / mngon par rtogs pa yang gzhan las mdor bsdus par gsungs pa ni/ gang zag bsdus pa la dga' ba rnams rjes su bzung ba'i ched yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ grub pa'i slob dpon ku ku rī pas spyan drangs pa ste/ de nyid kyi lo rgyus su lta'o/ /bod kyi yul du thog mar 'gos khug pas bsgyur bshad mdzad cing / lo tsa ba gzhan dang gzhan gyis kyang gtan la phab mod kyi/ 'di ni rje btsun mar pa lho brag pa nas brgyud pa ste/des kyang slob dpon shanti pa'i lugs dang / nag po pa'i lugs dang / nā ro pa'i man ngag gi lugs gsum rdzogs par gsan zhing / slob dpon gzhan gyi man ngag kyang ci rigs pa gsan par gsal la/ phyis slob dpon ku ku rī pa nyid la ye shes kyi snang ba'i tshul gyis dngos su gnang ba nod pa yin no/ /rnam thar yongs khyab lhad can rnams su/ ku ku rī pa dang zhi ba bzang po gcig par 'dod pa ni mun sprul te/ zhi ba bzang po ni mar 'gos gnyis char kyi bla ma/ rje mar pas kyang rgyud sde gzhan mang po gsan pa'i bla ma'ang yin mod kyi/ de nyid mahā ma ya'i rgyud la ches mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa yin pas/ mahā ma ya bla ma thar pa'i lam ston kyi rjes su 'brangs zhes/ gtso bor nag po shanti bha dra dang —60—

bzhed pa mthun la/ dpal nā ro pa'i man ngag gi khyad par cung zad tsam gyis brgyan pa'o/ /'dir dbang rgyud man ngag gsum char mar lugs kyis gzhung bsrangs nas/ grub chen zhi ba sbas pa'i man ngag legs chas cung zad brgyan par bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ rgyud kyi chings sam bsdus pa'i don te rje mar pa'i zhal nas/ngas gsang sngags kyi po ti gang zugad kyang / po ti de'i dkyus stod smad kyi don thams cad thun chung gcig gi nang du bsdus nas/ slob ma'i blo la skyel shes pa yin gsung ste/ 'dir don gyi gtso bo sum cu rtsa gnyis su bsdu'o/ /de yang / sa chog /sta gon/ dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga dbang bskur ba ste bzhi'am/ yang na bum dbang / gsang dbang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang / bzhi pa tshig dbang ste dbang gi mngon rtogs bzhi po ngo bo thabs rgyud yin yang / rgyu rgyud bsos 'debs byed yin pa'i phyir/ rgyu rgyud kyi mngon rtogs su mdzad la/ dman pa dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor rigs gnyis 'khor lo sngags kyi rnal 'byor/ thig le sngags kyi rnal 'byor/ phra mo sngags kyi rnal 'byor/ 'og sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor/ mthar thug chos kyi rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor gyi dam tshig ste brgyad ni thabs rgyud kyi mngon rtogs dang / las chen brgyad thun mong gi dngos grub brgyad/ mchog gi dngos grub la sku bzhi ste/ nyi shu ni 'bras rgyud kyi mngon rtogs so/ /de rnams su rgyud don mtha' dag 'dus pa ma yin kyang sgrub pa po la nye bar mkho ba'i don gyi gtso bo thams cad tshang ba yin no/ /yang na/ sgom bya dngos po'i gnas lugs/ sgom pa po gang zag gi mtshan nyid/ ji ltar sgom pa'i —61—

tshul/ de ltar sgoms pa'i 'bras bu ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ lus sems kyi gnas lugs sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa dang / dam tshig ma nyams pa dgos pas de'i rnam gzhag go /gsum pa ni sngags dbyibs chos gsum spyod pa dang bcas pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni las dang dngos grub ste/ bzhi po 'dis ni/ rgyud don ma lus pa yongs su rdzogs par bsdus so/ /lnga pa la/ rgyu rgyud kyi rang bzhin bstan pa/ thabs rgyud kyi rim pa bshad pa/ 'bras rgyud kyi rnam par bzhag pa dang gsum mo/ /dang po la/ sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba ni chos thams cad kyi chos nyid yin pa dang / rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa dang /'khor ba'i chos thams cad kyi dbyings dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad kyi rten dang / rang gi rig pa'i bdag nyid du gnas pa ste khyad par lnga las/ dang po ni/ gang zhig gis ni kun khyab pa/ /zhes dang / sems dang sems med sems rang bzhin/ /zhes pa la sogs pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/chos rnams rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /gdod nas dag cing rnyog pa med/ /ces dang /gsum pa ni/ 'jig rten gsum po yang spro'o/ /zhes dang / bzhi pa ni/tshangs la sogs pa bdag nyid che/ zhes dang / lnga pa ni/ sgrub pa'i dbang phyug rig pa nyid/ /ces pas bstan no/ /de yang rags par na rgyu rgyud ni rten gyis gang zag ste/ dbang bzhi thob pa'i khyad par dang ldan pa'o/ /de yang zhib mor na de'i sems rgyud do/ /de'i phyir rgyu rgyud dngos ni sems rang bzhin gyis 'od —62—

gsal ba yin la/ rgyu rgyud kyis bsdus pa ni/ 'khor ba'i chos thams cad kyang yin no/ /gnyis pa la/ smin byed dbang bzhi/ grol byed rim pa gnyis/ bsrung bya dam tshig /nye rgyu spyod pa/ bgrod bya lam gyi rnam ga theg ste lnga las/ dang po ni/sgyu 'phrul chen mo rab sbyor bas/ /zhes sogs kyis dkyil 'khor sgrub pa bstan/sangs rgyas thams cad 'phrog pa dang / zhes pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad ces pas bum dbang bstan/ 'phrog pa dang / lha mchog las skyes bu mo spyad/ ces pas gsang dbang bstan/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug byed rig pa/ /zhes pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bstan/ de bzhin du ni zhes pas dbang bzhi pa bstan te/tshigs su bcad pa de nyid la sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin pa'i bshad pa'i don no/ /man ngag gzhan las ni/ mig 'phrul byed ces pa'i tshig kyang dbang bzhi pa ston byed du mdzad de shin tu legs so/ /gnyis pa la/ bskyed rim dang / rdzogs rim gnyis/ dang po ni/ dman pa dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor te/ 'di la yang rang bzhin dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor dang / sprul pa dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor gnyis las/dang po ni/ skad cig gam sa bon las bskyed pa tsam gyi cho ga mdor bsdus pas sgom zhing / bsgom bya'i lha yang sprul gzhi rdo rje sems dpa' nyid bsgom pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor yin la/ phyi ma ni cho ga rgyas bsdus gang yin kyang rung ste/bsgom bya lha ni he ru ka'am mkha' 'gro ma bsgom pa'o/ /'dir man ngag gzhan gyi dgongs pa ltar rang bzhin dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor la bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka'i cha yod de/ rdzogs rim gyi lha sku thams cad rang bzhin dbyibs kyi rnal —63—

'byor yin la/ bskyed rim du gtogs pa ni gong du bshad pa bzhin te/ de ltar na/ dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor la yang / dman pa dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor bskyed rim kho nar nges pa dang / mchog dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor rdzogs rim kho nar nges pa'o/ /de'i phyir bskyed rdzogs thams cad sngags dbyibs chos gsum du/'du yang dman pa dbyibs/ zab pa sngags/ mthar thug chong/ zhes bya ba gsum du mi 'du zhing / de lhar 'chad pa ni nyams su blang bya'i gtso bo gsum bsdus pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ sngon bskyed rim la goms pa zhig gis rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i tshe lha sku ched du ma bsgoms kyang rang shugs kyis 'char ba sogs rgyu mtshan du ma snang bas so zhes pa 'di rang lugs su bzung bar bya'o/ /'dir he ru ka lha lnga'i bskyed pa'i rim pa'i don cung zad bshad par bya ste/ de la chos bcu bzhi las/ dang po bla ma dag pa'i cho ga ni/ sbyang bya skye ba snga mar 'phen 'grub kyi las gsogs pa spyod zhing / sbyangs 'bras bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa mtshon/ gnyis pa tshad med bzhi bsgom pa yang yul mchog dman gyi khyad ma gtogs de dang don mthun zhing lha rnams snying rje chen por 'char bar byed/ gsum pa stong nyid bsgoms pas/ 'chi ba sbyong zhing chos sku lam du byed/rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i dus na rlung sems snying khar 'dus pa'i 'od gsal 'char bar 'gyur ba'i rgyu grung po byed cing / snang ba stong nyid du 'char ba dang /dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi cho 'phrul du shes pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /bzhi pa bsrung 'khor ni/ gtso bor bar chad bsrung ba'i ched yin la/ skye —64—

ba len pa la gegs med pa dang / bdud bzhi bcom pa mtsho ni/ lnga pa rten dang bcas pa'i 'khor gyi lha bskyed pa la/ lha'i gnas bskyed pa dang / lha dngos bskyed pa gnyis las/ dang po ni chos 'byung gi nam mkha' mtshon zhing dkyil 'khor bde stong du shes par byed/ 'byung bzhi ri rab gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa grub pa ni/ snod kyi 'jig rten dang / ye shes kyi gzhal med khang mtsho ni/ rdzogs rim gyi rten/ spyi bo rlung / mgrin pa me/ snying kha chu/ lhe ba sa/dbu ma ri rab/ padma rtsa 'khor/ rdo rje ni 'gyung ba'i khams kyi dwangs ma rnams mtshon la de'i tshe lha bskyed pa ni rdzogs rim gyi ye shes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ ma'i mngal gyi gnas dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i zhing rnam par dag pa dbus kyi padma yin la/ hri yig ni bar do'i rnam shes/ de nas byung ba'i thig le'i gong bu ni mngal du gnas pa'i khu khrag dang sprul sku dang sku rdo rje/ yig 'bru ni bar rda'i rlung sems der zhugs pa dang longs sku dang gsung rdo rje/ phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan pa ni yan lag dang dbang po rnams dod pa dang chos sku dang thugs rdo rje/ 'od zer spro bsdu ni lus 'phel ba/ zhal phyag rdzogs pa ni mngal nas btsas pa dang bde ba chen po'i sku mtshone no/ /drug pa glus bskul ba ni/ dbus kyi thig le'i gong bu khu khrag sems gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo 'byung bzhi'i nus pas 'phel ba dang tshad med bzhis gzhan don la bskul ba yin no/ /bdun pa gtso bo bskyed pa la/ sa bon ni rtsa dang srog gi rlung chags pa ste phyag mtshan man chad gong dang 'dra/ 'di'i bskyed chog ni/ sku bzhi lam du byed pa rim pa bzhi bskyed ces bya ba rim pa logs pa zhig yin la/ sgrub thabs —65—

gzhan dang gzhan las ni mngon byang lnga bskyed dang / cho ga gsum bskyed dang /'od kyi gong bu las bskyed pa dang / rgyu 'bras rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbye ba byed pa sogs mang du yod mod/ rdo rje'i tshig gcig la don du ma 'thad ldan du 'byung ba'i phyir thams cad kyang legs pa kho na ste/ 'on kyang rgyud 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i dgongs pa ni dkyus nyid yin par gsal lo/ /brgyad pa yi ge dgod pa ni mig sogs skye mched rdzogs shing lus ngag yid gsum dang rlung sems kyi stobs 'phel ba dang/ yon tan mtha' dag gis brgyan zhing rdo rje gsum gcig tu gyur pa dang sku gsum mnyam pa nyid mtshon/dgu pa ye shes pa bsre ba ni/ lo bcu drug gi mthar tshor ba dang 'du shes rdzogs pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad ye shes mnyam pa nyid du gyur pa mtshon/bcu pa dbang bskur ba ni/ rigs dang mthun pa'i las la dbang bsgyur ba dang /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur ba mtsho ni/ bcu gcig pa mchod pa dang / bcu gnyis pas bstod pa dang / bcu gsum pa bdud rtsi myangs ba gsum ni rim pas sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje gsum mnyes shing bskul ba'i ched du yin la/ 'dod pa'i yon to la longs spyod pa dang / ye shes kyi mchod pa rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba mtshon no/ /bcu bzhi pa/ dag pa dran pa ni/ de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom pa de yang gzung 'dzin can gyi snang ba las 'das te yang dag pa'i ye shes su shes pa'i ched yin la/ de dag gi mthar lhar snang la sems brtan por sgrub dgos pa yin no/ /de yang tha mal du snang ba bzlog pa'i don du lha'i rnam —66—

pa la bslab pa dang / tha mal gyi zhen pa ldog pa'i don du lha'i nga rgyal la bslab pa gnyis nges par dgos shing re zhig bskyed rim kho na bsgom pa'i tshe lhar snang dang / nga rgyal de yang yang dag pa'i ye shes su bsgyur ba'i phyir dkyil 'khor sgyu ma lta bur 'char ba las bslab dgos shing / bskyed rdzogs lhan gcig tu sgom pas ni de'i bya ba rdzogs rim gyis 'grub pa'i phyir chos kyi rnal 'byor las gzhan pa'i stong pa'i rgyas gdab mi dgos so/ /mthar dkyil 'khor nye bar bsdu ba ni/ 'du byed kyi tha ma 'jig par 'gyur ba nges par sbyong shing / sprul pa sna tshogs pa thams cad kyang chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig pas mtshon la rdzogs rim kyi skabs su 'od gsal 'char sla zhing gnas skabs 'di nyid du yang mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye ba dang / byin rlabs brtan pa'i dgos pa rnams yod do/ /de ltar bskyed rim de nyid lam gyi gtso bo yin la ngag gi zhen pa bzlog cing lha'i thugs brgyud bskul ba'i phyir bzlas pa byed pa dang / las sgrub cing bar chad zhi ba'i phyir gtor ma 'bul ba dang / zas kyi bya ba bsod nams kyi tshogs su bsgyur ba'i phyir kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang spyod pa rnam par dag pa'i phyir thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor dang / gnyid dge bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ nyal ba dang ldang ba'i rnal 'byor te/ de rnams rnal 'byor gyi yan lag yin no/ /de lta bu'i bskyed rim gzhung dang sbyar ba ni/ yid kyi padma bsam bya ba/ /sogs kyis rten gyi dkyil 'khor bstan/ gong bur song ba'i 'od de yi/ sogs la spyi don gyi bshad pa sbyar bas/ thig le'i gong bu bstan/ yi ge dang ni sngags gzugs kyi/ zhes pa'i yi ge zhes pa'i don phyogs gcig gis sa bon dang /—67—

sngags zhes pa'i don phyogs gcig gis phyag mtshan dang / gzugs zhes pas sku yongs su rdzogs pa bstan te/ de yang shar du utpal sngon po'i mdog /ces sogs kyis rgyas par bshad do/ /byin gyi rlabs pa ni/ yi ge zhes pa'i don phyogs gcig dang / khyad par skye mched byin rlabs ni/ yi ge drug dang yang dag ldan/ /zhes sogs dang / sku gsung thugs byin rlabs ni/ dang po'i sngags dang yang dag ldan/ /zhes sogs dang / dbang bskur ni/ sangs rgyas gzugs kyi nyer brgyan pa'o/ /zhes pa dang /zhu ba glus bskul dang / bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ le'u gsum par/ brgyud pa'i tha mar legs gnas pa/ /zhes pa nas rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag bskul/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis rgyas par bstan te/ 'di'i bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa zhig go /bzlas pa ni/ sngags zhes pa dang / gang zhig bsam pa tsam gyis ni/ zhes sogs dang / bzang po'i yi ge'i 'phreng ba rnams/ /zhes pa'i don phyogs gcig gis bstan/ gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ yi ge go bzlog sbyor ba yi/sogs kyis shugs la 'phangs pa yin no/ /lhag ma rnams ni bskyed rim spyi'i 'gros sbyar bar shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa rdzogs rim la/ sngags kyi rnal 'byor dang / chos kyi rnal 'byor dang / sgyu ma gsum rgyud dang 'brel ba rnams so/ /dang po la steng sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor dang / 'og sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po la yang 'khor lo sngags kyi rnal 'byor dang / thig le sngags kyi rnal 'byor dang / phra mo sngags kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po la man ngag gi dbye bas/ 'khor lo gcig la —68—

brten pa dang / 'khor lo gnyis la brten pa dang / 'khor lo bzhi la brten pa ste gsum yod kyang rdo rje'i tshig gcig gis bstan te/ ā li kā li mnyam byas te/ sogs kyis so/ /'di ni rgyud sde gzhan las gsungs pa'i gtum mo me dmigs kyi rnal 'byor ro/ gnyis pa la/ steng gi sna rtse dang 'brel ba snying khar bsgom pa dang / lus kyi dbus su bsgom pa dang / 'og gi sna rtser bsgom pa dang gsum yod la/ dang po la/ slob dpon so so'i man ngag gi dbye bas gdams ngag tha dad pa yod kyang ngo bo ni snying kha'i thig ler gcig cing / de yang /bzang po'i yi ge'i 'phreng ba rnams zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ gong bur song ba'i 'od de yi sogs la sbas don gyi bshad pa'i phyogs gcig gis bstan/gsum pa ni/ rtag tu shes rab thabs sogs kyi/ /zhes pa'i nang bshad dang /brgyad pa'i mtha' mar legs gnas pa sogs/ mkha' gsang byin rlabs ston pa'i tshig rnams nyid kyis bstan no/ /gsum pa phra mo sngags kyi rnal 'byor la/rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang 'brel ba rnams dang / bum pa can dang 'brel pa rnams so/ /dang po la man ngag mang du yod kyang ston byed kyi tshig ni/ gang zhig bsam pa tsam gyis ni/ sogs te sgra ji bzhin pas bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis kyi btsan thabs su dgag pa ni/ mig gnyis dang ni rna ba dang / /zhes sogs kyis bstan cing / sbyor bas dgag pa ni/ srogs dang rtsol ba bsdams nas su/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa 'og sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor ni/ nges pa med sogs dang / rtag tu shes rab/ sogs dang / bdud rtsi myang ba'i tshig dang /—69—

spyod pa ston pa rnams kyis kyang 'chad do/ /gnyis pa chos kyi rnal 'byor ni/gang gang dbang po'i lam las ni/ /sogs kyis gsal bar bstan zhing / shes bya gshis kyi gnas lugs 'chad pa rnams kyis kyang don gyis bstan pa yin no/ /gsum pa sgyu ma gsum rgyud kyi gdams pa dang 'brel ba bstan pa ni/ sgyu lus dang / 'od gsal gnyis su 'du zhing / dang po la yang mnyam rjes gnyis su dbye/ de nas 'od gsal chos sku'i lam dang / mnyam bzhag sgyu ma longs sku'i lam dang / rjes thob sgyu ma sprul sku'i lam ste/ ji ltar sku gsum mchog ster ba/ /zhes pas bstan no/ /rnal 'byor gnyid dang yang dag ldan/ /zhes pas gnyid kyi 'od gsal gtso bor gyur pa'i 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag bstan la/rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i sgyu lus kyi khyad chos rlung sems lha sku'i rnam par gyur pa ni/ gong bur song ba'i 'od de yi/ /zhes pa'i sbas bshad pa dang / rgyan rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /zhes pa'i don phyogs gcig dang / dpag tshad brgya'i khyon tsam du/ /'di ni rab tu snang bar byed/ /ces pa rnams kyis bstan zhing / de nyid 'jig rten pa'i lha'i mig gis mthong ba ni/ thams cad kyis ni mi mthong zhing / zhes pas bstan/ de dag gtso bor mnyam bzhag sgyu ma yin zhing / rjes thob sgyu ma ni/ stong phrag gcig tu snang bar 'gyur/ zhes pa'i tshig gis 'phangs pa yin no/ /sgyu ma de spyod pa la bltos pa ni/ gang gi shes pa'i dngos grub kyis sogs dang / phyag rgya la bltos pa ni/ rnal 'byor ma yi grub sbyor bas/ sogs so/de ltar rgyud kyis ji skad bstan pa'i tshul mdo tsam du shes nas/ de dag —70—

gi snying po cung zad tsam brjod na/ sgrub po mtha' dag gis/ mthar thug chos kyi rnal 'byor thog mtha' bar gsum gyis gnas skabs thams cad dang / 'og sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor dus skabs ci rigs par sgrub dgos pa kho na yin la/steng sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor rnam grangs mang po de dag las gang yang rung ba gcig ni nges par bsgom dgos kyang / thams cad gang zag gcig gis nges par bsgom dgos par ni ma nges te/ shin tu brtson pas ring du goms pa las ni re res kyang drod chung waṃ rtogs pa bskyes par nus te/ de nas 'og sgo'i rnal 'byor la brten te/ drod chen po dang / rtse mo'i bar du bgrod par nus pa yin no/ /des na rnal 'byor 'di rnams la lam khrigs chags kyi dbang du byas pa dang / lam blo chod kyi dbang du byas pa gnyis las/ dang po ltar na thams cad gang zag gcig gi cha rkyen du sdebs pa yin te/ de yang bskyed pa'i rim pa la cung zad brtan pa'i gang zag gis dang por rlung sbyang bar bya ba'i phyir phra mo sngags kyi rnal 'byor la cung zad bslab/ de nas thog mar thur sel gyi rlung dbang du byed pa'i phyir/ 'og gi sna rtse la gnad du bsnun pa'i sngags kyi rnal 'byor bsgom/ des gsang ba'i rtsa mdud grol ba'am lhod por song ba na/ de'i rkyen gyis snying kha'i rtsa mdud kyang 'byed par sla ba'i phyir snying khar sgom pa la bslab bo/ /de nyid steng gi sna rtse dang yang 'brel bas/ srog rlung gi bya ba byed pa'i gnas snying kha gtso bor gyur pa'i lus de yan chad kyi rtsa 'khor thams cad kyi rtsa mdud 'jig cing dag par byed do/ /de dag gis rtsa mdud grol ba'am lhod por song ba na/ rang lus la brten pa'i dga' bzhi rdzogs par bskyed pa'i —71—

phyir 'khor lo sngags kyi rnal 'byor bsgom ste/ yur ba legs par bcos nas chu 'dren pa ltar rtsa'i lam rnams byang pa na/ gtum mo la brten nas dga' bzhi 'dren pa yin no/ /des kyang khams phra mo rnams thim dka' bar gyur pa na/ thig le sngags kyi rnal 'byor lus kyi dbus su bsgoms pas khams phra rags kyi thim tshul ci rigs pa 'phral du 'byung zhing / de yan chad du 'og sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor bsgom yang rung / mi bsgom yang rung ste/ skabs 'di nyid nas 'og sgo nges par bogs 'byin dgos la/ de la brten nas lam gyi lhan skyes sems rnam par dben pa mthar phyin pa thob cing / de'i skad cig gnyis par rlung sems tsam gyi sku 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar yang / dus bzhi rab tu sbyor ba yis/ /'grub par 'gyur pa goms pa'i mchog ces dang / /rnal 'byor ma'i grub sbyor bas/ /'phral du yid ches yang dag 'jug ces so/ / gnyis pa lam blo chod ltar na/ bskyed rim la cung zad brtan pa thob pa'am bskyed rdzogs lhan cig tu bsgom yang rung ste/ rdzogs rim 'khor lo sngags kyi rnal 'byor kho na bsgoms pas thog mar nye bar rlung sems zhugs gnas thim gsum byed cing / de las gtum mo rim gyis 'bar/ ro ma las brgyud de spyi bor phyin pa na/ spyi bo'i ha yig bzhu ba'i rgyun rkyang ma nas 'bab par 'gyur la/ de nyid lte bar 'phrad pa'i bde drod khyad par can skyes pa na/rim pas dbu ma'i nang du 'bar 'dzag 'byung / des thog mar lte ba'i rtsa mdud rnams grol zhing / de nas spyi bo'i rtsa mdud grol bar 'gyur/ spyi bo grol bas —72—

mgrin pa yang bde blag tu grol zhing / lte ba dang mgrin pa grol bas mthar snying kha yang dka' ba med par grol bar 'gyur te 'bar 'dzag gi dga' bzhi yang yang drangs pas lam gyi dga' ba dang / mchog dga'am/ snang mched kyi rtogs pa skyed thub cing / de nas 'og sgos bogs phyung bas lam gyi lhan skyes skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du/ thig le sngags kyi rnal 'byor lus kyi dbus su bsgoms pas kyang sna sgo nas brtsams te/ dpral pa'i rtsa mdud lhod po byed cing / de'i rjes su gsang ba'i rtsa mdud dang / de nas 'khor lo gsum cha mnyam du lhod por 'gyur la/ mthar ro rkyang gi rgyu ba 'gag pa nas dbu mar rlung thim dmar cha 'bar te/ ro ma'i lam nas 'gro ba sogs gong bzhin rtogs pa skye'o/ /yang 'og gi sna rtse dang dbu ma'i mas snar gnad du bsnan pa las/ thog mar dmigs pa'i bye brag gi nor bu'am bde skyong 'khor lo thur sel gyis dbang byas pa'i rlung rnams bzlog cing thim par 'gyur nges rang gnas kyi rtsa mdud 'grol zhing / gtsug tor dang spyi bo'i rtsa mdud kyang lhod por 'gyur la/khyad par de dag tu rlung thim pa'i rkyen gyis dbu ma'i mas sna yongs su gang zhing rgyas par 'gyur te/ las kyi rlung gsar du grub nas/ des lte 'og sor bzhir gnas pa'i tshangs pa'i me drag tu sbar bar nus/ me rlung de nyid kyi shugs kyis lte ba'i a shad kyang cung zad 'bar bar byed mod kyi/ sngar lte bar rlung sems thim par byed pa'i rdzogs rim gzhan ma bsgoms na lte ba'i gtum mo stobs chung bas las thams cad tshangs pa'i mes byed de/ ro ma nas 'bar bas spyi bo dang gtsug tor gyi thig le ci rigs par bzhu nas rkyang ma nas babs te/ lte —73—

bar 'phrod pa lan mang du byung ba na/ lte ba'i gtum mo yang stobs rgyas te dbu mar 'bar 'dzag byed pa gong dang 'dra'o/ /de bzhin du snying khar sgom pa la yang rlung bcu po thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i gnas snying kha yin zhing / lus chags pa na yang thog mar snying kha nas chags/ 'chi ba'i tshe yang mthar rlung sems snying khar 'dus pas gang la gnad du bsnun pa'i lus kyi gnas gtso bo yin no/ /'on kyang thabs gzhan gyi 'phrul med na rtsa mdud shin tu dbye bar dka' ba yin mod kyis/ man ngag gi gnad khyad par can gyis zin pa la ni tshegs chen po mi dgos pa yin no/ /de yang dang por snying khar srog gis dbang byas pa'i rlung rnams ci rigs par log pas rtsa mdud 'grol sla bar gyur pa na rdo rje'i bzlas pa byas pas smig ma'i sbubs 'gags pa thur mas bsangs pa bzhin du rtsa'i lam yangs por gyur zhing rtsa mdud rnams kyang ltod por 'gyur ro/ /snying kha'i rtsa mdud lhod por gyur pas lte ba dang mgrin pa yang rim gyis lhod por 'gyur la/ mgrin pa'i nus pas spyi bo yang ste/ 'khor lo gzhan rnams kyi rtsa mdud lhod por gyur pa na dmigs pa gtod pa snying kha kho nar byas kyang 'khor lo gzhan rnams kyi rlung yang rang gnas su 'du ste/ thim pa la sogs pa'i rim pas gtum mo 'bar te/ des kyang snying kha'i rtsa mdud ci rigs pa 'jig la khyad par gong du bshad pa bzhin gyi 'bar 'dzag thun mong ma yin pa grub pa'i tshe/rlan dang drod dang / nam zla'i dus kyi khyad par gsum 'dzoms na me tog kha bye zhing 'bras bu smin par 'gyur ba bzhin snying kha'i rtsa mdud grol zhing rtsa rnams rgyas pas rlung dang khams kyi bgrod pa gnas der rim gyis thim par 'gyur ba —74—

yin la/ de thim pa las/ lam gyi dga' ba dang mchog dga' skye ba sogs gong bzhin no/ /spyir rang lus la brten pa'i rdzogs rim gyi gtso bo gtum mo'i me dmigs yin yang / 'dir ni 'di nyid gtso bo yin te/ slob dpon rin chen 'gyung gnas kyis kyang 'di kho na bshad do/ /'di la nyi zla kha sbyor du byed pa ni/snying kha'i thig le de nyid khams dkar dmar kha sbyor du gnas pa ma sto zhing /de'i nang du thig le phra mo sgom pa ni/ dkar dmar de'i dbus na rlung drod kyi rang bzhin can tshe srog gi ngo bo sems kyi rten phra shos gang yin pa de yin te/ 'di la 'od kyi skud pa yi ge'i 'phreng ba dang bcas pa dkris pa ni/ dbus kyi rlung gi thig le de las ro rkyang du rgyu ba'i gzung 'dzin gyi rlung rnams 'byung ba'i gzhi rlung phra mo sgra dang rtog pa bskyed par byed pas steng gi thig le'i dbus phug nas byung ste/ rlung de nyid rgyu ba'i rtsa shin tu phra ba gsum dkris rgya gram ris kyis thig le kha sbyor bcings pa'i nang du 'khor zhing rgyu ba de mtshon no/ /yang thig le dkar po ni bde ba/ dmar po ni gsal ba/ dbus kyi thig le ni stong pa/ ri mo phyed bcas bdun las bdun ni nyon yid sogs rnam shes tshogs bdun/ phyed pa ni kun gzhi rnam shes so/ /zhes phal cher 'chad la/ rje btsun mar pa'i man ngag thun mong ma yin pa las ni/ ri mo phyed bcas bdun du bshad pa man ngag gab pa ste/ don du phyed dang bdun no/ /phyed ni nyon yid ma rdzo la/ drug ni rnam shes tshogs drug nyi zla kha sbyor kun gzhi/ bzang po'i thig le ni chos nyid de/ de skyon gyis ma gos pa'i brdar dkar po/ spros pa —75—

spangs pa'i brdar zlum po/ rtogs dka' ba'i brdar cha phra ba ste/ rnam par shes pa'i tshogs bdun ni phyed dang bdun gyi rtsa la brten/ kun gzhi ni thig le kha sbyor la rten no/ /zhes gsung ste shin tu legs par mngon no/ /phra mo sngags kyi rnal 'byor la yang rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang 'brel ba rnams kyis rlung las su rung zhing rtsa mdud yang por byas nas bum pa can gyi sbyor bas thog mar dbang po'i sgo rnams kyi rlung nang du bzlog cing / rim gyis lhe bar thim par 'gyur la/des gtum mo 'bar ba la sogs pa'i bya ba byed do/ /de ltar na 'og sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor ni thams cad 'brel bar 'byung mod kyi/ de gcig pus lam rdzogs pa ltar bshad pa rnams ni/ de nyid kyang rlung sbyang ba sogs sngon 'gro gzhan la bltos pa yin pa'i phyir/ steng sgo'i rdzogs rim la gtan nas ma brten pa mi srid pas rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa rdzogs par bskyed pa la steng sgo dang 'og sgo'i rnal 'byor gnyis ka dgos kyi/ ya gyal ba re res chog pa ni ma yin no/ /de la phyag rgya srog rtsol du 'gro ba'i gnad thams cad ni spyi dang 'dra par shes par bya'o/ /de dag bsgom pa'i gnas skabs su sgyu ma gsum rgyud kyi gdams pa bsgoms kyang rung ma bsgoms kyang rung ste/ lam gyi dga' ba'i rtog pa nam skyes pa'i tshe/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal rang shugs kyi bsgom par nus shing /de nyid rje bzang du 'gyur la rmi lam dang thun mtshams thams cad du lha sku'i snang ba ci rigs pa 'byung zhing / lha sku shar rung ma shar rung / snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i sgyu lus 'khor yug tu 'byung ngo / /rlung sems tsam gyi sku grub pa phan chad nas rmi lam yang mnyam bzhag sgyu ma kho nar 'byung la/ rjes thob thams cad du —76—

lha sku'i snang ba dang mi 'bral ba yin no/ /de la da lta las dang po pa rnams kyis sgyu ma gsum rgyud kyi gdams ngag bsgoms na/ lam gyi dga' ba'i rtogs pa ma skyes gong du yang de rnams rjes mthun pa rgyud la skye bar 'gyur zhing / khyad par dngos gzhi de dag skye ba la shin tu myur ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i seng lam du grags so/ /de la snyu ma gsum ni/ sad dus sgyu ma dang / rmi lam sgyu ma dang /bar do sgyu ma'o/ /de dang 'brel ba la bsre ba gsum gsum dgu ste/ 'od gsal chos sku dang bsre/ de bzhin du/ mnyam bzhag sgyu ma longs sku/ rjes thob sgyu ma sprul sku/ gnyid 'thug chos sku/ rmi lam longs sku/ gnyid sad sprul sku/ 'chi ba chos sku/ bar do longs sku/ skye ba sprul sku dang bsre ba'o/ /yang 'od gsal chos sku/ rmi lam longs sku/ sgyu lus sprul sku dang bsre ba ste gsum du yang mdzad la/bsre ba'i don ni lam du byed pa'o/ /'di dag gi don rgyas par gzhan du bshad par bya'o/ /gsum pa dam tshig la bza' ba'i dam tshig dang / bsrung ba'i dam tshig gnyis las/ dang po rgyun gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig ni/ kha zas bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas bza' ba yin la/ mchog gi bza' ba'i dam tshig ni bdud rtsi ril bu brten pa ste/ de dag kyang dam tshig chen po'i dngos grub ni/ /ri lu chen po sgrub par bya/ /zhes dang / mthe bong dang ni sogs dang / dam tshig sgrub pa'i dam pa ste/ /zhes pa nas/ 'di ni rgyud 'dir gsungs kyi gzhan du sbas/zhes pa'i bar rnams kyis rgyas par bshad cing / yi ge go bzlog sbyor ba sogs kyi byin rlabs kyang bstan la/ spyod pa ston pa'i tshig rnams kyi zhor byung la yang —77—

ci rigs par yod do/ /mchod pa'i dam tshig gi bza' ba tshogs kyi 'khor lo ni/rnal 'byor dpa' chen rtag rol te/ /zhes dang / nyin re bzla ba btung ba'o/ /zhes pas bstan zhing / gzhan yang ci rigs par sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyud 'dir rgyas par ma gsungs kyang / de ltar rtag tu gus ldan pas/ /zhes pas zur gyis 'phangs pa yin no/ /de yang rtsa ba'i lhung ba bcu bzhi po rnams phal cher thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu ma gus pa las byung ba yin pas/ de'i gnyen po bstan pa'i phyir dam tshig bsrung tshul khyad par can yin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ 'ga' zhig rgyud 'di'i lugs la spyod pa'i rnam gzhag mi dgos par 'dod pa'ang byung mod kyi/ spros bcas kho na la bsams na ni rung yang srid kyi/ spyir spyod pa ma spyad par 'bras bu mchog la sbyor nus pa ni mi srid do/ /yang kha cig rgyud 'di las spyod pa ma bstan par 'dod pa yang rgyud don mi shes pa'i rnam 'gyur ro/ /des na spyir 'og sgo'i rdzogs rim ston byed thams cad kyang spyod pa'i phyogs su dgos shing / khyad par rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams dang / rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs su ni/ /rnal 'byor bdag nyid ston par byed/ /ces pas spros bcas kyi spyod pa bstan/ 'dod pa kun la nyer spyod pa/ /sogs tshigs rkang gsum gyis spros med kyi spyod pa bstan/ rnal 'byor gnyid dang yang dag ldan zhes pas shin tu spros med kyang shugs la 'phangs/ sgyu 'phrul chen po rab sbyor ba/ /sogs dang / rgyan rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /sogs kyis spros bcas spros med kyi cha lugs bsgyur ba dang / cho ga'i rim pa bstan/ rtag tu sems can don byed pa'o/ /nas —78—

rnal 'byor ma dang lhan cig sbyar gyi bar gyis spyod pa'i bya ba rnams bstan/ man ngag gzhan las ni/ phyogs las rnam rgyal sogs spyod pa gsum gyi rnam gzhag dus dang bcas pa'ang bstan par bzhed pas/ spyod pa ston byed kyi gzhung tshig nyung yang don shin tu rgyas so/ /lnga pa ni/ dkyus kyi rgyud bshad dang / man ngag na gsal bar mi bzhugs pas/ dpal he ru ka'i gnas brnyes pa rtsod pa'i dus kyi 'gro ba mtha' dag gi skyabs gcig pu 'phags yul lto phyogs kyi rgyud du byon pa grub chen zhi ba sbas pa'i man ngag mdo tsam brjod na/ rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa skyes kyang rung / ma skyes kyang rung / bskyed rim la brtan pa thob na tshogs lam bgrod pa yin zhing / bskyed rim ma bsgoms par rdzogs rim gyis tshogs lam dang / drod 'bring tsam bgrod pa'ang yod mod/ drod chen po thob pa la ni rim pa gnyis ka sgom dgos pa kho na yin no/ /zhes pa 'di ni/ theg pa bla na med par nges pa'i tshig go /de la lha dang nor bdag dri za dang / /sogs dang / las dang grub pa chung ngu rnams kyis/ tshogs lam gyi yon tan gtso bor bstan par mngon la/khyad par drod ni/ rnal 'byor ma yi grub sbyor bas/ /'phral du yid ches yang dag 'jug /ces pas bstan/ rtse mo ni/ thams cad kyis ni mi mthong zhing / /sogs kyis bstan/ bzod pa ni/ de phyir ye shes 'di gsang zhing / /mi gsal yi ge med pa'o/ /zhes pas bstan te/ go rim bzhin nus pa rnyed pa dang / ye shes kyi lha 'grub pa dang / rang bzhin brgyad bcu'i rnam rtog gsal po 'gags pa rnams so/ /chos mchog ni dus bzhi rab tu sbyor ba yis/ nas sgo dgu las ni —79—

byung ba'i rdzas kyi bar la/ mthar thug gi bshad pas/ mthong lam gyi mngon byang dang / mthar thug gi mngon byang gnyis ka ston pa'i dang po de'i sbyor bas shugs la bstan no/ /tshe ring brtson 'grus chen po dang / /sogs kyis/ gsang spyod kyi phan yon dang / lha'i mig dang / sogs kyis/ smyon pa'i spyod pa'i 'bras bu dang /de yi tshe ni sogs kyis/ kun bzang gi spyod pa'i phan yon bstan/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi dpal/ /sogs kyis phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa'i phan yon bstan la/ de ltar rgyun du sogs spyod pa'i dus kyi khyad par ro/ /grub pa kun las 'phrog pa dang nas/ /rol mo las byung mkhyen gyi bar dang / rnal 'byor ma kun sbyor ba'i ma/ /zhes pa nas/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug byed rig pa/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi sgra ji bzhin pa'i bshad pas/ zung 'jug thob pa'i yon tan rnams bstan te/ phan yon gzhan rnams ni/ bskyed rim dang / stong nyid rtogs pa sogs thams cad kyi phan yon yin no/ /gsum pa 'bras rgyud kyi rnam par bzhag pa ni/ 'bras rgyud dngos/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang yin la/ thun mong gi dngos grub dang las tshogs ni/ 'bras rgyud dngos ma yin yang / de'i phyogs mthun yin pas/ 'dir bshad do/ /de la dngos grub phra mo de dag dang / las tshogs rnams ni ngo bo thabs rgyud yin te/ sgrub pa po'i bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs par byed pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'bras rgyud dang phyogs mthun pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir dang / rang nyid 'bad rtsol dang bral/ bde ba'i go 'phang gi gnas thob cing / dka' ba med par sems can gyi don 'grub —80—

pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la dbye na/ 'bras bu chung ngu las tshogs brgyad/'bring po thun mong gi dngos grub brgyad/ wo po mchog gi dngos grub bo/ /dang po ni/ rmongs pa dang ni rengs pa dang / /gsad dang bskrad pa la sogs dang / /dbang dang dgug pa'i las rnams dang / /zhes drug dang / zhe 'gras pa dang rmugs pa nyid/ /ces pa ste brgyad do/ /go cha drug gi las tshogs rnams kyang dbang dang dgug pa'i las gnyis su phal cher 'dus shing / cha shas 'ga' zhig ni gsad par bsdu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ mig 'phrul byed ces dang / nam mkhar 'gro ba nyid kyang ngo / /gzhan gyi grong sogs bya ba dang / /mi snang ba dang gang yang rung / /zhes dang / de bzhin sa 'og 'gro ba'o/ /rig 'dzin 'khor lo bsgyur nyid 'gyur/ /'chi ba med cing rgas pa med/ /rnal 'byor sgyu ma'i rig pa yin/ /'di yis na ba med par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i rgas pa med pa dang / na ba med pa gcig du bsdoms nas/nad 'joms kyi dngos grub zhes bya ste/ de ltar brgyad do/ /gsum pa ni/ ngo bo sku bzhi dang / khyad chos ye shes lnga las/ dang po ni/ ji ltar sku gsum mchog ster ba/ /zhes dang / zab mo sangs rgyas bstan pa'o/ /zhes pas spyir bstan cing / sangs rgyas byang chub gnas zhi ba/ /zhes pas ces sku dang / de nyid bla na med pa 'grub/ /ces pas ngo bo nyid sku dang / rgyan rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /sogs la mthar thug gi bshad pas longs sku dang / ga dma'i bye snyed sangs rgyas rnams/ /zhes pas sprul pa'i sku dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang /zhes sogs kyis/ dbye gzhi bde chen gyi sku yang bstan pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/—81—

rang byung ye shes lnga ldan 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang / sems dang sems med sems rang bzhin/ /sogs kyis bstan zhing 'dir 'phrin las ni lam lnga'i phan yon ston byed thams cad kyis rgyas par bshad par yang 'gyur zhing / cho ga'i thabs ni rnam pa sna tshogs bstan pa ni/ lha mo yid la 'dod pa rnams ni gsungs pa'o/ /zhes pas kyang bstan/ 'bras bu'i rgyud 'di ni/ phyag 'tshal gyis kyang bstan to/ tshig rkang dang po gsum gyis sku gsum ye shes lnga dang / lhag mas 'phrin las gsal bar bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir ni bshad pa'i sgo de tsam bstan par zad kyi lam spyi dang khyad par gyi mtha' dpyod pa rgyas pa bla ma'i zhal lung thob pas rtogs par bya dgos so/ /da ni de ltar bshad pa de rnams su lung dang rig pas grub pa'i mtha' cung zad brjod par bya ste/ oṃ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par shes pa'i yul yin phyir/ /dngos po thams cad rang bzhin med/ /dngos po yod pa mi srid phyir/ /dngos med ces bya ga la yod/ /tha snyad pa yi tshad ma las/ /snang ba'i dngos po yod min na/ /rtog pas btags pa tsam zhig gi /mi snang dngos med lta ci smos/ /dngos dang dngos med las grol ba'i/ /gnyis med ye shes rtag tu yod/ /nam yang 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir/ /'di ni rtag cing brtan pa yin/ /ye shes kho nas myong ba'i phyir/ /don dam yin par rgyal bas gsungs/ /rnam shes bslu bar mi byed pas/ /gsog gsob brdzun pa ma yin no/ /yul dang dus kyis ma bsdus shing / /sgra dang rtog pa'i yul min la/ /gnyen pos mi 'dzems nges 'byin min/ /kun rdzob shes pas ma myong zhing / /—82—

dpyad pa'i yul du ma gyur ba'o/ /de ltar rdzun par 'jog pa yin/ khyad chos brgyad dang bral ba'i phyir/ /'di ni bden pa kho na yin/ /spros pa'i mtshan ma brgyad spangs pas/ /spros pa med cing mtshan ma med/ ti nyes bya gzhis kyi gnas lugs 'di/ /blo 'das brjod bral zhes su brtags/ /rgyu rgyud thabs rgyud 'bras rgyud ces bya ba/ /don dam dbang du gsum po ngo bo gcig khres bya gshis kyi gnas lugs kho na yin/ /kun rdzob kyi ni gsum po tha dad do/ /gzhi yi gshis dang lam gyi chos nyid dang / /'bras bu dam pa'i don gyi sangs rgyas gsum/ /chos can dbang gi ming 'dogs tha dad tsam/ /ngo bo gcig cing gnas skabs dbye ba'ang med/ /sna tshogs 'khor ba'i chos kyi rgyu rgyud dang / /nyams len byed tshul nyams myong thabs kyi rgyud/ /gsal thob gzhan ngor snang ba'i 'bras rgyud de/ /gsum po 'di dag kun rdzob kho na yin/ /chos nyid gsal dang stong dang bde ba'i phyir/ /lam yang lha sku stong nyid bde ba sgom/ /de ltar bsgoms pas chos nyid de lta bu'i/ /dri ma dag ste mngon gyur 'bras bu yin/ /sgyu ma'i rgyal pos sgyu ma'i rgyal po gzhan/ /'joms pa'i dpe yis yang yang gsungs pa ltar/ /sbyang bya kun rdzob sbyong byed kun rdzob ste/ /'bras bu thob par brtags pa'ang kun rdzob yin/ /rang bzhin rnam dag don dam yin pa'i phyir/ /rnam dag de la rnam par dag pa sa /rang ngo shes pa'i dag pa gnyis ldan kyang / /don dam kho na yin gyi kun rdzob min/ /rnam par rtog pas btags pa'i lha sku dang / /blos byas stong nyid zhu bde'i lhan skyes rnams/ /ye shes rtogs pa'i thabs su brten dgos mod/ zhan tu nye ba'i thabs kyang ma yin no/ /sgyu —83—
