dpe'o/ /rgyud so rbe'i dgongs pas rtags dang rtags can gnyis kar yod pas phan tshun du kha bskang ste/ gnyis pa 'gal med du bya'o/ /rgyud 'di nyid kyi dgongs pa la rtags can gtso che bar bla ma rnams bzhed de/ yon tan brgyad ni/sa'i yon tan stobs che ba dang / chu'i yon tan dbyibs mdzes shing nyams bde ba dang / me'i yon tan drod dang kha dog gzi brjid che ba dang / rlung gi yon tan yang zhing shugs 'gyogs pa dang / nyi ma'i yon tan ci rigs par sprul pa byed pa dang / zla ba'i yon tan rab tu dwangs pa'i lus dang / nam mkha'i yon tan mi snang ba dang / rnam par shes pa'i yon tan ting nge 'dzin bde ba dang bcas shing mngon shes ci rigs pa 'byung ba'o/ /rtags lnga ni spyod pa'i sngon du thob pa nges par dgos la/ yon to brgyad ni spyod pas 'grub pa'o/ /rdo rje 'od kyis padma rab tu phye ba ni/ snying khas nye ba dang / mgrin pas spyi bo 'byed pa'o/ /ji lhar nyi ma'i 'od kyi sogs ni/ lte ba'i me 'od kyi ha yig gi gnas rtsa kha dbye ba ste/ a la la la la ho/ zhes yi ge drug lan gnyis ni/ 'khor lo bzhi dang dbu ma'i yas sna dang mas sna rnams su rlung thim pa'i ye shes dang / thig le 'bab pa'i ye shes de 'byung ba ston la thams cad las kyang ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams dpag tu med pa 'byung ba ni/ bde ba chen po rab tu rgyas pa'i gar ro/ /glu tsam gyis zhes pa ni/ rlung dbu mar thim pa tsam gyis zhes pa'i don no/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang ni bde ba dang lha sku sna tshogs pa spros bral du ro mnyam pa'i rdo rje 'chang gi dbugs dbyung yin la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams gar zhes pa ni/ mkha' 'gro ma lnga ni sangs rgyas lnga'i bdag nyid de/ bde ba dang lha sku'i ting nge 'dzin de —188—

bzhin gshegs pa'i dbugs dbyung ba'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag bskul/ /zhes bya ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbugs dbyung de la brten nas rdo rje 'chang gi dbugs dbyung thob pa ni/ zung du 'jug pa ste bskul ba ni thob par byed pa'i don no/ /gsum pa ni/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ni spyod pa'i dus kyi phyag rgya ste/ dpal rdo rje'i glu ni sred kyi yi ge la sogs pa dga' ba'i sgra'o/ /sred pa ni 'dod chags chen po ste lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'o/ /gnyen mchog ces bya ba ni/ sgrub pa po dang phyag rgya gnyis kar yang dngos grub la nye bar gyur ba'i sbun dang sring mo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rdo rje'i 'od ni byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer te/ des rtsa 'khor lo rnams kyi padma'i 'dab ma rnams rab tu sad par mjodi la/ de las ye shes ci zhig skye na/ la yig bzhi ni dga' ba bzhi yin la/ a ni stong pa nyid/ ho ni dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor rab tu gsal ba ste dbugs dbyung de gnyis kyi dga' ba bzhi la rgyas btab pa'i brdar yi ge de gnyis thog mthar bkod do/ /bde ba chen po rab tu rgyas pa zhes pa ni dga' bzhi rdzogs par bskyed thub pa'o/ /gar ni 'dod chags chen po'i gar te/ sbyor ba drug cu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa'o/ /nyi ma'i 'od ni byang chub kyi sems dmar cha rdul las skyes pa'i chags chen te/ de'i mthu las gsang ba'i chos 'byung la sogs pa rtsa rnams padma rgyas pa ltar kha bye ba'o/ /lhag ma gong bzhin te/ lan gnyis su bzlos pa ni/ dgyes rdor las/ re shig btsun mo shes rab ste/ /skyes bu thabs su brjod par bya/ /kun rdzob don dam dbye ba las/ /phyi nas de yi rnam pa gnyis/ /re shig skyes bu rnam pa gnyis/ /de yi khu —189—

ba'am bde ba nyid/ /skyes bu ji bzhin shes rab la'ang / /de yi khu ba'am bde ba nyid/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar zhu bde'i lhan cig skyes pa de nyid rgya cher spel te/ rtsal sbyang ba'i don du a ralbi'i bya ba rnams rtsom pa ste/ de yang rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang zhes pa ni/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi chas su zhugs te/ sems can rnams la bde bas byin gyis brlob pa'i don du glu dang gar la sogs pa rol pa rgya chen po spyod pa ste/ rdo rje 'chang gi dbugs dbyung gi dkyil 'khor yin la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams zhes pa ni/ sgrub pa po he ru ka dang / phyag rgya lnga mkha' 'gro lnga'i chas su zhugs te/ las bzhi sogs sgrub pa'i don du/ glu dang gar gyi rol pa byed pa he ru ka'i dbugs dbyung gi dkyil 'khor ro/ /rgyud sde gzhan 'ga' las gzhan yang gsungs kyang 'dir rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor la gtso bo yab yum kho na bshad pa dang /sangs rgyas rigs gzhan bzhi po'i dkyil 'khor ma gsungs te/ he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor kho na bstan la/ 'khor ba thog mar legs par sbyangs ba cung zad ma tshang na ye shes phab pa dang / dbang bskur te gzhug pa yin la/ de'i man ngag ni/ mi ro'i khar zhag bdun gzhag pa'i gu gul la dngos grub phab nas/dur khrod kyi me la bsreg pa/ zla mtshan gyi ras dang / byi la nag po'i brun gyis bdug par bcas pa'o/ /gal te 'khor lhag por yod na mchod pa'i gzung mar sbyor ba ni 'di nyid kyi rang lugs so/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag bskul/ /zhes bya ba ni/ lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul ba'i mchog mthar thug pa ni spyod pa yin par dgongs pa ste/ dpal gsang ba grub pa las kyang / /rkang rkyang bya ba —190—

spangs nas su/ /'khor ba'i mngag gzhug dor nas ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /yang dang yang du bskul bar bya/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ de nas 'dir rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi nges pa'i don gyi glu yang dag par blangs pa'o/ /rdo rje ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid rgyal ba rigs lnga ste/bdag nyid la snang ba'i chos thams cad rigs lnga'i ngo bor shar ba ni/ chos thams cad rigs lngar sbyor ba'i ngang tshul can yin pa'i phyir rnal 'byor ro/ /dgongs pa ni mnyam par bzhag pa'i rtogs pa'o/ /de yang ci zhig ce na/dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen pos 'gro ba grol bar bzhed de/ dpal ni bsod nams te thabs dang / rdo rje ni shes rab ste ye shes so/ /glu ni thabs dang shes rab de dag 'gro ba la ston par dgongs pa ste/ de yang srid pa sgrub pa'i sgo nas zhes pa la/ srid pa ni gzugs kyi sku gnyis so/ khren tu sgrub pa ni/srid pa dang zhi ba'i mtha' rab tu gnon pa zhes pa'i don du bshad la/ rdo rje ni bde ba chen po ste/ byang chub kyi sems g.yo med du bcings pa'i bde bas padma stong pa nyid sad par byed pa dang / nyi ma'i 'od kyis sogs la rang gi lus la dmar cha yang yongs su bcings pas stong nyid rtogs pa'i thabs dam par 'gyur ba bzhin byang chub kyi sems bcings pas kyang ngo / /de ltar rlung 'gags shing thig le bcings pa las byung ba'i mi 'gyur ba'i dga' bzhi dang /stong pa dang lha sku rnams zung du 'jug pa ni/ a la la la la ho zhes pas bstan te/ rang gzhan gyi phun sum tshogs pa rgya cher 'byung ba ni rab tu dgyes pa'i gar te/ rang gzhan gyi dbye bas lan gnyis su bstan no/ /gzhan yang de nas —191—

bshad par bya ba glu yi sgras chos ston pa dang / gar gyi sgras ni sprul pa sna tshogs pa ste/ rgyud gcig kyang tha dad par snang ba gar mkhan gyi rol ba bzhin du sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ /yang dag bskul zhes bya ba ni/ glu dang gar de lta bu la tshad med bzhi'i rang bzhin lha mo bzhis bskul bar byed pa'o/ /su zhig bskul zhe na/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams zhes pa ste dpe med pa'i bde ba chen po'i sku'o/ /sku gsum dang / ngo bo nyid sku'i dbye gzhi bde ba chen po'i sku mdzad pa ni rgyud 'di'i dgongs pa yin te/ slob dpon sto pas kyang / rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che/ /lha rdzas btsun mo dang 'dus pa/ /de las chos dang sprul pa dang / /ngo bo nyid dang longs spyod rdzogs/ /bskyed dang bsdud par byed pa yin/ zhes gsungs pas so/ /zhes pa ni man ngag gzhan no/ /de la rdo rje zhes pa ni/ bla na med pa'i ye shes te/ rang bzhin med pa'i yan lag go /de nyid 'dzin pa wo po ni/ snying rje rṣa pos stong nyid yongs su bzung ba las/ rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / 'gog pa med pa shugs la bstan pa'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams zhes pas kha sbyor bstan pas/ bde ba chen po dang / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i yan lag kyang don gyis 'phangs so/ /de ltar na zhu ba ni bskyed rim gyi gnas skabs su thig le'i 'od kyi gong bu dang / rdzogs rim gyi skabs thig le byang chub kyi sems dang / 'bras bu'i skabs su bde stong dbyer med yang dag pa'i mtha'o/ /glus bskul ba ni/ lha skur bzhengs pa'i don dang / thig le 'bar 'dzag 'gro 'ong gi don dang / gzhan don du gzugs skur bzhengs pa'i don gsum la bskul ba'o/ /—192—

bdun pa la/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi bshad pa bzhi las/ dang po ni/ de ltar rtag tu gus pa'i sgo nas dam tshig la yang dag par gnas pa dang ldan pas sbyor ba rnal 'byor gyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ba nyid yin la/ de la gus pa ni/ lha dang bla ma la gus pa dang / gzhi'i chos la gus pa dang / dam tshig gi rdzas la gus pa dang / chos la gus pa dang / skye bo dam pa la sogs pa sems can rnams la gus pa ste lnga yin la/ thams cad kyang bslab pa dang dam tshig la gus par 'dus so/ /'di rnams gyis sngags kyi dam tshig mtha' dag bsrung ba nus pa yin te/ chos la gus pas lung gi chos mi sbong ste grub mtha' med mod/ chos la gces spras kyis snod min la mi 'chad lam nyams len mi spong zhing / sgrub pa'i chos mi spong bas sangs rgyas kyi bka' las mi 'da' zhing de gnyis kyis theg pa gsum las tshig 'dzin pa dang / don nyams su len pa shugs la 'byung ngo / rtsa ltung lhag ma rnams kyang slob dpon dang / sems dang dam tshig gi rdzas dang / gzhi'i chos la smad par 'dus shing de rnams la gus pas de dag spong la khyad par du bsten par bya ba dam rdzas rgya las rigs lngar shes pa dang / gzhi'i chos nyon mongs pa lnga'i rang bzhin ye shes su shes pa dang /'gro ba rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs rdo rjer shes pas bsgrub par bya ba'i dam tshig rnams kyang 'grub pa yin no/ /de skad du/ rdo rje snying po rgyan sogs/ rgyud sde du ma las gsungs pa/ grol ba'i thig ler lung drangs pa/'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang / /sred dang 'du byed 'phel ba yi/ chos lnga skyes mchog rnams kyis gsungs/ /bshang gci khu ba mchi ma khrag /'dzag pa — 193—

'byung ba bzhi bsdus pa/ /bsgom pa'i blo gros rtogs pa yis/ /rtag tu bza' zhing spyin bsreg bya/ /zhes dang / rdo rje lus can dam tshig pas/ /las byung skyes pa bud med kyi/ /du ma'i gzugs la brnyas mi bya/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /de ltar dam tshig la gnas nas nyin re bzhin du thun bzhir dmigs pa la rab tu sbyor ba yis dngos grub 'grub pa la shin tu nye bar byed par 'gyur bas na goms par bya ba'i mchog go /de las ci zhig 'byung na rgyan te mngon shes rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dang / spos dang me tog gi brdas bstan pa byang chub kyi lam yan lag bdun rnams te/ de la 'jug cing brgyan par 'gyur ro/ /de'i rjes thogs nyid du 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sku gsum mchog dngos su ster ba ste/ de'i nye ba'i rgyu 'phags pa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur la/ ji ltar zhes pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsum ji lta ba ste rnam pa 'dra ba sa dang po nas thob pa'i don no/ /de lta bu'i mchog gi dngos grub nges par thob par 'gyur la/de thob na dpag tshad brgya'i khyon ni mtshon pa tsam ste/ dpag tu med ci pa'i zhing du dpag tu med pa'i sku'i sprul pa bskyed pa dang / gsung gi chos ston pa dang /thugs kyi ye shes kyi snang bas sku 'di ni rab tu gsal zhing snang bar byed do/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub phal pa ni mthong lam nas thob cing / gtso bo ni sangs rgyas nyid do/ /sangs rgyas dang mthun pa'i sku gsum po de yang 'di lta ste/chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa ni chos sku dang / mawo dpe rjes mthun pa'i ye shes kyi sku ni longs sku dang / sprul pa sna tshogs pas sems can gyi don byed pa sprul sku'o/ /lam de dag gi sbyor ba'i rtsa ba yang dad pa dang shes rab kyi —194—

dbang po gnyis ni mnyam par sbyor bas spyod pa dang / lta ba dag par 'gyur la/dam pa'i chos ston pa'i sgo gsung rab yan lag dgu las ni gang byung ba'i don rnams kyang sgrub par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar rtag tu lam la gus sbyor gyi brtson 'grus dang ldan pas bsgrubs na sbyor ba ni dngos grub ste nyams len 'bras bu dang bcas par 'gyur ba nyid yin la/ dga' bzhi'i rtogs pa skyes pa'i dus bzhi la sems rtse gcig tu rab tu spyor ba'i goms pa mchog gis tshe 'di nyid la dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur ba'o/ /de yang dga' ba gsum pa'i mthar rlud sems tsam gyi sku 'grub pa ni rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing dpag tshad brgya stong mang po'i khyon tsam du 'di'i 'od zer ni khyab cing snang bar byed la/ de grub tsam nyid na spos dang me tog la sogs pas rnam par brgyan pa mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po rang byung du 'byung ste/ rim lnga las/ gtso bo bde ba kun rang bzhin/ /sems pa chen po 'gro dang bzhugs/ /gnas dang zas dang gos la sogs/ /mkha' las skad cig dag gis rnyed/ /ces sku 'di 'gru/ba pa na nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rigs zhig thob par bshad do/ /ji ltar sku gsum mchog ster ba/ /zhes pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gsal ba sprul sku dang /rlung sems thig le dgags pa'i bde ba longs sku dang / stong nyid rnam par mi rtogs pas chos sku ster ba'o/ /dbang po gnyis ni rtsa dang khams te der rlung sems bsdud pa'i tshul gyis mnyam par sbyor ba dang / sgo dgu nas 'byung ba'i rlung rnams 'gags pa las ye shes de skye bar 'gyur ro/ /—195—

gsum pa ni de ltar rab tu gus pa'i rig ma dang ldan pas sbyor ba'i dngos grub tu 'gyur ba yin la/ de las ye shes bzang po skyes na/ spyod pa bya ste/dus bzhi ni thun tshod bzhi dang dga' ba bzhi yang ste thun bzhir dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes ring du goms par byas shing de nyid rgya cher spel ba'i cho ga'i rol pa la rab tu sbyar ba yis goms pa mchog las 'dod pa'i dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur ba'o/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i lha'i cha lugs su yongs su zhugs shing / spos dang / me tog la sogs pa mchod pa dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i yo byad thams cad kyis yongs su brgyan nas khyad par gyi dam tshig sgo dgu las byung ba'i rdzas mi spang ba dang / thun bzhir thabs dang shes rab kyi dbang po gnyis mnyam par sbyor ba ste/ de ltar yang dpal 'dus pa las/ dus bzhir ji ltar cho ga bzhin/ /rdo rje mo ni nyin rer sbyangs/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de ni spros bcas te spros med la ni rgyan dang cha byad dang / mchod pa'i yo byad rdzogs par med na ci rigs pas chog go khren tu spros med la ni yid kyi phyag rgya kho na dang / gnyid dang bsam gtan bsre ba'o/ de lta bu'i spyod pa des ni/ sgyu lus ma grub pa 'grub par byed/ 'od gsal ma thob par thob par byed/ zung 'jug 'grub nas kyang 'bras bu la mtshams sbyor bar byed pa'i phyir sngar sangs rgyas pa rnams kyi sku gsum ji lta ba de lta bu'i mchog ster ba'i dngos grub nges par thob par 'gyur ba'o/ /'dir nag po pas bogs 'byin du gyur pa'i phyag rgya'i lam las mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba sgrub tshul spyir bshad pas/ bye brag spyod pa ston pa la yang mi 'gal mod kyi/ rgyan rnams zhes sogs kyi cha lugs dang — 196—

mchod pa'i khyad par ni spyod pa kho na la ched cher dgos pa'i phyir tshig rkang dang po gnyis ma gtogs spyod pa/ 'bras bu dang bcas pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /man ngag gzhan las ni/ de'i tshe phyag rgya'i gzugs la lta ba'i bde ba bsgoms pas mig tu rgyu ba'i rlung dbu mar 'gag pa ste/ mig shes bde ba chen por 'gyur ba sogs sgo dgu las ni gang byung ba zhes pa'i don dang / dbang po gnyis ni sogs rig ma dang mnyam par sbyar bas nang gi bde ba chen pos rtsa mdud zhig cing rtsa khams rlung rnams dag par byed pa'i don no/ /zhes gsungs ngo / /bzhi pa ni/ rtag tu lam la gus pa dang ldan pas bsgoms na dngos grub myur du thob pa ni/ sbyor lam bzod pa mthar phyin pa na sangs rgyas sprul sku rnams kyis dbang bskur bas mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa 'byung ste/ dus bzhi ni dga' ba bzhi dang stong pa bzhi yin la/ de'i dang po gsum ni sbyor lam chos mchog yin zhing / bzhi pa ni mthong lam mo/ de nas phyag rgya chen po rdo rje 'chang 'grub par 'gyur ba'i don du bsgom lam gyi goms pa mchog tu bya'o/ /ci zhig goms par byed ce na/ zung 'jug gi sku rgyan dang mchod pa yongs su rdzogs pa thob pa de nyid thugs lhan skyes kyi bde ba'i dbang po dang / sku 'ja' lus gyi dbang po ngo bo gcig tu mnyam par sbyor ba de nyid goms par byas pas sgo dgu ste/ sa dang po nas dgu pa'i bar la gang 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang yon tan gyi khyad par rnams thob cing goms par byed do/ /zung 'jug de nyid la sku gsum mchog ster ba'i dngos grub ces bya ste/ 'od gsal rtog med kyi — 197—

chos sku dang / 'ja' lus zag med kyi longs sku dang / rjes thob tu dkyil 'khor spro bsdu dang mchod pas sprul sku ster bar byed pas so/ /yang de rnams nyid mngon byang phyi ma la sbyar na/ dpag tshad brgya'i sogs dang rgyan rnams sogs kyis longs sku dngos bstan zhing / dbang po gnyis ni zhes pa kha sbyor gyi yan lag dang / sgo dgu ni rigs lnga yum bzhi'i dkyil 'khor sprul pa dang / sku gsum ni sgra ji bzhin pa ste/ de dag thob bya la sbyar nas thob byed lam ni sa bcu pa'i tha mar sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dbang bzhi bskur bas dga' ba bzhi dang stong pa bzhi'i rang bzhin mngon par byang chub par dang po bzhi ni dus bzhi sogs kyis bstan la/ mngon byang lnga pa ni 'bras bu nyid do/ /de ltar na/ ji ltar sku gsum mchog ster ba'i zhes pa la/ don bzhin bshad pa rnams dril bas sgyu ma gsum rgyud kyi man ngag legs par thon pa'o/ /brgyad pa ni/ bshad ma thag pa de rnams kyi 'bras bu ste/ de yang 'bras bu'i gtso bo bshad pa'o/ /de la sangs rgyas byang chub gnas zhi ba/ zhes pa ni chos kyi sku ste/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sangs rgyas pa'am byang chub pa ni sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa sangs shing byang la chos thams cad la ye shes kyi snang ba rgyas shing chub pa ste/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub gnyis smos pas/ dang po ji lta ba'i don la sangs shing rgyas pa dang / gnyis pa ji snyed pa'i chos la byang zhing chub pa'o/ /gnas zhes bya ba ni bag chags rnam par dag pa'i dbyings dang rang bzhin no/ /zhi ba zhes pa ni spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'o/ /des ni sems kyi rang bzhin spros bral des ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i chos thams cad —198—

sgrib med du rtogs pa ni chos sku'o/ /de nyid bla na med pa 'grub/ ces pa ni ngo bo nyid sku ste/ chos sku dang ngo bo gcig kyang rtogs byed chos sku de'i rtogs bya'i cha nas bzhag pa'o/ /de kho na nyid ni chos rnams kyi gnas lugs de bzhin nyid ste bla na med pa ni gdod nas grub pa'i yon tan thams cad kyis nye bar brgyan pa'o/ /'di ni 'gyur ba med pa'i yongs grub ste/ chos kyi sku yang phyin ci ma log pa'i yongs grub don dam pa'o/ /yongs grub dang don dam par btags pa gzhan ni lam gyi bden pa ste/ de ni de kho na nyid ma yin no/ /yongs grub de ni 'dir zhi ba zhes yongs su smos pas rnam par 'jig pa'i tshul can gyi ming mthun phyogs yongs su zhi bas na rtag brtan g.yung drung ngo / /de ltar yang nag po pa'i 'grel pa las/ zhi ba zhes bya ba ni rang bzhin te/ rnam par mi 'jig pa rtag pa'o/ /de nyid ces bya ba ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes phyin ci ma log pas so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'o na lang kar gshegs pa las/ blo yis rnam par dpyad na ni/ /gzhan dbang med cing kun btags med/ /yongs su grub pa'i dngos med na/ /blo yis ji ltar rnam par brtag /rang bzhin med cing rnam rig med/ /kun gzhi med cing dngos med na/ /byis pa ngan pa rtog ge ba/ /ro dang 'dra bas 'di dag btags/ /zhes rang bzhin med cing yongs grub med par gsungs pa ma yin nam zhe na/ bden te 'on kyang lung 'di nyid kyis kyang yongs su grub pa ni bden yod du grub ste/ de'i kun gzhi ni/ de nyid du rgya cher bshad pa mdzad pa'i rnam shes nyid yin la/ rnam rig ni gzung 'dzin gyi snang ba rnams yin zhing / rang bzhin ni kun rdzob rnams kyi rang bzhin bkag tsam gyi stong nyid —199—

de yin la de dag dang / kun brtags dang gzhan dbang rnams la khyad par ma sbyar bar spyi ldog nas med par gsungs shing / yongs su grub pa la ni dngos po'i mtshan nyid med par gsungs pas/ de nyid kyi ngo bo ni yod pa kho nar bstan no/ /'o na dngos med kyang med par ci'i phyir mi gsung zhe na/ de ni kun brtags bkag pa nyid kyis khegs pa la dgongs pa'o/ /des na bram ze chen po'i zhal snga nas/ yang na thabs kyi bde ba skad cig ma/ /yang na de nyid gnyis su 'gyur ba ste/ /bla ma'i drin gyis slar yang ni/ /brgya la 'ga' yis shes par 'gyur/ /grogs dag zab mo dang ni rgya che ba/ /gzhan med bdag nyid ma yin par/ /lhan cig skyes dga' bzhi pa'i dus/ /gnyug/ ma nyams su myong pas shes/zhes dang / rang bzhin dag pa'i sems la bsam gtan dag gis mi bslad de/bdag nyid bde la gnas shing gdung bar ma byed cig /ces gsungs pa ltar thabs kun rdzob kyi bde ba thams cad ni skad cig ma yin la/ yang na bde ba de la skad cig ma dang rtag pa gnyis su dbye/ de'i rtag pa ni zab pa yang yin/ rgya che ba'ang yin/ bdag gzhan la sogs pa mtshan ma thams cad spangs pa/ bzhi pa'i nyams myong la brten nas shes shing rtogs par 'gyur ba ma gtogs sngon med gsar du byung ba ma yin te/ gnyug ma dngos po'i gnas lugs so/ /lam gyi shes pa brdzun pas bslad cing gdung bar ma byed cig /rang nyid kyi gnas tshul bde bar gnas pa yin no/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /de ltar na le'u gsum pa dngos ni de yan chad yin la 'di la le'u'i mtshan bstan pa med pa'i phyir mtshan bshad pa mi dgos kyang brjod bya'i don gyi dbang du byas te/ kha bskong gi le'u —200—

zhes bla ma gong ma rnams gsung ngo / /'di la le'u'i mtshams bcad pa med pas don bsdu phan yon dang bcas pa 'dir bsdus kyang mi 'gal lo/ /de ltar na rgyud don mtha' dag shes bya dang dngos po'i gnas lugs sogs bzhir bsdus kyang rung la/ rgyud gsum du bsdus kyang rung / gnas thabs gsum du bsdus kyang rung / sngags dbyibs chos gsum du bsdus kyang rung / zhes bla ma rnams gsung pa ltar gnas so/ /le'u gsum pa'i rgya cher bshad pa'o// //gsum pa don bsdu phan yon dang bcas pa la/ /don bsdu dang / phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ 'dir tshigs bcad du gyur pa ni/ zhes sogs te/ tshigs bcad ces pa ni don bsdu ched du brjod pas nges pa bskyed pa ste/ de la gzugs ni lha'i sku/ phyag rgya ni rgyan gyi khyad par la sogs pa rnams dang /mtshan ma ni phyag mtshan dang yi ge dang sngags rnams so/ /rdzas ni dam tshig gi ril bu la sogs pa rnams dang / bsam gtan te gtso bor rdzogs pa'i rim pa rnams dang / bsgom pa yi zhes pa ni mthar thug chos kyi rnal 'byor dang / rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa'o/ /cho ga'i thabs ni rnam pa sna tshogs zhes pa las dang dngos grub kyi rtogs pa rnams so/ /dang po gsum ni dbyibs kyi rnal 'dre(ra yan lag dang bcas pa ste/ yang na phyag rgya'i mtshan ma zhes gcig tu bsdoms nas ngo bo mtshan ma'o/ /de ltar na bskyed rim dang / dam rdzas dang /rdzogs rim dang / spyod pa dang / las tshogs te don lnga'o/ /dang po la so sor phye bas bdun nam drug tu bsdus kyang rung la/ de'i dam rdzas kyi ni dam tshig thams cad kyang don gyi bstan pa yin no zhes gsung / de ltar don lnga'am bdun pa de —201—

dag ni/ 'dod pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs te/ lha mo zhes 'khor lo'i dbang phyug ma la bos nas sems can rnams kyi 'di la 'dod pa'i don rnams mtha' dag sgrub par bya ba'i phyir gsungs pa'o/ /yid la 'dod pa'i don sems can rnams kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin dang / skal pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'gro ba'i don spyod pa yin pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi 'phrin las bstan pa yin no/ /zhes gong ma rnams gsung la/ yang yid la 'dod pa ni dngos grub yin la/cho ga'i thabs sna tshogs ni las tshogs yin zhing / phyag rgya'i mtshan ma zhes pa'i phyag rgya ni logs su mi bgrang bar gzugs dang mtshan ma la rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog pa'i rnal 'byor du bshad nas bsdus don bdun du nag po pas bshad la/ yang yid la 'dod pa ni/ cho ga'i thabs sna tshogs te/ sku gsum dang / las tshogs dang / gzugs yongs su brje ba dang / grong du 'jug pa dang / mi snang ba dang / dbang bskur ba dang / bdud rtsi sgrub pa ste sbas pa bdun la byed pa dang dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid dang / lha'i de kho na nyid dang /sngags kyi de kho na nyid dang / las tshogs kyi de kho na nyid dang / glu'i de kho na nyid dang / dam tshig gi de kho na nyid dang / dman pa'i dngos grub kyi de kho na nyid dang / gzugs nas bsgom pa'i bar mang du gsungs kyang / 'dod pa'i don sgrub pa'i thabs de kho na nyid bdun po 'di'o zhes pa'i don du 'chad pa yod de/thams cad mi 'gal bar mngon no/ /man ngag gzhan las ni/ gzugs ni dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor dang / phyag rgya ni las kyi phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor dang /mtshan ma ni mtshan bcas kyi rdzogs rim dang / rdzas ni las tshogs dang dngos —202—

grub kyi rdzas thams cad de/ sman dang sngags dang 'khor lo gsum char bstan pa yin la bsam gtan ni mtshan ma med pa'i rdzogs rim ste lnga po mtshan gzhir bzung nas de dag la sogs pa bsgom zhing nyams su len pa'i cho ga'i thabs spros bcas dang spros med sna tshogs pa rgyud 'dir gsungs pa rnams dang sems can rnams kyi 'dod pa'i don 'dir gsungs pa dang ma gsungs pa thams cad sgrub par byed pa'i thabs so/ /de la rgyud 'dir ma gsungs pa ni 'di'i rnal 'byor la brten nas/ rgyud gzhan las gsungs pa'i las tshogs thams cad sgrub tu rung ba ste/ de yang dper na sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin pas mdun du khro bo chen po stobs po che mdung rtse gsum pa dang sbrul zhags 'dzin pa kha dog dud kha bsgoms te/ mchod gtor spyi dang mthun par phul nas oṃ badzra kro dha mahā bā la ha na da ha ni pa tsa bi dhwa sa ya yo so mā ra ya hū phaṭa/ ces khri bzlas shing bsnyen pa bya'o/ /phyi nas ji ltar 'dod par char dbab ste/ grog mkhar gyi sa dang / ba'i rnam lnga la nor rgyas kyi gzugs bya/ ka ra wi ra'i lcug mas chu gtor zhing gu gul gyis bdug /dkar gsum gyi gtor ma byin la/ stobs po che bskul nas bka' bsgos na/ ji ltar 'gor yang zhag bdun gyis dbab par 'gyur la/gal te mi 'bab na gzugs dum bur gtubs te bum par blug la chu bo chen por bskul nas sngags drag tu bzlas na/ the tshom med par char chen po 'bab bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang rab tu gnas pa dang / bsregs blugs dang / sa'i cho ga dang / pha rol gyi sde gzhig pa dang / zhi ba dang / rgyas pa'i khyad par rnam pa —203—

du ma rnams dang / mig sman dang / ro langs dang / rkang mgyogs dang / gnod sbyin mo dang / bum pa bzang po la sogs pa ji ltar 'dod pa thams cad bsgrubs pas dngos grub kyi 'bras bu chen por 'gyur ro/ / zhes gsung ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ gang gis khyim du sogs te/ khyim gang du rgyud 'di'i glegs bam la gus pas mchod pas gnas pa dang / klog pa ste kha ton dang thos bsam byed pa dang / don bsgoms par byed pa de dag dam tshig dang bcas pa ni nges par dgos te/ de la phan yon gyi tshogs 'di rnams 'byung ngo / /ci zhig ce na/ nad dang rims kyi tshogs mi 'byung ba dang / rgas par mi 'gyur ba dang /lha'i bu'i bdud kyis sems g.yeng bar byed pa la sogs pa bgegs kyi gnod pa'i rigs gang yang mi 'byung la/ 'chang zhing klog pa tsam gyis kyang dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba bzlog cing / rtse gcig tu bsgom pas ni rdo rje'i lus 'grub pas 'chi bar mi 'gyur te/ sgrub pa po de rnams la ni/ rgyun du dus thams cad du rnal 'byor ma'i dbang phyug la 'phags ma chen mo rnams kyis bgegs bsrung zhing / zhi ba dang / rgyas pa la sogs pa'i cho ga bzang po mdzad par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /rgyun du zhes pa dang dus thams cad du zhes so sor smos pa ni/ rgyun du zhes pas/ bsung ba la sogs pa'i cho ga bzang po ji srid mdzad pa de srid du'ang mnyam par bzhag pa dang / ma bzhag pa dang / gnyid log pa dang /sad pa la sogs pa'i gnas skabs gang du yang bar stong cung zad tsam yang med pa'i don yin la/ dus thams cad du zhes pa spyi'i dus kyi tshad bstan pas/ gang rgyud 'di la zhugs pa nas sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar ma 'ongs pa'i dus thams —204—

cad ces pa'o/ /de ltar na/ rgyud 'di tshig nyung yang / rtsa rgyud bsdus pa yongs rdzogs yin pa'i phyir/ brjod bya'i don/ rgyud chen po gzhan las nyung ba ni ma yin no/ /gsum pa bshad pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba ni/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi dgongs pa sogs te/ de la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ni bshad zin to/ /de rnams kyi dgongs pa ste ji ltar rtogs shing sku nyams su bstar pa'i don mi rtog pa'i bde ba chen pos chos nyid rtogs par byed pa'i lam ni mchog tu gsang ba yin la gsang ba chen po ni 'bras bu sku dang ye shes te/ de'i nye bar spyod pa zhing dang / gdul bya dang / 'phrin las rgyas par bshad pa dang bcas pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di yongs su rdzogs so/ /zhes pa la rdzogs pa ni bshad zin pa'i don dang / sa mā rdza zhes pa'i sgra las drangs na/ ston pas de ltar gsungs pas 'khore kyis yang dag par rtogs so/ /yang dag par thob bo/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /de ltar mar rngog gi bshad sgros ji lta ba bzhin rdzogs par bshad nas/ sharnyi pa dang / nag po pa'i 'grel pa las legs cha cung zad blangs shing / dpal rgyan pa dang / mi thub zla ba'i 'grel pa ni snga ma rnams las legs khyad thon pa cher mi snang la/ 'phags yul gyi man ngag khyad par can mang pos kyang brgyan te gzhan yang 'di nyid kyi yi ge rgya bod du byung ba/ phyogs 'dir ji tsam yod pa phal cher gyi don khong du chud nas brjod zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ nag po'i 'grel par slob ma la bshad dang / shanti pas mdzad tshogs bshad bzang po dang / grub pa'i dgongs 'dus mar pa'i man ngag —205—

ste/ /sngags srol bshad pa bzang po gsum thos shing / /zhi ba'i zhabs kyi man ngag mchog gis brgyan/ /rgyud 'dir brten pa'i rgya bod gzhan rnams kyi/ /ye ge phyogs 'dir yod pa'ang phal cher mthong / /kun 'dus zab cing rgya che'i 'grel pa 'di'o/ /man ngag ni rtsod pa'i yul ma yin pa dang / khyad par du/gsang sngags smra rnams mang du ni/ /spros te smras pas ci zhig bya/ khyad par du ni sems sgrub ste/ /sems las rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung / /zhes pa'i don yid la gzhag nas spros te mi brjod do/ /da ni gzhan zhig dpyad par bya ste/'dir kha cig tshogs la bshad pa'i sgra tsam la brten pa'i tshig gi sbu 'phreng tsam ste/ man ngag dang bral ba'i phyir snying po med pa'o/ /zhes smra ba de dag ni rang gi de nyid ston par zad de/ tshogs slob kyi bshad tshul 'di gnyis char yang ston pa nyid kyis gsungs pa'i 'chad tshul yin pas so/ /yin yang der 'gyur na ston pas rgyud don log par bkral par 'gyur ro/ /zhes thal bar 'gyur ba ma yin nam/ mkhas pas mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyis rgyud kyi 'grel pa byas pa de dag ni/rang gi rnam par rtog pa tsam yin gyi/ tshogs slob kyi bshad pa gang yang ma yin no/ /tshogs la bshad pa de la don dam ston pa'ang shin tu mang zhing / kun rdzob gtso bor ston pa yin kyang / thar pa mchog don gnyer la nges par dgos pa sha stag ste/ stong pa nyid dang / snying rje dang / dam tshig dang / bskyed ba'i rim pa la sogs pa ni/ de'i don yin pas so/ /gang tshogs la bshad pa'i don med na ni gsang sngags log par spyod pa'i gnas kyang yod la/ tshogs bshad de yod pa la slob ma la bshad pas nye bar brgyan pa na/ mchog sgrub pa'i thabs bla na med —206—

pa rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes rtogs par bya'o/ /glegs bam gyi mthar/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po a nī la badzra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyis bsgyur zhing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/ /zhes 'byung ba ni 'gyur byang ste/ lo tsā ba 'gos khug pa nyid kyis bsgyur ba la yang / paṇḍi ta dzi na warma dang / shanti bha trore drung du bsgyur ba'i 'gyur khyad yod pa re yang snang mod/ brgyud pa 'di la 'gyur sngar smos pa 'di gtso bor mdzad cing / 'gos 'gyur phyi ma yang 'di yin la/'di la glog skyas cung zad bcos pa'ang yod cing / phyis gzhan dang gzhan gyis bcos pa'ang mthong mod/ 'gos 'gyur nyid byings che zhing legs par mngon no/ /rdo rje dang mtshungs rdo rje'i tshig /dbye ba dka' ba 'di dbye las/ /bla med go 'phang bla ma yi/ /gnas la 'gro kun gnas par shog /dpal ldan rdo rje rol pa mos/ /gnang ba'i mtshan ma thob pa na/ /blun po'i blos kyang 'grel pa byas/ /de la 'phags rnams bzod par mdzod/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud rgyal tshig nyung don rgyas pa/ /phyogs 'dir deng sang nub tu nye mthong nas/ /skal ldan 'ga' zhig blo gros rgyas bya'i phyir/ /rgyas 'grel byas pa 'di yang don bcas yin// //zhes pa dpal sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgyud kyi rgya cher bshad pa de kho na nyid kyi sgron ma zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rang nyid kyi dran pa gso ba dang / rgyud 'di don du gnyer ba'i skal ldan 'ga' zhig da ltar yod srid cing phyis 'byung bar 'gyur na/de dag la shin tu phan par mthong ste/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo sum cu rtsa bzhir son pa'i dus/ sa ga'i tshes bco lnga la/ dpal jo mo nang du sbyar ba'o/ /bkra shis dge legs 'phel/ ma ṅga la/ /—207—

gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhu / gas/skye( khyu sti/ dam pa'i bde mchog bdud rtsis nges bran pa'i/ /shes rab mdzes ma'i tshogs kyis rtsen pa'i sku/ /dpyid kyi dga' bas sems can phan dges kyang / /bdud kyi stobs 'joms he ru ka la 'dud/ /mgon po de yis nges par yang / /byang chub la sbyar mkhas rnams kyis/ /rnam dag gzhung lam bstan pa la/ /byed pa ci yang dge legs nyid/ /'dir dpal sangs rgyas thod pa las 'byung ba/ he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa sgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rnams byas la/ huX phaṭa/ ces bzlas pas/ bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor srung ba byas shing / 'og nas 'chad pa ltar nang mchod byin gyis rlabs te/ oX āXhuX gis bdud rtsi myangs par 'dir 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma sbyin par mi 'jigs pa'i gzhud 'grel las 'khyu/nga ba ltar byas kyang legs/rngo ma 'gru/ba kyang 'gal ba med do/ /rang gi snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i rdo rje hū ཾ ༷ gis mtshan pa/ de'i 'od kyis dpal he ru ka gnyug/ ma'i dga' ma sna tshogs bde mas 'khyud pa/ phreng bzang ma la sogs pa rdo rje rol pa mo nyi shu rtsa bzhis bskor ba spyan drangs te/ rang la mngon du phyogs pas bzhugs par gyur/ 'od zer rnams snying ga'i hūX la thim/yang snying ga'i huX las lha mo brgyad cig car sprul nas mchod par gyur/ 'dzag pa de las rnal 'byor ma/ /brgyad po bu mo rnams kyi mchog /mchod pa sna tshogs 'dzin pa yis/ /mgon po he ru ka mchod do/ /rdo rje mgon po'i shar gnas pa/—208—

rdo rje mche ba ma yis ni/ /thod pa khrag gis bkang bzung ste/ /gzi brjid chen po gsol bar mdzod/ /rdo rje pho nya bdag nyid che/ dbang ldan du ni cang te'u brdung / /rdo rje gdod ma dri snod dang / /me yi phyogs su rnam par gnas/ /rdo rje can ma grags chen mo/ /mchod yon snod can bden bral ni/ /rdo rje gtsigs ma lho yi ni/ /phyag na rnga bo che 'dzin gsungs/ /rlung du rdo rje lte ba ma/ /ri bong can gyi snod 'dzin no/ /nub tu rdo rje 'jigs ma ni/ /lce spyang phyag na 'dzin par gsungs/ /byang du 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ /lha mo'i chags pas gtso bo mchod/ /de ltar he ru ka bsam nas/ /rnal 'byor ma ni brgyad kyis mchod/ /sna tshogs zas dang sna tshogs skom/ /sna tshogs rol mo mchog gsungs dang / /dri zhim lnga dang me tog spos/ /'di dag gis ni gtso bo mchod/ /mchod yon zhal bsil de bzhin khrus/ /glu yi mchog ni rnam mang pos/ /mgon po khrag 'thung bdag nyid che/ /'di dag gis ni mchod par bya/ /zhes pa ni mchod pa'o/ /rgyas pa la spro na/ 'og nas ཿnga ba'i mchod sngags rnams kyis mchod do/ khrag 'thung yon tan zab mnga' ba/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin mchog /sems can kun la phan dgyes dang / /sna tshogs sde la rtag tu 'dud/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal po che/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dra ba sdom/ /dngos kun rang bzhin 'gro ba skyob/ /sna tshogs sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes phyag bya/ bdag gis bdag nyid kyi sdig pa thams cad 'chags shing slar yang mi bgyid do/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / 'phags pa dang / so so'i skye bo thams cad kyi bsod nams thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo / /bdag nyid kyi dge ba thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i —209—

byang chub tu yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang / shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa chos dkon mchog dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa'/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog la byang chub kyi bar du skyabs su mchi'o/ /kye ma ma la bdag gis sems can kun gyi don dang / phan pa dang / bde ba dang / ji srid du de rnams shin tu mthar thug pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa/ bla na med pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes la bkod pa'i bar du de'i lam sgrub pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par byang chub par bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum mo/ /sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig /'og gi rlung gis bskul bas 'bar ba'i gtum mo'i mes 'byud pa'i snying ga'i huX las/ 'od zer 'phros khams gsum ma lus pa bsregs te stong par sbyangs/ oX hūṃ n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa utpa ko3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las/ sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthu las/ raX las byung ba'i nyi ma'i steng du/ huX las sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba huX gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur bla re mda'i dra ba/ me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum dkar po'i nang du/ yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam ba dan dang yaX gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar ba bdun dang raX gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baX las —210—

chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pa dang ba gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du la las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi rdo rje dang la gyi mtshan pa/ de ltar 'byung ba bzhi ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ sngo dkar ser dmar ljang ba'i rtsigs pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i pha gu dang /dra ba dang / dra ba phyed pa dang / shar bu dang / mnga' yab dang ldan pa/ rtsigs pa'i phyi rol du mchod pa'i gzungs ma rnams dang ldan pa'i kha khyer gyis bskor ba/ rin po che thams cad kyi rang bzhin las byung ba ka ba dang / dril bu la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ steng thog rim par phub pa'i dbus phyur bu'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar byang ser nub dmar lho nag /dbus sngo ba'i sa gzhi'i steng du/ sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ rtsibs chan sngon po/ mu khyud la rdo rje dkar po'i phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i lte bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ rtsibs chan ljang khu mu khyud la rdo rje dmar po'i rwa bas bskor ba/ de'i nye bar thugs kyi 'khor lo nag po rtsibs brgyad pa/ mu khyud la rdo rje sngon pos rwa bas bskor ba/ 'khor lo'i lte ba sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pas khyab pa/de'i lte ba sngon po la slar yang padma la gnas pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin mi ro'i snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang / phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi dang /'khor lo phyi ma gnyis kyi rtsibs rnams su pad nyi dang / sgo bzhir padma nyi ma mi ro'i gdan rnams so/ /me lce'i khor yug gi phyi rol du/ dur khrod chen po brgyad —211—

kyis yongs su bskor ba ni/ shing brgyad kyi rtse mor wo skyong brgyad dang / rtsa ba na phyogs skyong ba rnams dang / klu'i dbang po brgyad dang / sprin gyi bdag po brgyad dang / mngon par 'phags pa'i ri brgyad dang / de la gnas pa'i mchod rten brgyad dang / drag tu 'bab pa'i chu klung brgyad dang / rab tu 'bar ba'i me brgyad dang / bya dang gcan gzan sna tshogs dang / sbrul gyis khyab pa/ gsal shing gis phug pa dang / shing la dpyangs pa dang / phyed tshig pa dang / dum bur gyur pa dang / ma gyur pa'i mi ro sna tshogs dang / rus pa'i dum bus khyab pa ro langs dang / srin po dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / grub pa thob pa dang / dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs yongs su rgyu bas ngo mtshar bar byed pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ g.yon bskor gyis/ a ā i yī u mū ṛ grwa '-i lī e i o au aX aX phrag gnyis mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo de rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /de'i steng du g.yas bskor gyis/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzñā nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa rte ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha kṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa lha/phrag gnyis dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo de rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /de gnyis kyi bar du hūX las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ lte ba la huX gis mtshan pa thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa'i rang bzhin ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /de las 'od zer 'phros/sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub la bkod pa ni/ bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes so/ /zla nyi rdo rje huX yig dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ sku —212—

yongs su rdzogs par grub pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /de yang bcom ldan 'das yab yum grub pa na/ nor bu dang nor bu'i 'od zer gyi tshul gyis/rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi yang / huX yig de nyid kyi snang ba las grub ste/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa/ kun da dang zla 'od ltar dkar zhing 'tsher ba'i sku las nor bu'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ phyag g.yas gnyis na cang te dang gri gug /g.yon gnyis na kha ṭāX ga dang thod pa bsnams pa/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa ltar mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma sna tshogs bde ma dmar mos 'phyud pa'o/ /spyir rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sngon pos kyang rung la/ bram ze chen pos mdzad par grags pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ skabs 'dir g.yas gnyis gri thod g.yon gnyis kha ṭāX rdo rje/ yum yang dkar mo phyag gnyis mas phyag mtshan bzhi bzung ba ste/ g.yas cang te'i steng na gri gug dang / g.yon kha ṭāX thod pa lhan cig par bshad pa'ang snang ngo / /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i 'dab ma rnams la/ shar du 'phreng bzang ma/ byang du thod can ma/nub tu 'jigs byed ma/ lhor thub dka' ma/ dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la/ g.yas bskor gyi khu ba dang / rdul dang / bdud rtsi lnga dang / sgron ma lngas gang ba'i thod pa'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad la/ shar du dge ba'i ska rags can ma/ byang du gzugs can ma/ nub tu rnam rgyal ma/ lhor 'byung gnas ma/ dbang ldan du dus can ma/ mer mtsho chen ma/ bden bral du byed can ma/ rlung du sdud byed ma'o/ /sku'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad la/ shar du sgrol byed ma/ byang du 'jigs mthong ma/ nub tu legs mthong ma/ lhor mi pham ma/ dbang ldan du dge ba ma/ mer grib gnon ma/—213—

bden bral du dus mtshan ma/ rlud du grags chen ma/ shar sgor mdzes sdug ma/byang sgor nor 'dzin ma/ nub sgor skal bzang ma/ lhor sgor yid 'ong ma/ 'di dag kyang mtshan nyid dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /lha mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i thod par gnas pa'i bdud rtsis bcom ldan 'das la yang dag par mchod cing / yum gyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX snying gar huX/ gsang bar rdza/ brla gnyis la hā/ de rnams kyi 'od kyis sku gang / yum gyi bha ga hruXlas byung ba'i padma dmar po/ lte ba la āXyig dmar pos mtshan pa/yab kyi liṅga hūX las byung ba'i rdo rje nag po rtse mo la oṃ dkar pos mtshan pa/ lha mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi sna tshogs bde ma dang lhan cig dbyer med pas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'dod pa mdzad de bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang ngo / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra su bhā wa atpa ko3haX/ rjes su chags pa'i mes shes rab ma'i 'khor lo bcom ldan 'das dang lhan cig zhu bar gyur pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la khu ba'i gzugs kyis gnas par gyur to/ /dang po sbyor ba'i kho nge 'dzin no/ /de nas thig le las sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis/ gdung ba dang bcas pas bskul ba ni/ /byams pa'i rang bzhin 'phreng bzang mas/ /ci ste 'jig rten snyan mnan na/ /ci ste khyod ni mi dgyes gyur/ /gal te khyod bdag tshig gsan na/ / mi dgyes gyur ba mtha' dag thong / /snying rje'i rang bzhin thod can mas/ /stong pa'i gzugs ni ma mdzad par/ /nyid kyi dgongs pa grags par mdzod/ /srid 'jigs skye bo kun bslu bas/ /rnal 'byor ma yi grogs po bzhengs/ /dga' ba'i rang bzhin 'jigs byed mas/ /bdag po sngon gsungs dran par mdzod/ / bya bar sgyid —214—

lug ma mdzad cig khyod mi snang na skye bo kun/ /lhung bas 'gro ba mi dgar 'gyur/ /btang snyoms rang bzhin thub dka' mas/ /log pa'i nga rgyal ma mdzad par/ /mdza' bo stong pa'i rang bzhin thong / /dngos po mtha' yas khyod thong la/ /rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs la spyod/ /tshigs bcad 'di dag mi 'jigs pa'i gzhud 'grel 'gyur gsar na drangs pa rnams go bde zhing 'gyur legs par snang yang / lag len mdzad pa'i rgyun la gyi khro'i 'gyur bzhin mdzad kyin snang bas de ltar drangs so/ /sa ra has mdzad zer ba'i sgrub thabs ltar na/ gtso bo yab yum zhu ba ma gtogs 'khor gyi lha mo rnams gnas shing de'i phyir thig le las lha mo spro ba med la/ bskul mkhan yang mdzes sdug ma la sogs pa sgo ma bzhis byed do/ /de ltar bskul ma thag tu thig le de nyid huX du gyur zhing / huX las rdo rje hūX gis mtshan pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog sngon po chu shing gi me tog gsar du kha bye ba lta bu'i mdangs can/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas kyi dang pos cang te'u steng du ga khrol zhing / g.yon gyi dang pos kha ṭāX ga dkar po gyen du bsgreng ba/ g.yas 'og mas gri gug bsnun pa'i tshul can/g.yon 'og mas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa/ sna tshogs padma'i ste bar padma dmar po dang mi ro'i snying ga la gnas pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/'jigs shing khros la drag po'i sku can/ nyi ma'i dkyil snyen ra gsar du shar ba lta bu'i spyan gsum pa/ zhal nas hūX gi sgra sgrog pas bdud dang phas kyi rgol ba thams cad sdigs shing phye mar mdzad pa/ mi bzad pa'i mche ba rnon po gtsigs —215—

pa/ thal ba chen pos sku la nye bar brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs rgyab kyi char 'dzin pa/ mi'i rgyu ma rlon pa'i tshangs skud dang / dpral bar thod pa lnga'i phreng bas brgyan zhing / thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas dbu la brgyan pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ 'khor lo dang / rna cha dang / mgul rgyan dang / gdub bu dang / ske rags te rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing / thugs rje chen pos lus can rnams 'khor ba las 'don par mdzad pa'o/ /de la 'phyud pa'i sna tshogs bde ma rnal 'byor ma'i dbang mo ni/ sku mdog brgyu ltar dmar ba/ rus pa'i rgyan can/ rnam par 'gyur pa'i zhal/ dbu skra kham ser grol zhing gyen du 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum mche ba'i myu gu gtsigs pa/phyag g.yon pas thod pa rang byung sirla'i rgyun gyis gang ba 'dzin zhing yab la 'khyu/da pa/ g.yas gri gug dang bcas pa steng du sgreng bas/ gdug pa thams cad la bsnun par mdzad pa/ sgeg cing g.yo bas rtsen pa'i sku/ shid kyi sgra dang bcas pa'i sgyu rtsal dang rtsed 'jos rol pa can no/ /mi 'jigs pa'i g.yi 'grel las yab he ru ka dbu skra nag po ral pa'i cod pan du byas par bshad de gdam nga yin pas mi 'gal lo/ /gtso bo yab yum grub pa dang / rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi yang skad cig gis grub par gyur te/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i 'dab ma rnams la/ lko pa nas/ lho sgor yid 'ong ma ste rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi po thams cad kyang sngon mo ind+ra nī las 'od zer 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ 'dzus khros mche ba gtsigs shing —216—

skra ser gyen du grol ba/ me tog manta ra ba kha bye ba lta bu'i nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa/ sgo skyong ma bzhi ni dbugs bral gyi gdan la g.yon brkyang gi stabs dang gzhan rnams g.yon brkyang pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa lnga po thams cad mi mgo'i dbu rgyan dang phreng ba spangs shing rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang / phyogs kyi gos can/ zhal nas khrag chen gyi zegs ma 'thor ba/ rab tu chags pas zla ba'i rgyun 'bab pa'o/ /yang na gdam nga la thugs 'khor ba rnams nag mo gsung 'khor ba rnams dkar ser/ sku 'khor ba rnams ljang khu/ sgo skyong rnams nag mor yang bsdus pa'i rgyud nyid las bshad pa ltar bya la/ /yang thugs 'khor ba dang sgo skyong rnams phyogs mdog /gsung 'khor pa rnams dmar mo/ sku 'khor pa rnams dang / sna tshogs bde ma yang dkar mor sa ra he'i gzhung du grags pa las 'byung zhing / de nyid rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs pa yin par yang grags la/ gzhan de dang 'dra ba las/ 'jigs byed ma dkar mor 'dod pa yang 4gad pa dang / rdzogs 'phreng las gtso bo he ru ka'i smad g.yogs glang po che'i pags pa yang bshad la/ 'khor nyer bzhi stag lpags rgyab tu 'phyar ba byed pa'ang yod pa dang /de bzhin du/ yum sna tshogs bde ma phyag bzhi phyag mtshan yab dang 'dra ba yang da lta'i rgyud 'di las gsungs te/ de dag las rang nyid ji ltar mos pa zhig bsgom par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar oX/ dpral bar haX/ mgrin par ho/ spyi bor lha/ phrag pa gnyis la hoX /mig gnyis la hoX / gsang ba la hi/ lus thams cad la haX zhes pa go cha'o/ /thugs kar huX las rdo rje nag po'i lte bar hūX gis mtshan pa/ mgrin par aXlas padma dmar po as mtshan pa/ spyi bor oX las 'khor lo dkar po oX gyis mtshan pa/ snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i rdo rje'i lte ba la hūX de las 'od —217—

'phros/ dpal sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dkyil 'khor/ ye shes sems dpa' badzra sa mā dza hru zhes bgegs bskrad/ tso ( zhwa hipra wa ra sad ka rā ra tha/ badzra argha pra tismo swāhā/ dza rgyu ba ho sgo ma bzhi pos dgug gzhug bcing mnyes bya/skyed pu rna/ ka pā li nī ā kha bra dru sdo/ ā ā ā hū hu hu phaṭa phaṭa/ zhes ye shes sems dpa' dang ro mnyam gcig tu 'dres par gyur/ de nas/ lte bar gtum mo 'bar bas bde ba chen po'i 'khor lor gnas pa'i bdud rtsi zhu zhing babs te/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i sa bon la khrus gsol ba'i dus su/ de'i rtsa brgyad kyi rang bzhin mkha' 'gro ma brgyad/ sgeg cing mdzes sdug phun sum tshogs pa/ lo bcu gnyis lon pa'i na tshod can rnams kyis/ byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa thogs te/ 'dzum pa'i 'od zer dang bcas pa phyir spros/ snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas spyan drangs pa'i phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rig pa'i lha mor bcas pa rnams/ rab tu dwangs shing bzhad pa'i 'dzum dmul te/ he ru ka rgyal bar gyur cig /rgyal bar gyur cig ces gsung bzhin gyur/ yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal te/ /thal mo sbyar nas gsol 'debs na/ thugs rje che dang ldan pa rnams/ / bdag la dbang ni skur du gsol/ /brtse ldan grags pa chen po pas/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbang bskur/ /'khor ba'i 'dam du bying ba bdag /dbang bskur pa yis bdag sgrol mdzod/ /oṃ a bhi ṣañtsa ntu mā/ sarba yo gī rkyo mu ku ṭi a tra a dhi tikhyi stu ā ga : tshu hu swāhā/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshon dang ba dan dang / gos dang / rol mo la sogs pa nye bar mkho ba thams cad dang ldan pa/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dkar po —218—

'dzin pa rnams kyis khrus gsol ba dang / bkra shis dang / rnga bo che'i sgra dang /tsandan dang gur gum dang me tog la sogs pa'i char phab cing / phyi dang gsang ba dang shes rab ye shes dang / bzhi pa'i dbang bskur bar mdzad do/ /de nas dbang lha rnams snying ga'i rtsa brgyad la thim/ gtso bo rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo la/mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan pa dang / sna tshogs bde ma la rdo rje sems dpa' dang / thugs 'khor ba rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan dang / gsung 'khor ba rnams la 'od dpag med dang / sku 'khor ba rnams la rnam par snang mdzad dang / sgo skyong rnams la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan rtsa brgyad po las byung ba'i rnal 'byor ma brgyad po rnams kyi gtso bo la mchod par gyur/ oṃ brnya ka pā li ni ma ṭa ma ṭa a swāhā/ me tog 'bul ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ mahā ka pā la ba dzī ba ra ba ra ta ṭa sta ṭa ya sta ṭa ya ma ṭa ma ṭa hū he swāhā/ dri chab 'bul ba'i sngags so/ /o bzhi ka pā li ni ta ṭa hpho ṭa ya sarba shu bha pra dā yi ni hu phaṭa/ sbos 'bul ba'i sngags so/ /skye( pudhe ka pā li ni gro hā gro hā gro hā pa ya grihā pa ya ba ra ba ra ta ṭa ta ṭa/ sta ṭa ya sta ra ya ma ṭa hu hu swāhā/ mar me 'bul pa'i sngags so/ /tsho rna bcag ka pā li ni/ gro hā gro sna grotna pa ya gro sna pa ya ji ji skyo/ lha bshos 'bul ba'i sngags so/ /o mahā ka pā li badzra dharma dharma me bhe ba re pra ba re ba ra ba ra ka ra ka ra/ ta ṭa ta ṭa/ ha he swāhā/ gos 'bul ba'i sngags so/ /skabs 'dir/ spro na gong tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar/ tshigs bcad brjod pas/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa mtha' dag 'bul ba skabs su bab pa'ang yin no/ /de nas/ rdo rje dang ni padma 'dus shing bdud rtsis bde rgyas shing / /rim gyis yongs gyur sku can sems can don du gar byed pa/ /rdo rje lha mo'i rtsed —219—

mo'i rol bas rtser mdzod 'gro rmongs la/ /'gro la mi dman kun dga' ster ba khyod la bdag 'dud do/ /zhes bstod/ de nas bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa lnga rnams spyan drangs/ spyi bo nas zhugs thugs kar byang chub kyi sems dang 'dres/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi padma ra babs pa/ ye shes bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin du gnas pa la/ lha thams cad kyi ljags las byung ba'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs nas/ gsol bas tshim zhing mnyes par gyur/ nang gi bdud rtsi myang ba'o/ /nang mchod bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ya las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ra las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po zur gsum pa 'bar ba bdun gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du oṃ ā hū las byung ba'i mi mgo'i skyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ ā las byung ba'i thod pa dum bu gsum pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'o/ /de'i nang du bo ro hūṃ mo tshu rnams las dri chen rakta byang sems kyi klad pa dri chu ste bdud rtsi lnga dang / go rku do lha rna rnams las ba glang khyi glang po rta mi sha ste sgron ma lnga la/ o hu kha spru hū gis mtshan pa/ 'og gi rlung g.yos me sbar bas rdzas bcu yi ge dang bcas pa zhu ba'i rlangs pa rnams steng gi bar snang la hu las rdo rje sngon po hu gis mtshan par gyur pa la reg pas de zhu nas thod par lhung ba rdzas rnams dang ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur/ yang mtho gang tsam gyi bar snang la/ o las zla ba o gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams las/byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs pa dang / nor bu dang sngags dang sman —220—

gyi nus pa'i bye brag thams cad bkug ste rdzas la thim pas/ de thams cad dngul chu'i mdog can rab tu bsil ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ā hu/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ yang lan gcig gis bdud rtsi myangs nas/ hū dkar po las skyes pa'i ljags rdo rje rtse gcig pas drangs te gsol bar bsam ste/ phyi'i bdud rtsi myangs ba'o/ /de dag ni dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog gi ting nge 'dzin no/ /dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i bdag gzhan snod bcud dang bcas pa thams cad rmi lam lta bur bsam zhing / sprul pa spro bsdus sems can gyi don byed pa ni las rgyal po mchog gi ting nge 'dzin no/ /de nas mi 'jigs pa'i gzhung 'grel ltar na/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i man ngag dang mtshungs par/ lus dkyil sgom par yang mdzad de/ de ltar spyir shin tu 'thad cing / phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag yin te/ sgom par spro na gzhung 'grel nyid las tshol bar bya'o/ /'on kyang bsdus rgyud 'di'i dngos bstan la med pas na/ med mi rung gi yan lag tu mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ bsdus pa la dga' ba'i don du brtsams pa'i skabs 'dir ma bris so/ /de nas yang 'di ltar sgom te/ sprul pa'i 'khor lo padma 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i kha steng du phyogs pa'i/ mdud pa'i bu gar a sngon po'o/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa 'og tu kha phyogs pa'i bu gar hū sngon po'o/ /steng du kha phyogs pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa'i bu gar oṃ dmar po'o/ /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo rtsibs sum cu rtsa gnyis po 'og tu kha phyogs pa'i bu gar ha dkar po'o/ /gsang ba'i 'khor lor gnas pa'i rlung gis bskul ba'i me gtum mo'i rang bzhin a yig 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis bzhu ba'i hu yig la sogs pa yi ge gsum dang lhan cig dbyer med pa'i a yig —221—

lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i rang bzhin gyi thig ler gyur pa'i dpa' bo sgom zhing / sgom pa yongs su smin par mos: nas/ de nyid las 'od zer gyi re kha phra mo me lce 'bar ba ltar gnas pas blta bar bya'o/ /de mthus bdud rtsi 'dzags pas gang ste dpa' bo bkrus pa na 'od zer gyi re kha de yang bsil bar gyur te/de nas dpa' bo la sems nges pas/ ji srid du sems brtan pa thob par mtshan ma rnams kyi nye bar dmigs pa de srid du blta bar bya'o/ /brtan pa nye bar mtshon pa na/ 'od zer gyi re kha de'i snang bas sna tshogs pa gsal bar snang bar byed par bsam ste/ thams cad lag mthil gyi skyu ru ra ltar blta'o/ /ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyang myur du rdzogs par bya'o/ /zhes pa thig le'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas bzlas pa ni/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa gang yang rung ba sngon du 'gro bas/ ngag bzlas bya ste/ tsho rna hi bsgo ri hu ka pā li ni ā zhes pa ste rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /i rna brnya ka pā li nī u hihi hū phaṭa/ snying po'o/ /oṃ brnya ka pā li nī badzi ṇi ho dur dza ya dur la snye hu phaṭa/ ces pa ni nye ba'i snying po'o/ /de ltar ci 'grub tu bzlas la/ gtor bsngo mi byed na 'og nas 'byung ba ltar dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu bya'o/ /'grub na bzlas pa'i mthar gtor ma nges par bya ste/ gtor ma nang me chod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ stong pa'i ngang las bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su/ skad cig tsam gyis ye shes sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rdzogs par byon pa/ bdag nyid kyis sgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang gnyis su med par gyur/ gong gi dam ye bsre ba'i sngags lan gsum bzlas/ dur khrod kyi sa gzhi la phyogs skyong ba thams cad kyang gnas par gyur/ gong bzhin chu gnyis dang nyer spyod lnga dang lha mo brgyad kyi sa mchod/ o bzhi ka pā li ni —222—

ba li gro hā gro hā/ gro hā pa ya gro hā pa ya 'a sku huX/ zhus dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la lan bdun gyis phul/ oX ba dha ka pā la badzra tsa ṭi su tse ṭi/ a (laX ba ne sha baX bā re)shrī ṇa ya/ sarba bhū tā na/ ma rā ya sa spru mā rā na/ gī la ya sa rbu dus na/ u tsa ṭa ya sa ṇḍa ne/ bi dra bā ya/ bho bha ga wa te/ yakṣa rakṣa sa/ bī shā tsa ༷na/༷shoX ṣa ya/tā ḍa ya/ sa sta pā tā la ga tā na/ sa ra sa ra/ pra sa ra pra sa ra/ hū hū hū/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ ces lan gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs la phul/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rtog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ khyu dang las las kun du 'byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes kyis la/ /sems can don gyi mnyam med byos/ /'on te sangs rgyas sras bu skyes/ /zhes chos bshad nas/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med pa'i/ /lam de nyid du zhugs nas kyang / /sangs rgyas nyid dang phrad gyur cig /ma grol ba rnams grol bar shog /ma brgal ba rnams brgal bar lha dag /rnal 'byor gtsug lag dam pa la/ /da lta nyid du gnas par shog /ces dge ba bsngos nas/ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang : lko pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi /bar gyis phrin las bcol/ arghaX: nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod pa spyi dang 'dra bar phul/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol rnams byas te/ khu tshur sa la brkyang nas se gol gtogs te/ tseX( āXhūX muX zhes pa dang dril bu 'khrol bas gshegs su gsol/ de nas dkyil wor nye bar bsdu ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa/ bdag gis sgoms —223—

pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ dur khrod brgyad bsrung ba'i 'khor lo de gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa la: de yang lha rnams la: lha rnams gtso bo yab yum la gtso bo yab yum yang thugs ka'i hu la de yang 'od gsal du thim par gyur/ bar skabs der/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag /de las thun mtshams kyi lha sku bsgoms te dge ba bsngo'o/ /gal te dkyil 'khor bsdus pa'i rjes su gtor ma bsngo na/ mdun bskyed dam tshig pa sa bon ni sngags tsam las bskyed/ ye shes pa dang bsres nas gtor ma 'bul ba'am bsdu na skad cig gis bskyed nas spyan drangs kyang chog ste/ gshegs gsol gyi mthar yang smon lam dang bkra shis gang 'grub bya'o/ /gzhan rnal 'byor gyi yan lag rnams ni/ theg pa bla na med pa'i bskyed rim gyi sgrub thabs spyi dang 'dra bas 'dir ma brjod do/ /dam pa rnams ni chos kyi bang mdzod 'dzin/ /gsar pa'i legs bshad rgyas kyang ngoms pa med/ /skye bo nyon mongs can gyi thibs por yang theg mchog nyi 'od 'jug pa 'ga' la srid/ /de phyir mchog tu rnyed dka' ba'i/ /sgrub thabs byas pa'i dge ba gang / /kun la phan pa'i sems kyis te/ /mkha' khyab he ru kar gyur cig/ //ces pa dpal sangs rgyas thod pa'i sgrub thabs de kho na nyid gsal ba zhes bya ba 'di yang /rgyud kyi rgyal po nyid slob dpon sa ra ha pas mdzad par byed pa'i gzhung 'grel bzhi dang bcas pa dang / padma badzra gyi mdzad pa'i rgyud 'grel 'gyur 'phro dang / a bha yā ka ra'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i 'grel chen mi 'jigs pa'i gzhung 'grel rnams la nges pa cung zad rnyed cing / de rnams las phal cher phyi ma nyid mchog tu mthong ste/ gtso bor de'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas jo nang dpal gyi ri khrod du sbyar ba'o/ /bkra shis// //—224—

na nyid gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/dpal sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga de kho na nyid gsal ba zhes bya ba/ rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje sangs rgyas rnam sangs rgyas/ /stong pa'i yab gcig lhag pa'i lha/ /gcig pu bde ba che rang bzhin/ /rang byung bcom ldan la phyag 'tshal/ /rgyud 'di gtsor byed nyung ba'i phyir/ /cho ga rab rgyas nyer mkho med/ /zab mo'i chos mchog mi nub phyir/ / don tshang mdor bsdus tsam zhig 'bri/ /de la 'di'i dkyil chog rim pa gsal ba zhes bya ba/ bram ze chen po'i gzhung du grags pa 'di las/ sa chog gi rim pa la cho ga spyi nag po spyod pas mdzad pa'i bde mchog gi dkyil chog dang 'dra rung ba las/ gsol btab dang gtor sngags sogs mi 'dra ba mang dag dang bcas pa 'byung mod kyi/ sa chog ni gsang ba spyi'i cho ga'i rjes su 'brangs pas don grub cing legs par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gzhan du shes par bya la/ cho ga lhag ma rnams pa/ mi 'jigs pa'i gzhung 'grel las kyang / lag len 'debs rung du gsungs mod kyi/ rgyud 'di'i dkyil chog rang rkang tshugs pa phyogs 'dir 'gyur ba ni rim pa gsal ba gcig bu yin pa'i phyir/ cho ga lhag ma rnams gtso bor de'i rjes su bgrang bar bya'o/ /de yang dang por sta gon gyi bya ba la/ sngon du bya ba'i rim pa dang / sta gon dngos so/ /dang po ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/oX āXhuX gis byin gyis brlabs/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs rnams badzra sa mā dzaX a rghaX nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ tsho( brnye ka pā la badzra tse ṭi/ zhes pa nas/yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar sgrub thabs kyi gtor chog ltar brjod/ de nas —225—

'phrin bcol spyi dang mthun par yang byas nas/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te gtor ma phyi rol du dor ro/ /de rjes gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa yang bde dgyes sogs spyi dang 'dra'o/ /de nas sgrub thabs ltar/ skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar dang / dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu te/ mngon rtogs rgyas pa rdzogs par sgom/ gnyis pa sta gon dngos ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'am maṇḍal la sa lha'i mchod gtor tshom bu dang bcas pa bkod/oṃ haX/ haX gi sgra dang hūX gi 'od kyis bskul nas/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa byung / tshom bu'i steng du byon pa ni sa'i lha mo gser gyi mdog can zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i rin po che'i bum pa bsnams pa/ rgyan dang na bza' dkar po can du gyur/ snyu gsum gyis mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ oX pri thi lī de lī khyuX arghaX pra titsā swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ pā juX/ pu spre/ dhwa pe/ ā lo ke ga rnye/ nai wi du/ sha lta āXhūX gtor ma/a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āXhuX ha ho hri/ oṃ pri the lī de lī khyuX na maXsarba ta thā ga ta spyo bi shwa mu khe khyuX sarba thā khaX ud ga te spa ra ṇa i maX ga ga na khaX gri ste daX bha ling ta ye swāhā/ lan gsum/ oṃ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul deng khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyur/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi stobs bcom pa/ de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ oṃ pri thi lī de ldi khyuX arghaX pra titsā swāhā/ sa'i lha mo slar yang sa de nyid la thim par —226—

gyur/ de rnams sa'i lha mo'i sta gon no/ /de dag bsal te dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'am/ maṇḍal la lha dang grangs mnyam pa'i tshom bu bkod/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ dkyil 'khore gyi dbus su pad nyi ro'i gdan la/ hu dang rdo rje las/ bcom ldan 'das yab yum grub pa na/ nor bu dang nor bu'i 'od zer gyi tshul gyis rnal 'byor ma/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi yang grub pa ni/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka: nas/ brtsed 'jo'i rol pa can no/ /de'i phyi rol shar du phreng bzang mje sogs/ dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams bzhi la/ g.yas bskor gyi nas/ thod pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol shar du dge ba'i ske rags can ma: nas/ sdud byed ma'o/ /de'i phyi rol shar du sgrol byed mje nas/ rlung du grags chen ma'o/ /de'i yang phyi rol shar du mdzes sdug ma/ byang du nor 'dzin ma/ nub tu skal bzang ma/ lhor yid 'ong ma ste/rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi po nas/ zla ba'i rgyun rab tu 'bab pa'o bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar tho nas/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur gyi bar/ go cha gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes pa bstims pa/ dbang bskur rgyas btab/ mchod pa/ bstod pa/ nang gi bdud rtsi myangs ba/ phyi rol gyi bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs pa rnams mngon rtogs ltar bya/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pa lan gsum brjod pas nang mchod phul/ spros pa la dga' na/ mchod bstod rnams rgyas pa dngos gzhi'i skabs nas kha bskang bas chog go /gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ tse( bzhi ka pā li ni ba li grihā zhes pa nas/ kun 'grub shog /gi bar gyi 'phrin las bcol/ spos dang bcas pas rdor dril 'dzin pas/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i/ khyab bdag dngos kun bdag nyid can/ /ston pa'i gtso bo khrag 'thung dpal/ /sna tshogs bde mar yang dag —227—

ldan/ /phyogs mtshams rnams kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /rigs pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can/ /byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /slob ma la ni phan pa dang / khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje can bdag 'di zhes pas/ /nangs par dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ /kun gyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab bo/ /mchod pa khag sos te/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rtsa brgyad po las byung ba'i/ zhes pa nas/ khyod la bdag 'dud do/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod bstod dang /snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum sbyar bas nang mchod phul/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad rang gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs te snying gar thim/de rnams lha sta gon no/ /de nas rgyas par na/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa bya ste/ gtso bo'am byang sgo'i lha mo gang rung las/ las bum logs su mi byed pa ltar na/ bum pa nyer lnga yin la/logs su byed pa ltar na nyer drug go /'on kyang der sang gi lag len ltar na/ las bum logs su byed cing lha bum gcig la bsdu ba yin pas/ bum pa gnyis spyi dang mthun par bshams/ tseX( a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las sna tshogs padma'i steng du a las zla ba'i gdan re re/ de'i steng du paX las rin po che bum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyi mgul bcings dang / dpag bsam gyis shing gi kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su/ pad nyi'i gdan gyi steng du/ g.yon skor gyi a ā i yī nas/ huX yig de nyid kyi snang ba las grub ste/bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog sngon po nas/ rol pa can no/ khar —228—

du phreng bzang ma/ zhes pa nas/ badzra arghaX pra titsā swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar/ lha sta gon gyi skabs dang sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ rtsa brgyad po las byung ba'i nas/ bdag 'dud do/ /zhes mchod bstod dang / snying po'i 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ dzaXhūX baX hoX ye shes sems dpa' dang ro gcig tu 'dres pas/ lha rnams byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bor gyur/gtso tsho snying po nyid ci lbob tu bzla'o/ /las bum gyi nang du huX dang sna tshogs rdo rje las/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang khu/ ljang dkar ser ba'i zhal gsum phyag dang po gnyis kyis sna tshogs rdo rje dang thod khrag 'dzin pas/ rang snang gi yum la 'phyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje 'bar ba dang kha ṭāX ga bsnams pa/ khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /dpral bar oX/mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ ye shes sems dpa' bdud rtsi 'khyil ba badzra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoX oX badzra kuṇḍali badzra hūX phaṭa/ ces ci nus su bzlas pa'i mthar/bum pa gnyis kar la thun mong du/ arghaX nas/ shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ rdo rje dang ni:sogs dang / 'jigs pa'i hūX sgra sogs kyis bstod/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis/ bzod par gsol/ dung phor gyi nang gi he ru ka yang zhu bar gyur/ me tog dang spos la sogs pas mchod do/ /skabs 'dir gtor ma 'bul bar bshad pa 'ga' zhig la yod kyang / 'dir bum pa la gtor ma med la/ mdun bskyed la gong gi des chog pas 'dir mi dgos so/ /bum bskyed kyi skabs 'dir/ rim pa gsal ba dang / gzhud 'grel dang /'grel pa ye shes ldan gsum nas so sor cung zad mi 'dra ba tsam kho na bshad kyang / rgyud las/mdog dang mtshan mar ldan pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams sa bon gyi/ /'od zer gyi ni nom par bsam/ /bdag nyid chen po grags chen po/ /bum pa ru ni —229—

zhugs tsam gyis/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor zhu bar gyur/ zhes gsal bar gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa'o/ /'dir las bum mi byed na bum pa gcig gis kyang rung bar mngon no/ /de rnams bum pa sta gon no/ /de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas/ maṇḍal phul/ tha lu mo sbyar nas/'di'i rjes zlos byed de/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul ston pa/ / mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsole/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ slob ma rnams zhal du bcug /thugs ka'i hū yig gi 'od zer 'bar bas sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs/ he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin pa'i rnam pas rdo rje'i lam nas lha mo'i padma ra phyung shing / hu zhes gsang ba'i mkha' nas spros te/ phyi rol du pad nyi la 'khod par mos/ bu tshur theg pa chen po la/ khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ khyod la yang dag bshad par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro la phan phyir gang bzhugs pa/ /de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes/ /gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med de/ /skyob pa dpal ldan he ru kas/ /bdud sde shin tu mi zad pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen —230—

thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /gong nas gong ma'i sdom pa ni/ /bu khyod kyis ni bzung bya ste/ /grol ba'i rgyu ni de las gzhan/ /thabs ni ci yang yod ma yin/ /zhes slob dpon gyis brjod/ de nas slob mas rgyun bshags lan gsum bya ste/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang / /bgyid du stsal dang yi rang dang / /sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas ni/ /ma lus so sor bshags par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyi/ /bsgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams dang / /tshogs dag la ni yi rang ngo / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas thod pa mkha' 'gro ma/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bdag nyid che/ khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung dpa' bo dang / /rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpag med sogs/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /che ge dus 'di nas bzung ste/ /ji srid gnyis med la gnas par/ /de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa/ /byang chub mchog sems bskyed par bgyi/ /bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas myur du bsgrubs byas te/ /sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /bla med gnas su bsgral bar bgyi/ /slob ma skad cig gis he ru kar bskyed pa'i gnas gsum du dri'i thig le dang / oṃ ā hu las 'khor lo dang / padma dang rdo rje rnams yig 'bris mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi nus pa bkug —231—

nas bstims la/ spyi bor me tog /mdun du spos/ spyan la mar me/ thugs kar dri/ zhal du lha bskos/ snyan la rol mo rnams 'bul lo/ /de nas u dum wa ra'am/a shwatā la sogs pa'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa/ rtse mo me tog ldan pa la/ oX huX he bha ga wa ti mu khaX pa ri shu khyuXsge ku ru swāhā/ zhes lan bdun bsngags pa lag tu byin nas shar ram byang du kha bltas te/ dor ba las dngos grub lung bstan/ de nas/ oX hriXbi shurnya dharma sarba pā paX ni tsa a gya bi lha( dha ya sarba bi ka lhan a pa na ya hūX/ zhes pas khyor chu blud nas/ gtso bo'i snying po bzlas pa'i srad bu dmar po la mdud pa gsum dang ldan pas/ skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon/bud med kyi g.yas/ byis pa'i mgul du bcings pa la/ 'bru gsum brjod nas/ ku sha byin gyis bsas te sngas dang stan du sbyin par bya'o/ /de nas/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wa ra'i me tog ltar/ /brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'di ni/ /de bas kyang ni rnyed dka' ste/ /gang gis mnyam med sems can don/ /bla med par byed nus pa yin/ /gnyis med zab mo'i spyod yul 'dis/ /sems can sangs rgyas thob byed pa'o/ /dang po bskal pa grangs med nas/ /bsags pa'i sdig pa gang dang gang / /de kun zad par 'gyur ba ni/ /zab mo'i dkyil 'khor mthong bas so/ /zhes brjod cing don yang po gad nas/ ku sha'i stan la seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis nyol la rmi lam rtog shig /nangs par dkyil 'khor chen po mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes bsgo bar bya'o/ /de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i bsrung ba ni/ slob dpon gyi lag pa g.yon pa dris byugs shing / me tog gi bkra shis par zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms la/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs te byang sems su zhu ba zla ba la —232—

thim/ de bzhin du mgrin par yang gsal btab nas/ slob ma'i spyi bor lag pa bzhag la/ oṃ bzhi a ta che ge mo'i kā ya adhi tiṣṭha ya skye ma tsa la ma tsa la/ tiṣṭha la ha ra ha ra/ bi dha ra bi dha ra/ dra ba dra ba/ bho bha ga wan sarba bzhi ka pā la badzra gya ya ka ta ma la kā ya shī ghra ku ru ku ru hu hu hā hā/ zhes lan bdun bzlas/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo zla ba zhu nas slob ma'i lus la thim par bsam mo/ /de rnams slob ma sta gon no/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi nyi ma la/ nangs par sngar langs te he ru ka'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/thod pa'i nang du bzhag pa'i thig skud lnga so so'i sa bon las rgyal ba rigs lngar bskyed/ mchod bstod byas te bzhu nas/ thig chen brgyad gdab pa'i dus su/ 'jig rten khams ni ma lus pa'i/ /sangs rgyas la sogs 'gro ba'i don/ khyed kyi dus ni 'di yin no/ /zhes brjod/ ye thig dang las thig mtha' dag legs par btab la/ rdul tshon kha dog sna lnga dang / thig skud bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /sangs rgyas thod pa rgyal chen po/ /de bzhin gshe/gas pa kun kyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /tshon gyi las la yang dag 'jug /ces brjod cing slob dpon gyi rsā thog mar dbye'o/ /thig tshon byin brlab kyi lag len ni/ bde mchog sogs spyi dang 'dra la/ thig tshon gyi mtshan nyid kyang logs su 'chad par 'gyur bas/ de dang de dag las shes par 'gyur ba'i phyir/'di rgyas par ma smos so/ /de ltar na dkyil 'khor zhug gi cho ga'o/ /de nas rgyan dang mchod pa rnams kyang bkram par bya ste/ rnam rgyal bum pa lhor sgo dang / las bum byang sgor 'god par bzhed de/ dkyil 'khor gyi zhal 'jig rten pa'i lha la bstan pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /—233—

rgyud las/ ba dan rnam pa brgyad kyis brgyan/ /zhes pa ltar/ phyogs kyi mdog can gyi ba dan brgyad kyang gtsugs/ gzhan spyi dang 'dra'o/ /sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / gnas yo byin brlab sngon du btang / skyabs 'gro nas bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar sgrub thabs nas 'byung bar ltar rdzogs par sgom/ spro na bgegs sbyang ba dang / til sbyang dang / khrus gsol bya/ bris pa'i dkyil 'khor/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swabha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sngon gyi smon lam gyi: nas/ngo mtshar bar byed pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi gzhal yas khang gdan bcas bskyed/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus kyi/ zhes pa nas/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /de yang dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog sngon ponas/ rtsed 'jo'i rol pa can no/ /dpal he ru ka'i zhal nas hu zhes pa'i sgra bsgrags pas/ rnal 'byore ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi yang skad cig gis grub par gyur ste/thugs kyi 'khor lo'i: nas/ zla ba'i rgyu 'bab pa'o/ /zhes brjod cing sgom ste dam tshig pa bskyed pa'o/ /'di skabs rim pa gsal ba las/ gtso bo hūṃ las skad cig gis bskyed par bshad pa ni/ zor yang bar dgongs pa ste bsdu na de ltar rung la/ yab rkyang du bshad pa ni cung zad mi legs shing / yang na gtso 'khor dus gcig tu bskyed kyang shin tu legs so/ /bdag skyed kyi bsgom pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor dbyer med du gyur/ rang gi thugs ka nas sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor spros te nam mkhar bzhugs/ argha: nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ rdo rje dang ni: sogs kyis bstod/ dza / ba ho zhes dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor dang gnyis su med par bstim/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar lko nas/ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i las kyi he ru ka phyag gnyis —234—

par gyur/ bsgrub mchod zhag sbrel ma byed pa'i dngos gzhi'i nyi ma rting ma rnams la/ skabs 'dir sta gon gyi skabs su 4zhad pa bzhin bum bskyed bzlas pa'i bar du bya'o/ /mchod pa byin rlabs bla med spyi dang mthun par byas/ dkyil 'khor dang bum pa'i lha la dus gcig tu mchod par bsam la mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ bsdu na bdag bskyed dam sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar gyis chog la/ cung zad spros pa la mos na/ dwangs shing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi yon myong mchog 'di dag /sogs dang / oṃ brnya ka pā la/ dza hu kha ra a/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ zhabs bsil dang / pā bya/ 'thor thung dang prokṣa ṇa ste chu gsum 'bul/ oṃ lha yi me tog shin tu dmar sogs dang / oṃ brnya ka pā li ni ma ṭa: sogs/ oṃ tsandan ga bur: sogs/ oṃ brnya ka pā li ni ta ṭa: sogs oṃ mar me'i 'od zer 'bar ba: sogs oṃ budha kā pā li ni gro hā: sogs/ sna tshogs lha yi dri zhim pa sogs dang / (〈pho〉 rma ) mahā ka pā li5 sogs oṃ kha dog dri dang : sogs dang /oṃ buddhā ka pā li ni gro hā nas/ ji sku spyo/ oṃ pa ṭa pa ṭa ha dang jo sogs dang / oṃ badzra shasta ā hu/ gis rol mo phul/ gos zung 'bul ba yang spyi dang 'dra ba las/ sngags ni/ glu tshe mahā ka pā la: badzra dharma sogs so/ /ga༈ yang spro na lha mo bcu drug dang / rin wo bdun dang / 'dod yod lnga la sogs pas mchod/ de nas bstod pa ni/ rdo rje dang ni: sogs dang / hū chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las byung / /gdug pa 'dul mdzad khro bo'i sku/ /mi bzad ha har ba 'ad pa yi/ khrag 'thung sku la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor pham mdzad cing / /rdo rje hu mdzad yi ge hū/ /cha lugs du ma rab tu 'jigs/ /'jigs byed 'jigs par mdzad la 'dud/ /seng ge 'phro go byed tshangs pa'i gtsos/ /gang gi zhabs la phyag 'tshal ba/ khams gsum dbang phyug —235—

srid gsum 'joms/ /dpa' bo'i dbang phyug khyod la 'dud/ /gnyug ma'i dga' ma lhan cig skyes/ /bdag med don gyi ye shes dngos/ /sems can kun la phan dgyes pa/ /sna tshogs bde ma la phyag 'tshal/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa yi thugs/ khres bya kun la rab g.yo ba/ /mkha' spyod rnal 'byor skur ston pa/ /phreng bzang ma sogs la phyag 'tshal/ /zag med bde ba bcud kyi len/ /ye shes bdud rtsis gang ba yis/ /thod pa bzhi po rab sprul ba/ /mchod pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gang gi gsung dbyangs mi zad pa/ /'gro kun bsam pa ji bzhin 'jug /sa spyod rnal 'byor ma yi tshul/ /dge ba'i ske rags can sogs 'dud/ /ji lta ji ltar 'dul ba'i sku/ /sna tshogs sprul pa thabs kyi don/ /sa 'og spyod pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /sgrol byed ma sogs phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dgug dang / /mngon spyod 'phrin las spyod mdzad cing / /'gro ba'i don la gzhol ba yi/ /sgo skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i khang bzang nyams dga' ba/ /e yig bha ga chos kyi dbyings/ /rgyan rnams kun kyis rab brgyan pa/ /gzhal med khang la gus phyag 'tshal/ /sna tshogs rdo rje padma nyi/ /dur khrod wo po'i rab bskor zhing / /rdo rje'i gur ཿngas la sogs pa/ /de dag rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pas bstod par bya'o/ /de nas rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ snying ga'i hu las lha mo brgyad cig car sprul: zhes pa nas/ 'di dag gis ni mchod par bya/ /kho pa'i bar brjod la/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i:zhes pa nas/ skye( ā hu/ lan gsum bar sgrub thabs ltar nang gi bdud rtsi myang ba dang / phyi'i bdud rtsi byin rlabs rnams bya/ de nas nang mchod 'bul ba ni/ he ru ka dpal ye shes —236—

mkha' 'gro ma/ /blo gros rin chen grub thob sa ra ha/ /klu sgrub shā wā ri dang mi tri pa/ /mar pa lo tsā tshul ston dbang nge dang / /ro mnyam rdo rje rgya ston yon tan grags/ kham pa shaka rdor bar btang chos kyi grags/ /rgan lhas pa dang chos rje bsod nams 'phel/ /bag ston gzhe ne tshul mkhas grub brag dkar ba/ khyud lhas pa dang grub chen kun blo'i zhabs/ /bla chen grags rin nam mkha' tshul khrims dang / /zla ba rgyal mtshan chos kyi seng ge dang / /nam mkha' rin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma ste/ /brgyud ldan bla ma kun la mchod pa 'bul/ oṃ ā hu/ gtso bo'i snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pa/ lan bdun gyis dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/mchod pa'i mgron rnams la 'bul tshul yang bde dgyes sogs dang 'dra/ mthar bdag nyid kyi bdud rtsi myangs nas/oṃ a mṛ ta snya da na badzra su bha wa atpa ko3ha/ de'i rjes su 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul te/ sta gon gyis skabs su bshad pa bzhin no/ /de dag ni dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas khrus dang maṇḍal sngon du 'gro bas/ ā kha ldi ra hu/ gyis mig dar bcings shing me tog bzung / sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo/ /rnal 'byor gnas la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /don dam smra ba'i seng ge rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/ /nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa/ /srid pa'i nyes brgya skyed rtsa nyon mongs choms mdzod la/ /rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid grub par mjodi/ /ces lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ kye khyod su yin/ zhes dris —237—
