pa'i lan du/ bdag ni rgyal ba'i sras so/ /de nas dkyil 'khor la gsol ba gdab pa ni/de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lan gsum/lhas gnang ba sbyin par mos/ dzaXhuX baX hoX yol ba'i nang du bcug par mos/ oṃ na ma ste huX/na mo me huX/ na mo na maXhuX/ zhes thun mong du phyag bya/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pu dza u pa za na ya utpa naX ni khya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta swe ra yo gi nī utpa su ma la a dhi tiṣṭha swa maX/ zhes shar sgo dang / oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pu dza a bhi ṣe ka ya utpa naX nirya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta lī ra yo gi nī utpa kā ma ni a bhi ski rmin maX/ zhes byang sgo dang / oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pu dza a pra warta nā ya utpa naX nirya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta lī ra yo gi nī/ utpa bhi ma pra warta ya maX/ zhes nub sgo dang / oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pu dza karma ṇi utpa naX nirya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta wi ra wo gi nī utpa arya ga rma ku zad co maX/ zhes lto phyogs nas phyag 'tshal/ skabs 'dir rim pa gsal ba las thal mo 'god pa spyi dang cung zad mi 'dra ba bshad mod kyang / spyi dang mthun par snying ga spyi gtsug mgrin pa dpral ba rnams su rim bzhin sbyar ro/ /de nas sdom pa bsgrags pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs yid 'ong / /sdom pa brtan por gyur ba'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /blo wo khyod kyi bzung bar bya/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ khres rab dril bu zhes bsgrags so/ /slob dpon khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par spund/ rin chen rigs la rtag tu —238—

ni/ /nyin re bzhin yang lan drug tu/ /chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung / /'di ni padma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /de nas sdom pa bzung ba ni/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de ltar bdag gis bgyid par 'tshal/ /lan gsum mo/ /rang gi snying gar zla ba'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnas pa'o/ /me tog phreng ba dang bcas pa'i rdo rje lnga pa snying gar bzung la/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta u pa ta ya mi/ zhes sems bskyed/rdo rje snying gar gtad/ oṃ su ra te sam ya sta ho : sidha badzra ya tha su kha/ zhes so/ /oṃ badzra kuṇḍali badzra hū phaṭa/ las bum gyi chus bsangs/ ā kha lī ra hu/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs par mos/ /de nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ deng khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ ngas khyod la dpal he ru ka'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan rnams lta ci zhig smos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes dang / he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras gyur na/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshe/gas/ /zhes dang / mna' chu 'thung zhing / 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud —239—

rtsi'i chu 'dis thob/ oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha huX/ zhes dang / de nas brtsams te khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyi/ gang ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba de bya dgos so/ khyed kyi nga la brnyas par yang ma byed cig khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par dus byas nas dmyal bar lhung ba 'gyur ta re/ zhes pa'o/ /de nas ye shes dbab pa ni/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dpal he ru ka dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi ye shes bdag la dbab tu gsol/ /rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ dpal sangs rgyas thod pa yab yum kha sbyor gyi sku/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'bar ba/ sku chung la yan lag dod par gyur/ yab yum snyoms ca zhugs pas mkha' gsang bskyod pa las byung ba'i 'od zer dmar pos lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas lus sems thams cad bde bas khyab/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ dpal he ru ka mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs te/ rang nyid la gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ oX tiṣṭha mahā kro dha ā be sha hūX/ oṃ shrī he ru ka bid ma he bi tu rā dza ya dhī ma he swāhā/ zhes rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te dbab bo/ /oṃ tiṣṭha badzra/ zhes spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram bzhag ste brtan par mos/ lha rnams rigs kyi rim pa bzhin/ /bsod nams ci 'dra de 'drar shog /'di yi dngos grub ci 'drar 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /pra titsā badzra hoX zhes me tog dang / oṃ pra ti gro hā twaX e maX satwa mahā ba la/ zhes me tog rang gi spyi bor bzhag /rang gi las dang rjes su mthun par nam mkha'i kha dog mthong bar mos/ slob ma —240—

dbang bskur gyi dus/ skabs 'dir nam mkha'i kha dog brtag he ru ka dpal dang khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed pa ni brtson par mdzad/ /bye bas thams cad mthong bar yang rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ badzra ni tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa la khyo zhes mig dar phye/ dkyil 'khor bzang —po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dang ba rab tu skye/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang / /dngos grub kun khyod mngon du gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang / /sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis/ /zhes lta bar bskul/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i da/kyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar gyur/ zhes brjod/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs su/ skabs 'dir mngon rtog ltar lha ngo bstan no/ /sna tshogs padma'i gdan steng nas/ /gnyis su med pas legs par 'khyud/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin can/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol ba po/khrag 'thung che la bu khyod ltos/ /sna tshogs bde mas gtsor mdzad pa'i/ /phreng bzang ma sogs lha mo lnga/ /thod pa bzhi por bcas pa yi/ /rab zab thugs kyi 'khor lo dang / /dge ba'i ske rags can la sogs/ gsung gi rnam dag 'khor lo dang / /sgrol byed mkha' 'gro ma la sogs/ /rnam dag sku yi 'khor lo ste/ /rab dang 'bring dang tha ma can/ /mdzes sdug la sogs lha mo bzhi/ /gzugs sogs dag pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /lha rnams de nyid mtshan ma yin/ /zhes brjod/ de rnams ni 'jug pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas dbang dngos ni bum dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul la/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can/ /ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas stsal/ /de bzhin bdag la deng stsol cig /dpa' bo —241—

chen po mi bzlog pa'i/ /dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol/ /sems can kun kyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon gyur/ /lan gsum gyis gsol ba bto/dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i phyogs su dbang stegs seng khri padma gdan nang tshangs can brtsegs pa'i steng du/ bdag nyid dpal he ru ka zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/sku mdog sngon po ḍā ma ru kha ṭāX ga gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur gyur/ steng du gdugs dang mtha' skor du mchod pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su gang bar byas/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i nye bar gtum mo 'bar bas/ zhes pa nas/ me tog la sogs pa'i char phab cing /dbang bskur bar mdzad do/ /zhes brjod/ yungs kar gyis brab cing gtso bo'i sngags brjod/ rnam rgyal bum pa bteg ste me tog 'thor zhing / oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba/sogs kyis shis pa brjod cing rol chen bya'o/ /de nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba spyin par bya/ /oṃ he ru ka ldi ra twaX a bhi shis zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur te/ rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can rnams kyis dbang bskur bar gyur/ dbu rgyan bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ huX oX khyu hruXkhaX rnams las byung ba'i dbu rgyan dar dpyangs dang bcas pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i ngo bo/ rigs lnga'i sku gzugs kyis mtshan par gyur/ dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs bcings la/ thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab bsngags pa'i/ /rin chen dbu rgyan dam pa dang / /dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oX pa ṭa ka badzra a ra li —242—

ho/ de nas rdo rje rtse dgu pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hu las dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de nyid zhu ba las byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi ngo bor rdo rjer gyur/sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje yi/ /dbang gis de ring khyod dbang bskur/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long / /oṃ badzra a dhi pa ti twa/ a bhi khiñtsa ma/ rdo rje gsor zhing snying gar gto la/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /ces rdo rje'i de kho na nyid bsam/ dril bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ rang snang pa'i thabs kyis 'khyud pa/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i rtse dgu pa'i mtshan pa'i dril bur gyur/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcings/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /oṃ shri he ru ka a dhi pa ti twa/ a bhi khri ñtsa tiṣṭha bī ra sa ma ya twa/ dril bu lan brgyad du dkrol la dkur bsten/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis dngos med byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa dam pa byed par shog /ces dril bu'i de kho na nyid dran par bya'o/ /de la rim pa gsal ba las/rdo rje chen po rtse dgu pa/ /de nyid ldan pas byin brlabs nas/ /zhes 'byung ba ni/ rdo rje'i de kho na nyid/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /lko sogs dran pa yin gyi/ lha nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi de nyid dran pa la sogs pa ni ma yin no/ /des na/ 'dir rdo rje dang dril bu rdor sems yab yum du bskyed/ yab rdo rje dang yum dril bur bsgyur nas/ dbang de nyid rim can du tsho—243—

bskur yang legs par 'gyur te/ rim pa gsal ba'i ba ched pa yang de yin no/ /rdor dril snying gar 'khyud rgya byas la/ bdag nyid dpal he ru ka yum sna tshogs bde mas 'khyud pa/thugs rgyud bde ba chen pos gang bar gyur/ rdo rje dril bu yang dag 'byud/ /g.yon snyems pa dang sgros snon 'chang / /gnyis med gnyis med rnal 'byor te/ /phyag rgya chen por byin gyis brlabs/ /zhes phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig dran par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung / zhal nas thon/rang gi kha sgo nas zhugs/ snying ga'i hu la thim/ snying po lan gsum brjod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gse(la/ /'dir gzhung las/ byin brlab che ldan sngags kyis ni/ / sngags kyi dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /zhes 'byung ba ni/ sngags dbang ster dgos pa'i don yin gyi/ tshig de brjod dgos pa'i don ma yin no/ /de nas dpal he ru ka yab yum gyi ngo bo rdo rje dril bu spyi bor bzhag pas lus 'od kyis gang bar bsam la/ oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti twa/a bhi ṣañtsa rtem/ shrī he ru ka nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal/ zhes gsang mtshan dran par bya/ ming gi dbang ngo / /de ltar dbang de rnams bskur bas/ nyon mongs pa lnga dag /phung po lnga gnas gyur/ ye shes lnga mngon du bya'o/ /sangs rgyas lnga'i 'phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang ngo / /bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par gyur/ rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo rdo rje lag tu gtod la/'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /he ru ka dpal phyag na 'dug khyod kyi kyang ni —244—

rtag tu bcang / /he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badzra sa ma ya/ /tiṣṭha e ṣa twaX/ dha ra yā mi hūX/ ha ha ha hoX rdo rje brtul zhugs so/ /rang nyid sangs rgyas thod pa he ru ka'i skur gyur/ huX las byung ba'i phyag mtshan rnams gtad/ he ru ka dpal kha ṭāX ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍā ma sa /rdo rje kha ṭāX rdo rjer bcas/ /dril bu sil sil sgra sgrog cing / /tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag kha ṭāX ga dang rnal 'byor snod/ /dpa' bo chen pos blang bar bgyi/ /spyod pa'i brtul zhugs so/ /de nas dbang gi lha rnams gtso bo'i thugs ka'i rtsa brgyad la thim/ spros pa la dga' na chu dbang nas 'di'i bar dbang rdzas la gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab rnams byed pa dang / dbang lnga la slob ma'i mchod pa dang / rtogs skyed sogs/ spyi dang mthun pa dang / bar 'di lha mchod pa dang / mig thur sogs rjes gnang rgyas pa'ang byas pas chog go/'on kyang spros pa tsam du rig par bya'o/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang dang dbye dang mnan la sogs/ /bsad dang bskrad pa thams cad ste/ /las de rnams ni bsgrub par bgyi/ /ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang / / mchil lham de bzhin ril bu ste/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dngos grub ni/ /de ni ci dgar bsgub par bgyi/ /rjes gnang ngo / /de nas lung bstan ni/ he ru ka dpal lung ston bzhin/ / mgrin gcig tu ni thams cad kyi/ /'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te/ /he ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs/ /dngos po mchog tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /shrī he ru ka nā ma/ ta thā ga ta tiṣṭha sirnyi sa ma ya twaX/ bhu ra bhuXwa suX gsang mawo dran par bya ste/ lung bstan no/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /—245—

zhugs pa dang ni mthong bas kyang / /sdig pa kun las nges grol te/ /de ring khyod rnams bde bar gnas/ /dbang 'di bskur ba tsam gyis ni/ / slob ma yon tan bdag por 'gyur/ /slob dpon nyid kyang bde ba yi/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi dam tshig yin/ /nangs par sngar langs sems dag nyid/ /ma lus las ni byas nas kyang / /srung dang bza' ba la sogs pa/ /sdom pa'i bdag nyid kyis bsrung ngo / /lus dang srog la ltos med par/ /dam tshig dang ni sdom pa bsrung / /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin yang bzla bar bya/ /gang tshe nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa/ kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ /dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te/ /zla ba re re bsrung ba ni/ /gnyis med gnyis med 'khor lo gnas/ /tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod/ /chang dang sha sogs gang ci'ang rung / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs/ /thams cad gnyis med dbang na gnas/ /he ru ka dpal rab tu mchod/ /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ / sems can la yang rgyab mi phyogs/ /'khor ba dag kyang mi spong zhing / /mya ngan 'das la dgar mi rung / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun la/ khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya ste/ /phyag rgya gzhom pa mtshon cha dang / /mtshan ma 'god par mi bgyid do/ /dam tshig rab bsrung bsod nams kyis/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /bud med thams cad mthong ba na/ /g.yon nas lan gsum bskor bya zhing / /spyi bos phyag ni byas nas kyang / /lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab/ /bdag bu khyod nyid ma yin te/ /ji srid byang chub 'byung bar du/ /byang chub yan lag nu ma las/ /byung ba'i rang gi 'o mas skyongs/ /gnyis med ye shes dpyod ldan par/ /bslab pa blangs

pa sngon 'gro bas/ /sgra sogs stong pa sngon 'gro ba'i/ /tshangs par spyod pa shin tu srungs/ /dam tshig de la rtag gnas te/ /de sngon 'gro ba sbas pa'i yid/ /spyod dang grol ba'i gnas 'dod pa'i/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub 'gyur/ /zhes dkyil 'khor gyi bdag pos gsungs par bsam shing / gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsa'/ pa/ /de ltar bdag gis bgyid par 'tshal/ /lan gsum gyis khas blang ngo / /de ltar bum pa'i dbang thob pas/ /bskyed rim 'phrin las kun la dbang / /phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob cing / /sprul sku'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur/ /gsang ba'i dbang gi don du mkha phul/ bdag ni 'khor ba'i 'dam du bying / /dpung gnyen mdzod cig skyob pa po/ /bdag ni skal dman rtsol ba chung / /sangs rgyas chos dang rnam bral bas/ /kyai ston pa bla ma che/ /mgon po khyod kyis brtse bar mdzod/ /ces lan gsum/ de nas/ glu te he ru ka lī ra twaX/ badzra a bhi khri sbyo/ zhes chu dbang dang / skye( pa ṭaX ka badzra ā ra li hoX zhes dbu rgyan dang / oṃ badzra a dhī pa dhi twaX a bhi khri nyu mi/ zhes rdo rje dang / oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa dhi twaX/ a bhi ṣañtsa tiṣṭha bī ra sa ma ya twaX/ zhes dril bu dang /oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa dhi twaX/ a bhi ṣañtsa mi/ shrī he ru ka nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ zhesaming gi dbang bskur ro/ /'dir de tsam gyi don 'grub par mthong bas/ zor yang pa'i dbang du byas la/ gzhud las/ sngar gsungs cho ga bzhin du ni/ /chu sogs dbang rnams bskur bar bya/ /ces sngags dbang ma gtogs gong bzhin bskur bar bshad pa yin te/ spros pa la dga' na de ltar bya'o/ /sgyu thod kyi dkyil chog rim pa gsal ba gnyis kyi lugs lo/ skabs 'dir 'di lta bu bshad kyi/ rgyud dang dkyil chog gzhan phal cher las mi 'byung bas/ mi spro na ma byas kyang chog go /ā khaX bī ra huX gis gdong g.yogs/ yid kyi lus ni brtan pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig —247—

rab tu brjod/ /gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan/ /des na phyag rgyar rab tu bsgrags/ /bla ma he ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab yum gyi sku la zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhugs/ gsang bar lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes brtan par byas pa'i byang chub kyi sems bdag gi lce thog tu bzhug /'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyi/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur/ /byang chub sems ni bzang po yis/ /de ltar bu khyod dbang bskur ro/ /snying po'i mthar/ oṃ ā hu/ zhes brjod/ bdud rtsi myangs/ a ti su kha/ zhes brjod/ gdong g.yogs bsal/ de ltar gsang ba'i dbang thob pas/ /sngags bzlas rlud sogs sgom la dbang / /sa bcu pa dang skal ba mnyam/ /longs sku'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur/ /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du ma rdzo phul/ bdag ni 'khor ba'i 'dam du bying / /rnam rtog mang dang bdag ldan pas/ /bag chags yang dag bcad pa yi/ /mdzes ma khyod kyis skyob par mdzod/ /grags pa chen po snying rje che/ /lha mo des ni zhi bar mdzod/ /ces lan gsum/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo he ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i rjes chags kyi rkyen gyis/ lte bar gtum mo sbar bas bde ba: zhes pa nas/gsung bzhin par gyur/ kyai ā ho dper na bu tsha med pa'i khyim/ khre ma thag tu stong par 'gyur/ /de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni/ /ye shes kun du stong pa nyid/ /dper na pi wa sbyor sogs kun/ khyud dang bral na rdung mi rung / /de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni/ /sngags dang bsam gtan 'grub mi 'gyur/ / rmongs pa gang zhig dbang med par/ /bdag ni dbang —248—

bskur zhes smra ba/ /ji srid sangs rgyas zhugs kyi bar/ /slob mar bcas te dmyal bar 'gro/ /zhes nyes dmigs bsgrags so/ /'di bram ze chen po'i gzhung 'grel du grags pa 'di dag tu/ gong ma'i dbang gsum la so sor phral te sbyar yang / de 'dra'i nges pa mi snang bas/ 'dir chabs gcig tu sgrog go /de nas yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal te/ zhes pa nas char phab cing dbang bskur bar mdzad do/ /zhes brjod/ gong gsal dbang gi skabs ltar dbang lnga dang / yid kyi lus su: sogs/ phyag rgya'i dam tshig dang / 'das pa'i rdo rje pa sogs kyis gsang dbang yang bskur bar mos/ de nas yang sngon bzhin mig dar bcings/ dbang gi lha mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis gdams par mos la/ bcu gnyis lo lon bu mo ni/ /tshul khrims ma nyams chags chung ba/ /thos dang ldan zhing grags chen mo/ /nad med snying rje dang ldan pa/ /sems can don la gcig nan tan/ /dgod cing padma'i spyan dang ldan/ /zla ba'i cha 'dra gdong mdzes ma/ /mu cor mi smra brtan zhing dul/ khres rab padma'i nang dbus su/ /dpag tshad bye ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /sum brtsegs dag pa'i bdag nyid lus/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa/ /dkyil 'khor de yi dbus gnas pa'i/ /mkhas pa'i slob ma bzang dbang bskur/ /gal te byang chub bla med 'dod/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor bya ba min/ /lha rnams bshig pa tsam gyis ni/ /sdig pa chen por skye bar 'gyur/ /des na rdul tshon tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhi lha rnams dag mi 'gyur/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen dang / /de bzhin padma ral gri nyid/ /byas nas slar yang 'jig byed pa/ /skyes bu tha shal dmyal bar 'gro/ /gang gis sangs rgyas spyan 'dren zhing / /gang gis gshegs su gsol ba yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' byon pa dang / /de —249—

bzhin gshegs pa byon pa rnams/ /gang na'ang bzhugs pa ma yin te/ /dri ma med cing dag pa'i lus/ /gang gis spyan drangs gshegs su gsol/ /de nyid kyis na brtag med par/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams phyag bya/ /de nas mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rig ma gtad par mos la/ gang gis shes rab ma mnyes par/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyis ni mchod/ /'di nyid la ni sangs rgyas bzhugs/ /gzhan gang dngos grub gtso bo dang / /snying rje ldan pa gzhan gang zhig /mkha' 'gro ma kun 'di la bzhugs/ /gsang ba phyi yi lnga dang ni/ /bdun dang bcu bzhir bshad pa dang / /gnyis ka gcig tu 'dus pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de nas spro na bar 'dir/ dri ba dri lan sogs kyang bya/ bdag dang rig ma gnyis ka mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog sngon po nas/ rtsed 'jo'i rol pa can no/ /yab yum gnyis ka'i thugs kar tho nas/rdo rje'i lte ba la hu/ yum gyi bha ga hi las:nas/ oṃ dkar pos mtshan pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas/ lugs 'byung dang lugs zlog gi dga' ba bzhi mngon du byas par gyur/ 'dod chags ma yin chags bral min/ /dbu mar dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /gsum po spangs pa kho na las/ /lhan cig skyes pa byang chub brjod/ /gang du dbang po nyams gyur dang / /bdag gi rang bzhin rnam par nyams/ /lhan cig skyes dga' rtogs de yin/ /bla ma'i zhal las gsal 'dri na'o/ /zhes brjod/ gdong g.yogs bsal/ de ltar shes rab dbang thob pas/ /las dang ye shes lam la dbang / /bcu gnyis pa dang skal mnyam zhing / /chos sku'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur/ de nas dbang bzhi —25()—

pa'i smo du mkho phul/ khyod zhabs pa' bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang / /bdag la bka' drin skyabs du gsol/ /lan gsum/ gang zhig shar dus tshe na dbang po dang / /yul rnams nub gyur de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi snying sbas su sad pa/ /phyis ni mngon dga' rgyal ba'i mdzes sku gcig /so so rang gis rigs gdod ma nas gnas pa'i ye shes/ mngon gsum du shar na gzung 'dzin nub par snang la/ rtogs bya dang rtogs byed dbye ba med pas sems nyid kyi rang bzhin lhan cig skyes dga' rnam pa thams cad pa'o/ /de ltar yang / phyag rgya chen po thig le las/ /yang dag dri med rnam pa'i 'od/ /gang du yang na gnas med do/ khar ba ma yin nub pa min/ /rtag tu shar ba char yang mchog /ces gsungs so/ /mtshams med lnga re byed/ pa dang / /rmongs gang ma rung las byed dang / /skye ba dman gyur 'gro ba rnams/ /rdul tshon mthong bas grol bar 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu mngon zhugs pas/ /gtsang ma'i gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ khren tu sbyor ba'i sems kyis ni/ /skye 'dir dngos grub ma thob kyang / /skye gzhan srid par dngos grub 'gyur/ /dbang bskur yang dag spyin ldan na/ /skye dang skye bar dngos grub 'gyur/ /de yi skye ba bdun la ni/ /ma bsgrub par yang dngos grub thob/ /gang yang sgom pa dang ldan zhing / /gal te dam tshig sdom la gnas/ /skye 'dir las dbang gis ma grub/ /re zhig dam tshig nyams pa la/ /dngos grub thob pa lta zhog gi /mi yi skye ba'ang rnyed par dka'/ /gang yang bla ma brgyud pa yi/ /rim 'ongs de nyid rig pa yi/ /sgrub pa po yis 'grub snyam —251—

dgongs/ /zhes dam tshig bshad do/ /de ltar bzhi pa'i dbang thob pas/ /phyag rgya chen po bsgom par dbang / /rdo rje 'dzin dang skal mnyam ste/ /lhan cig skyes sku mngon du 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /gtso bos ji ltar: sogs lan gsum/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams te: sogs dge ba bsngo/ skabs 'di'i mchod gtor gyi mthar/ spyin bsreg dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo sogs ci 'grub tu bya'o/ /de dag ni bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'o/ /slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba yang de nyid 'don pa spos pas 'grub par 'gyur ba'i phyir/zlos te brjod par ma byas so/ /de nas rjes chog gi mchod pa bshams la byin gyis brlabs/argha nas sha lta'i bar gyis mar/ rdo rje dang ni: sogs kyis bstod/ bdud rtsi phul/ 'dod don gsol btab/ yig brgya bzod gsol rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol ba dang /ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs bya ba dang / rdul tsho ni cho ga nyin zhag sbrel ma'i skabs/ zhag snga ma rnams la brtan bzhugs dang / /phyi ma la gshegs gsol bya ba dang / mthar rang la go cha dgod cing / smon lam dang bkra shis rnams bya ste spyi dang 'dra'o/ /zab mo blo mig dag pas mthong ba na/ /dad pa'i snying la mi g.yo'i go skabs ci/ /nges pa'i gzhud dang mthun par legs sbyar ba'i/ /dkyil chog 'dis kyang 'gro la phan par 'gyur/ /dge des bcom ldan rdo rje snying rje'i stobs/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i bde bas rol pa can/ /mnyam med de dang mnyam par nyer spyod pa'i/ /gsang ba'i bdag dang mtshungs par da gyur cig/ //ces pa dpal sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga de kho na nyid gsal ba zhes bya ba 'di yang / rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ ma ṅga la/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i lugs kyi 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga shes pas/ 'di la 'jug par bya'o/ /—252—

rdzogs rim bzhugs/oṃ snya skyi/ 'dir rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal sangs rgyas thod pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa nyams su len pa la/ bskyed pa'i rim pa ni mi 'jigs pa'i gzhung 'grel las 'byung ba ltar lha nyer lnga'i mngon rtogs rdzogs par sgom pa'am/ rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rim pa'am/ gtso rkyang sogs man ngag ltar bsgom par bya'o/ /rdzogs rim sgom par 'dod na thog mar bsrung ba bya ba ni/ oṃ bzhi ka pā li ni a khaX graX druX shuX huX phaṭa ces pa'i sngags 'di brjod pas so/ /de nas rang nyid skad cig tsam gyis bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas thod pa'i skur lam gyis bsgom par bya'o/ /sku'i rnam pa ni sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas kyi dang pos gri gug dang g.yon gyi dang pos thod pa 'dzin pa/ lhag ma gnyis g.yas kyis cang te'u dang / g.yon gyis kha ṭāX 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis pad nyi ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ sgrub thabs rnying pa dang man ngag las dbu skra ser po gyen brdzes su bzhed/ gzhung 'grel las 'khor lo sdom pa lta bur bshad/rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ mgo 'phreng can/ yum sna tshogs bde ma sku mdog dmar mo gcer mo rgyan med gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa'i sku can no/ /de ni rten bskyed rim bsdus pa ste dmigs skor gcig go /—253—

dngos gzhi la/ thog mar rlung gi rnal 'byor rnam pa bzhi las/ dang po rdul mtha' can ni/ rlung phyir 'gro ba'i tshe sgra med shin tu dal ba rdul mi ldeg pa lta bu'i rgyun ma chad par 'bud cing 'bud pa rdzogs pa'i tshe lto ba tshigs pa la bcar te phyir nan tsam byed pa dmigs skor gnyis pa'o/ /gnyis pa gang ba can ni/ rlung nang du 'ong ba'i tshe sgra med shin du dal ba'i ngang nas rngub cing rngubs zin pa na cung zad gcig nang du nan tsam byas kyang phyi la shar gyis btang / dmigs skor gsum pa'o/ /gsum pa rengs pa can ni/ rlung phyir bus la phyir thub tshad du bzung /mig nam mkhar blta ste dmigs skor bzhi pa'o/ /de rnams la dbugs kyi 'gro 'ong dang bstun pa'i 'od zer 'gro 'ong la dmigs pa bya'o/ /bzhi pa bum pa can la thog mar 'jam rlung bgang ba la bslab ste sngon 'gro yin/ dmigs skor lnga pa'o/ /de nas steng rlung shar gyis rngubs dmigs pa ni lus kyi stod kyi rlung rnams 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa'i rnam pas nye bar sleb par bsam thur sel drag tu 'then pas smad kyi rlung rnams 'od zer gyi rnam pas nye bar sleb par bsam la rlud bum can kha spyor drag tu bzung / res 'ga' steng 'og gi rlung rnams dkrugs pa'i tshul gyis 'dres par bsam res 'ga' so sor gyes par bsam mo/ /mi bde ba snyam byed na gzhi la/ skabs su bab pa na kha nang gi rlung mid pa mang nyung ji ltar rigs par bya ba ni bum can dngos te dmigs skor lnga pa'o/ /de rnams ni phra mo'i rnal 'byor ro/ /gtum mo rdor bzlas dang bcas pa —254—

la gtum mo'i rnal 'byor ni rnam pa gsum las/ dang po ni lus la rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi gsal gdab par bya ste/ lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma sbom phra mda' smyug 'bring po tsam kha dog sngon po yas sna spyi bo dang / mas sna lte 'og sor bzhir zug pa/ g.yas su ro ma dmar po dang / g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po gnyis kyi mas sna dbu ma'i mas snar chug tsam dang / yas sna sna bug g.yas g.yon gnyis su zug par bsam/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa kha dog gser btso ma ltar ser ba'i lte ba rtsa dbu ma'i nang du nyi ma'i dkyil sde bor gyi steng du a sngon po zhig gsal btab/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad pa kha dog nag po'i lte ba dbu ma'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hū nag po zhig gsal btab/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa kha dog dmar po'i lte ba'i dbu ma'i nang du o dmar po zhig gsal btab/ spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis pa kha dog dkar po'i lte bar ha dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa zhig gsal btab/zugang sgor rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam sngon po dang / de'i steng du me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po rnams gsal btab/ de nas rlung ro bsal ba ni thog mar rlud phar zang tshur zang lan kha yar zhig byas la/ de nas dang por lus sgur ba las rim gyis sgyed kyis byed cing sna bug nas hu gi sgra dang bcas te rlung ro lan gsum bsal/ de nas lus kyi stod sgur gdong thur du bstan la kha nas hal zhes pa'i sgras rlung ro lan gsum bsal lo/ /de nas steng rlung myur bar rngubs pas ro rkyang gi nang brgyud de song ba las dbu ma'i mas snar zhugs/—255—

thur sel drag tu 'then pas bshang sgo'i rlung g.yos me 'bar bas me rlung 'dres pa de dbu ma'i nang nas zhugs lte ba'i a la reg pas a las reg bya shin tu tsha ba'i gtum mo'i me sngon po zhig cher gyis 'bar dbu ma'i nang brgyud snying ga'i hū la reg pas hū las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi nang thams cad gang zhing der gnas pa'i byang chub kyi sems rnams zhu bar byas 'od zer ba sbu'i bu ga nas phyir 'thon sems can rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi dwangs ma rnams dang / sa chu me rlung sogs 'byung ba'i khams kyi bcud rnams dang / sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi byin brlab thams cad bsdus te/ ba sbu'i bu ga nas zhugs/ de rnams dang rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi byang chub kyi sems rnams spyi bor 'dus shing / spyi bo'i ha las byung ba'i byang sems lhan cig tu babs te rim gyis dbu ma'i nang brgyud snying ga'i hu las khrus gsol ba'i tshul gyis khyil li li 'khyil zhing byang sems rnams snying ga'i hu la thim par bsam pa ni gtum mo'i dmigs pa dang po ste dmigs skor drug pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'thon pa'i bar sngar dang 'dra ba las/ de nas snod bcud kyi dwangs ma rnams rang gi spyi bor zhugs/ de rnams dang ha las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems rnams lhan cig dbu ma'i nang brgyud de snying ga'i hu gi sked pa tsam du 'bar 'dzag rtse sprad do/ /de yang res 'ga' byang sems kyi rgyun stobs che bar gyur te gtum mo'i me de hū gi zhabs kyu las sor gang tsam gyis dma' bar bsdus shing byang sems kyi rgyun der sleb —256—

par bsam/ res 'ga' gtum mo'i me stobs che bar gyur te gtum mo hū gi na da las sor gang tsam gyi mtho bar song ba na byang sems kyi rgyun yang de tsam du yar thung ngu song bar bsam zhing rlud bum pa can bzung ba ni gtum mo'i dmigs pa gnyis pa ste dmigs skor bdun pa'o/ /gsum pa ni gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las 'bar 'dzag lte bar rtse sprad de sgom pa ni gtum mo'i dmigs pa gsum pa ste dmigs skor brgyad pa'o/ /yang na gtum mo 'di rnams bum pa can gyi rlung sbyor dang ma sbrel bar rlung rang bab kyi ngang nas sgom na dbugs phyir 'gro ba'i tshe gtum mo 'bar/nang du 'jug pa'i tshe ha las byang chub kyi sems babs/ gnas pa'i tshe 'bar 'dzag rtse sprad de bsgom/ de la nang tshan gsum yod pas sgom pa na dmigs skor gsum yang chig 'khrid 'bogs pa'am/ go sla ba'i sgo nas dmigs skor gcig tu bsgoms te dmigs skor dgu pa'o/ /de ltar gtum mo ni rang lus thabs ldan gyi thig le'i rnal 'byor ro/ /gtum mo'i rnal 'byor gsum po de las gang yang rung ba zhig yun ring du bsgoms kyang bde drod kyi ye shes skyed ma gas na/ bogs 'don gyi rma sbyor rnams bsgom par bya ste/ de la yang dbu ma'i sgor rlung rnams sdud pa dang / dbu ma'i sgo dbye ba dang / btsan thabs kyi sbyor ba dang gsum mo/ /dang po la gnyis las rlung spyor dang po ni lus gnad sems skyil lhod pa tsam bya zhing lag pa gnyis pus mo'i steng du bzhag /lus sgyed cing rlud ro bsal/ steng rlud bshar kyis rngubs la/ sked pa'i thad nas bzung rlung mdun ngos su thub tshad du phul ba —257—

dang / lto ba mdun ngos su phyir drag tu bskyed do/ /de rjes gsang gnas kyi rlung gi sne mo rgyab ngos la bcug go /rlung phyir 'bud pa'i tshe rgyab rlung drag tu 'then la lto ba tshigs pa la gcer ba ste dmigs skor bcu pa'o/ /rlung sbyor gnyis pa ni/ lus gnad sngar bzhin las rlung phyir bus shing /dbu ma bskyel bshig yang yang byed pa dmigs skor bcu gcig pa ste de gnyis rlung rnams dbu ma'i sgor sdud par byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa dbu ma'i sgo dbye ba la yang gnyis las/ dang po lus gnad sngar dang 'dra ba las/ rlung lho bar mnan zhing mdun ngos su drag tu bkyed cing yang rlung ma shor bar lto ba tshigs pa la gcer te dmigs skor bcu gnyis pa'o/ /rlung sbyor gnyis pa ni lus gnad pus mo gnyis sa la btsugs lag pa g.yas g.yon gyis mkhal khung g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi phyi mtshams nas bsdams la rlung mkhal khung du drangs/ gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las mthar rlud phyir 'bud pa'i tshe mgo bo dang / ro stod g.yas g.yon du gcu pa ni dmigs skor bcu gsum pa ste rlung sbyor de gnyis ni dbu ma'i sgo dbye bar byed pa'o/ /gsum pa btsan thabs kyi sbyor ba la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lus gnad tsog bur byas la rlung bum can bzung zhing lag pa gnyis kyis mgrin pa'i 'phar rtsa gnyis gnon pa ni longs spyod kyi wos te dmigs skor bcu bzhi pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni rkang pa g.yas pa'i rting pas bshang sgo bkag cing lag pa —258—

g.yon pa rkang pa g.yon pa'i brla dang byin pa'i bar du bcug nas gdan la bstad/ lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs pa g.yon pa'i mchan khung du bcug cing g.yon pa'i bar lhus mnan la rlung bum can bzung zhing / mchan khung g.yon ngos su rlung drag tu dgang ngo / /dmigs skor bco lnga pa'o/ /yang g.yas phyogs la ni de las go ldog pa ste dmigs skor bcu drug pa'o/ /'di ni btsan thabs kyis sbyor ba gnyis pa yin zhing / de dag gis ni rlung g.yas g.yon du spo bar nus so/ /de nas rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ /rlung nang du dal bus 'ong ba'i tshe oṃ gyi sgra dang ldan par mos shing lus kyi dbus su gnas pa'i tshe hri te gzhil ba yang de'i nang du 'dus pa dang / 'gro 'gro ba'i tshe lto ba gcer ba na buddhā dang / phyir bzung zhing hu gi sgra bya sgra nam mkha' dang mnyam par mos/ ka pā li ni zhes pa'i sgras yang dbus g.yas g.yon gsum nas drangs nang du 'ongs shing spyi bo las byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun babs par mos/gnas pa'i tshe skyo gi sgra dang srog thur mdun du phul bas byang chub sems kyis lus thams cad gang bar mos phyir 'gro ba'i tshe ā zhes pa'i sgra dang bcas par bsam zhing kha nas drag tu bus la 'dar dkrug bya ste dmigs skor bcu bdun pa'o /de ni bum can gnyis kyi ring la yi ge bcu gcig pa'i rdor bzlas tshar gcig 'gro bar byed pa'o/ /de ltar na de yan chod ni rang lus thabs ldan gyi man ngag dmigs bcas kyi rdzogs rim yin zhing / gzhan lus shes rab ma la —259—

brten pa'i dmigs bcas kyi thig le'i rnal 'byor ni logs su shes par bya'o/ /dmigs med rnam par mi rtog pa'i rdzogs rim la thog mar so sor sdud pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ lus gnad spyi dang mthun par byas shing / mig gi lta stangs gyen thur thad ka gang rung la mig 'bras mi g.yo bar blta/ sems rnam rtog gi 'phro 'du thams cad spangs te bzo med du lhod de 'jog pa ni so sor sdud pa'o/ /yul snang dang rnam rtog ci shar ba thams cad sems kyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pas gang shar ba de la bzo med du 'jog pa ni bsam gtan gyi rnal 'byor cho/ /rnal 'byor de gnyis ni rgyas par bram ze chen po'i do he'i khrid yig tu bshad zin pa kho na'o/ /de ltar gong gi dmigs bcas kyi rdzogs rim dang /dmigs med kyi rdzogs rim 'di yun ring du bsgoms pas g.yas g.yon ro rkyang gi rlung 'gags te dbu mar zhugs pa ni srog rtsol dang / dbu ma'i nang gi rlung rnams 'khor lo so so'i lte ba'i thig le la thim pa ni 'dzin pa dang / stong gzugs kyi phyag rgyas zhu bde 'dren pa ni rjes dran dang / mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba'i ye shes skad cig ma dang po skyes pa nas ting nge 'dzin no/ /de yang gong gi phra thig gi rnal 'byor la rtse gcig tu 'bad pas bde drod kyi nyams myong ci rigs pa skyes na dmigs med kyi rdzogs rim de sgom pa la bogs che zhing dmigs med bsgoms pas dmigs bcas kyi rgyun de yang rdzogs rim rnam par mi rtog par 'gyur la/ phra thig gi rnal 'byor de kho na yun bsrings te sgoms na yang thog mar rang shugs kyi sems lhan kyis gnas pa dang / bde ba'i nyams —260—

myong ci rigs pa skye zhing / de nas mi ring bar bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin mchog rang shugs la skye bar 'gyur ro// //dpal sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud las 'byung ba'i rdzogs rim gzhung shing gi khrid yig 'di yang tā ra nā thas smras pa ste rgya gar gyi mkhas grub slob dpon 'i rbu ṇa shi'i gsung bzhin bkod pa'o/ /zhus dag //rī—261—
